description: Terrestrial herbs with pseudobulbous stems, evergreen, glabrous, mostly 30–60 cm tall. Pseudobulbs conical to cylindric, covered by the bases of the foliage leaves, close together. Foliage leaves 3–4, on the apex of the pseudobulb, plicate, lanceolate-ovate, cuneate at the base, petiolate, present during flowering. Inflorescences racemose, suberect and much shorter than the foliage leaves, arising from the basal portion of the new developing shoot; peduncles partly hidden by sheathing sterile bracts; rachis few-flowered; floral bracts persistent. Flowers large, resupinate; in Thai species usually white, cream-coloured, pink or yellowish with darker markings. Sepals united in their lower part into an urceolate body, adnate to the column foot and thereby forming a distinct spur-like or globose mentum. Petals free, smaller than the sepals. Labellum 3-lobed, spurless, mobile on the apex of the column foot, clawed at the base, with erect side lobes and a triangular or oblong mid-lobe; ornamented by one to few longitudinal keels. Column with a long, U-shaped column foot, glabrous; anther incumbent, versatile, with 8 clavate waxy pollinia. Capsule erect, held on an elongate pedicel.</br></br>A genus of 11 species distributed in a broad band ranging from Sri Lanka, southern India and the Himalayas through the whole of SE Asia eastwards to New Guinea, New Caledonia and the islands of the south-western Pacific Ocean, and also ranging northwards to southern and central China and southern Japan; 3 species in Thailand.

description: Flowering shoots to 50 cm tall. Pseudobulbs ovoid-cylindric, usually with 4 nodes, c. 7 by 1–1.5 cm. Foliage leaves (1–)2–3, elliptic to oblong-elliptic, acute, 19–32 by 7–8 cm; petioles 2–16 cm long. Inflorescences: peduncles c. 10 cm long; rachis short, 3- to 6-flowered; floral bracts ovate-lanceolate, to 30 by 18 mm. Flowers white, cream-coloured or yellow with red-brown veins, labellum white and its side lobes with purple markings and a yellow mid-lobe. Sepals obtuse; dorsal sepal oblong, 18–22 by 7–11 mm; lateral sepals obliquely oblong, 24–28 by 13–17 mm, recurved at the apices, basally adnate to the column foot to form a globose mentum. Petals oblong to oblong-lanceolate, obtuse, 18–22 by 6–10 mm. Labellum 3-lobed above the claw; mid-lobe triangular, reflexed at the middle, 4–5 by 2–5 mm; side lobes hatchet-shaped, suberect, 5–8 by 5–9 mm; disk ornamented by 3 rounded and smooth keels, laterals pronounced and median one insignificant. Column 10–12 mm long, column foot 22–26 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) 20–32 mm long. Capsule not seen.

description: Flowering shoots 35–60 cm tall. Pseudobulbs conical to cylindric, with several nodes, 8–15(–19) by 0.7–2 cm. Foliage leaves 1–2(–3), ovate-elliptic, acute, 20–30(–59) by (4–)6–11 cm; petioles 6–15 cm long, forming a pseudostem to 12 cm long. Inflorescences 1–2, semi-dense; peduncles 7–10 cm long; sterile bracts elliptic, 1.3–3.5 cm long; rachis 5–6.5 cm long, 5- to 10-flowered; floral bracts elliptic-lanceolate, acute or acuminate, 20–35 by 10–19 mm. Flowers white, pinkish, yellowish or cream-coloured with red veins, labellum with yellow mid-lobe, column white. Sepals elliptic-lanceolate, subacute or obtuse, lower two thirds fused; dorsal sepal 18–25(–28) by 7–12 mm; lateral sepals similar but wider, basally adnate to the column foot to form a narrow spur-like mentum to 22 mm long. Petals obovate or oblong, subacute or obtuse, 17–25 by 6–10 mm. Labellum 3-lobed, 20–30 by 15–22 mm, claw about 10 by 4–5 mm; mid-lobe triangular-flabellate, 4–7 by 5–8 mm; side lobes suberect, falcate, 7–10 by 7–9 mm; disk ornamented by a single obtuse keel, sometimes 2 very inconspicuous lateral keels also present. Column 8–14 mm long, rostellum semi-circular or shortly oblong, column foot to 40 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) cream-coloured with violet lines, 28–42 mm long. Capsule ellipsoid, c. 45 by 17 mm, erect.

description: Flowering shoots 27–50 cm tall. Pseudobulbs conical to cylindric, to 15 by 2 cm. Foliage leaves 2 or 3, ovate-elliptic, acute, 25–40(–80) by 3.4–10.3 cm; petioles 5–11(–34) cm long. Inflorescences to 15 cm long, semi-dense; peduncles 3–9 cm long; rachis 1–3 cm long, 5- to 8-flowered; floral bracts elliptic-lanceolate, acute, sometimes dull purple, 24–30 by 12–21 mm. Flowers white or yellowish-white, sepals and petals with red dots distally, labellum mid-lobe yellow; flowers fragrant. Sepals elliptic-ovate, subacute, lower two thirds fused; dorsal sepal 23–28 by (10–)12–17 mm; lateral sepals 30–40 by 14–20 mm, basally adnate to the column foot  to form a globose mentum 14–15(–19) mm long. Petals obovate, subacute or obtuse, 24–29 by 10–16 mm. Labellum 3-lobed, 34–40 by 10–15 mm; mid-lobe oblong, recurved, 6–8 by 3.8–4 mm long; side lobes falcate, obtuse, suberect, 5–7 by 5–8 mm; disk ornamented by 3 or 5 erose or coarsely dentate keels. Column stout, 13–15 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) 22–50 mm long. Capsule ellipsoid, to 60 mm long, erect.

description: Epiphytic, sympodial herbs with very short rhizomes; in addition to normal roots also sometimes producing erect, debris-catching roots (“catch-roots”). Pseudobulbs usually densely clustered, ovoid, relatively short and thick, each consisting of more than one internode and bearing 2–4 leaves. Foliage leaves narrow, much longer than the pseudobulbs, sheathing at base, duplicate, glabrous, deciduous. Inflorescences erect, racemous or paniculate, arising from the base of pseudobulbs, usually with many small flowers, relatively lax. Flowers opening widely. Sepals: dorsal sepal free, lateral sepals connate for their entire length to form a synsepal behind the labellum. Petals free, spreading. Labellum adnate to the basal half of the column, forming a short, narrow tube; labellum lamina bent at right angle to the column. Column straight, hooded at the apex, with 2 slender stelids that are translucent distally; column foot absent; pollinarium composed of 4 elongate solid pollinia arranged in 2 equal pairs and attached to a linear-spathulate stipe (tegule) and a tiny viscidium; rostellum beak-like. Ovary glabrous. Fruit a capsule.</br></br>A genus of c. 6 species distributed in NE India, Myanmar, Yunnan, Indo-China, Malaysia, Indonesia, Philippines, Papua New Guinea, Australia and the SW Pacific islands; 3 species in Thailand.

description: Pseudobulbs ovoid or conical, covered with sheaths, 1.5–2.2 by 0.8–1.2 cm, with some erect white catch-roots in between. Foliage leaves 2(–4?) per pseudobulb, linear to elliptic-oblong, acute, thin-textured, glabrous, 7–10 by 0.4–0.8 cm. Inflorescences paniculate, lax, many-flowered, glabrous; peduncle (4.5–)8–10 cm long; main rachis 8–14 cm long; lateral branches 7–14 cm long; bracts triangular, minute, 1–2 mm long, glabrous. Flowers opening a few at a time; pedicel (including ovary) 6.5–9 mm long. Sepals glabrous, yellowish-green with small purplish dots, oblong, rounded, margin slightly involute; dorsal sepal boat-shaped, 4.3–5 by 1.2–1.5 mm; synsepal boat-shaped, 4.2–5 by 1.2–1.5 mm. Petals spreading, glabrous, yellowish-green with a few small purplish dots, obovate to shortly spathulate, slightly oblique, rounded, 4–4.1 by 1.9–2.5 mm. Labellum oblong to broadly ovate or somewhat fiddle-shaped, obtuse to rounded, margin often wavy, whitish or greenish with a few small purplish dots, 3.8–4.5 by 1.7–2 mm; 2 distinct parallel diskoid calli at the centre of the labellum. Column glabrous, 3.3–4 mm long, greenish, often becoming purplish towards the apex, hood pale purplish to whitish; stelids blunt, greenish or purplish, c. 1 mm long. Capsule not seen.

description: Pseudobulbs obclavate to obovoid, longitudinally furrrowed, 1.5–4 by 0.8–2 cm with erect white catch-roots in between. Foliage leaves 2(–3) per pseudobulb, linear-oblong, acute, gradually narrowed towards base, thin-textured, glabrous, 5.4–23.5 by 0.4–1 cm. Inflorescences racemose (less often paniculate), lax, many-flowered, glabrous; peduncle 18–25.5 cm long; (main) rachis 8.5–17 cm long; lateral branches (if present) 13–21 cm long; bracts triangular, minute, c. 1 mm long, glabrous. Flowers: pedicel (including ovary) 3–7 mm long. Sepals glabrous, greenish yellow with purplish mid-line, (linear-)oblong to oblong-ovate, rounded to subacute, margin slightly involute; dorsal sepal boat-shaped, 4.3–7.1 by 1.6–2.2 mm; synsepal boat-shaped, 4–7.2 by 2.1–3 mm. Petals spreading, glabrous, whitish to greenish-yellow with purplish mid-line, oblong, more or less oblique, rounded, 4–6.1 by 1.8–2.3 mm. Labellum 3-lobed, lateral lobes much broader than mid-lobe, whitish with purple patches on the centre of lateral lobes and mid lobe; side lobes semi-circular to obliquely ovate-triangular, rounded to subtruncate, margins  slightly wavy, 1.2–2.1 by 1.9–2.2 mm; mid-lobe oblong to oblanceolate, rounded to obtuse or retuse, 1.9–2.6 by 1–1.2 mm, margins straight to irregulary wavy; 2 prominent parallel discoid calli at the base of mid-lobe. Column glabrous, 3–5.3 mm long, purple, hood whitish to pale purplish; stelids blunt, whitish or greenish yellow, translucent at apex, 1–1.6 mm long. Capsule ellipsoid to subspherical, 8–11.2 mm long, 6–9 mm in diameter.

description: Pseudobulbs ellipsoid to fusiform, slightly furrowed, covered with sheaths, 1.5–3.5 by 0.6–1.1 cm; without erect catch-roots. Foliage leaves 1–2 per pseudobulb, linear, acute to obtuse, thin-textured, glabrous, 4.5–15 by 0.3–0.6 cm. Inflorescences racemose, lax, 12- to many-flowered, glabrous; peduncle 10.4–22 cm long; rachis 8–19.5 cm long; bracts triangular, minute, c. 1 mm long, glabrous. Flowers: pedicel (including ovary) 5–10 mm long. Sepals glabrous, pale yellowish-green with purple markings, oblong, acute to rounded, margin slightly involute; dorsal sepal boat-shaped, 6.7–8 by 2.2–2.4 mm; synsepal boat-shaped, 6.8–8 by 2.2–2.6 mm. Petals spreading, glabrous, pale yellow with purple markings, obovate, slightly oblique, rounded, 4.8–6.6 by 3.1–3.2 mm. Labellum 3-lobed, white with pink calli; side lobes obliquely oblong, rounded to subtruncate, 1.4–1.6 by 1–1.5 mm, margins slightly wavy, spreading; mid-lobe broadly spathulate, 2.5–2.9 by 2.5–2.6 mm, rounded, sometimes retuse, margins irregularly wavy; proximal part of labellum with a median keel that splits to form 2 parallel diskoid calli on claw of mid-lobe. Column glabrous, dark purple proximally, white distally, 3.5–4.5 mm long, hooded; stelids blunt, dark purple with translucently greenish-yellow apices, swollen at apex, 1.8–2 mm long. Capsule not seen.

description: Terrestrial or sometimes lithophytic herbs with corms borne shallowly underground, glabrous. Foliage leaves mostly 2 or 3, plicate, narrowly lanceolate, deciduous. Inflorescences erect, racemose, lax, unbranched or less commonly branched, arising from the base of the leafy shoot; peduncles with several sheathing sterile bracts; rachis few-flowered; floral bracts persistent. Flowers medium-sized, non-resupinate, base gibbous; perianth lobes forming a slightly downwards deflexed tube. Sepals connate in the lower two thirds, apices free and spreading to somewhat recurved. Petals connate at their very base and free above, elongate, spathulate. Labellum basally united with the column, spurless, narrow in the lower part, apical part expanded and 3-lobed, without prominent ornaments. Column elongate, apex dilated and geniculately incurved through 90 degrees, without column foot, apically obscurely winged; anther incumbent, versatile, with 4 rather soft pollinia; stipe absent.</br></br>A monotypic genus distributed from the eastern Himalayas and north-eastern India to Myanmar, Thailand, Indo-China and China.

description: Flowering shoots 14–40(–50) cm tall. Underground corms globose, 0.7–1.5(–2.2) by 0.7–1.5(–2.3) cm. Foliage leaves 2–3(–5), present or absent during flowering, linear-lanceolate, acute, 14–35(–48) by 0.3–1.3(–3.5) cm; petioles (5–)7–13(–16) cm long, forming a pseudostem 5–11(–18) cm long. Inflorescences lax; peduncles brown or purple, 11–25(–35) cm long; sterile  bracts 3–6, tubular, lanceolate-oblong, acute or acuminate, usually 0.4–2.5 cm long; rachis 3–15  cm long, (2–)5‒20-flowered; floral bracts ovate-lanceolate, acuminate, green or pale maroon, (2–)3.5–5.5 by 0.8–2 mm. Flowers violet, pink or white, column light purple, white or cream-coloured, anther yellow. Sepals elliptic-ovate, subacute, fused into a tube 5–9 by 0.9–1.8(–2) mm; dorsal sepal 13–18 by 2–3(–4) mm; lateral sepals 12–15 by 3.8–5.6 mm. Petals spathulate, obtuse or acute, 11–17 by 1.5–3 mm. Labellum 3-lobed, (9–)10–16 by 8–12 mm; mid-lobe obtusely triangular or flabellate, 1.2–4 by 1.5–3.8(–4) mm; side lobes oblong or flabellate,  obtuse, suberect, 1.2–2.5 by (1.5–)2–4 mm. Column 11–15 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) green or dull purple, 10–26 mm long. Capsule c. 18 by 4 mm.

description: Terrestrial, mycoheterotrophic herbs with underground, sparsely to densely rooted, often flexuous rhizomes and erect flowering shoots. Stem slender to robust, (purplish-)brown to pale yellowish. Leaves alternate, reduced to brownish scales that are sheathing (below) to non-sheathing (above). Rhizome condensed, producing fibrous roots. Inflorescence terminal, racemose, bearing 3 to many resupinate flowers. Sepals and petals free, subsimilar or sepals distinctly larger than petals. Labellum differentiated into hypochile and epichile; hypochile firmly attached to column, flat to concave (but never saccate or spurred), with or without distinct side lobes; epichile elastically attached, devoid of longitudinal keels, often more or less papillose on the ventral surface. Column slender, (sub)clavate, more or less incurved, glabrous, without stelids and foot; pollinia 2, soft and mealy, devoid of caudicles; rostellum slightly protruding, stipe absent, viscidium absent or obscure; receptive part of stigma concave. Ovary distinctly pedicelled; pedicel not elongating during fruit ripening. Fruit a pedicelled capsule dehiscing by longitudinal slits.</br></br>A genus of c. 25 species distributed throughout Indo-Malesia to Japan and northern Queensland; 4 species in Thailand.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Flowering shoots (62–)103–170 cm tall; stem, (2–)3–9 mm in diameter just below rachis, bearing 10–21 scale-like leaves. Rachis (8–)25–83 cm long, (10-flowered to) many-flowered, (sub)glabrous; floral bracts linear-lanceolate to narrowly linear-triangular, acuminate, 23–55 by 1.5–7 mm. Flowers opening widely, mainly pale yellow (sepals with purple veins; labellum orange, often suffused with brown or purple). Sepals sparsely scurfy-pubescent on the dorsal side; dorsal sepal narrowly lanceolate, caudate, 27.3–40 by 4.9–8 mm; lateral sepals obliquely linear-lanceolate, caudate, 34.2–48 by 3.7–7.2 mm. Petals obliquely to falcately linear-(ob)lanceolate, caudate, 19.2–28 by 3–5.5 mm. Labellum 15.1–19.3 mm long; hypochile with well developed, erect, obliquely oblong, rounded to truncate side lobes, 2.4–3.6 by 7.2–13 mm when flattened; epichile 4.6–7.3 mm wide when flattened, porrect (continuing the line of the hypochile), often recurved in its proximal part, more or less fiddle-shaped with erect to inrolled margins, subacuminate, densely papillose on the ventral surface (except for the erect margins proximally). Column somewhat incurved, 14–15.3 mm long (to apex of anther); anther broadly obovate in upper view, 2.4–2.5 mm long, apex rounded to obtuse; rostellum semicircular; receptive part of stigma triangular-trapezoid. Ovary (including pedicel) 2–4.9 cm long, sparsely scurfy-pubescent to subglabrous. Capsule pendent, (ellipsoid-)oblongoid, 3.5–5 cm long (excluding perianth remnants and pedicel), 0.8–1.7 cm in diameter, dehiscing by longitudinal slits; fruit pedicel 10–16 mm long.

description: Flowering shoots 60–110 cm tall; stem 3–6.5 mm in diameter just below rachis, bearing c. 10 scale-like leaves. Rachis 26–52 cm long, many-flowered, glabrous; floral bracts linear lanceolate to narrowly linear-triangular, acuminate, 20–41 by 2–5.1 mm. Flowers opening widely, mainly whitish (sepals and petals with purple veins; column pale yellowish-green). Sepals sparsely scurfy-pubescent on the dorsal side; dorsal sepal lanceolate, caudate, 29.5–33.2 by 6.3–6.4 mm; lateral sepals obliquely lanceolate, caudate, 30.6–35.3 by 6.1–6.5 mm. Petals linear-lanceolate, slightly oblique, caudate, 21.9–24 by 4.4–4.5 mm. Labellum 19.8–20.7 mm long; hypochile with raised (but low) margins, 5–5.1 by c. 2.9 mm when flattened; epichile 11.3–12.1 mm wide when flattened, suberect (describing an obtuse angle to the hypochile), slightly recurved, from a broadly flabellate, concave, glabrous base abruptly prolonged in an  approximately half as wide, linear-triangular, acute to acuminate, somewhat fleshy distal part that is densely papillose on the ventral surface. Column strongly incurved, 10.5–11 mm long (to apex of anther); anther ovoid-triangular in upper view, 3.8–3.9 mm long, apex drawn out in a horn-like projection; rostellum transversely rectangular to broadly trapezoid; receptive part of stigma semicircular. Ovary (including pedicel) 1.2–1.9 cm long, scarcely scurfy-pubescent to subglabrous. Capsule not seen.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert
bibliographicCitation: Aphyllorchis evrardii . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 2, 2014. Pg. 321. Accessed 2022-04-21

description: Flowering shoots 24–115 cm tall; stem 1–4 mm in diameter just below rachis, bearing 4–24 scale-like leaves. Rachis 9–45 cm long, 7- to many-flowered, subglabrous to sparsely papillose-pubescent; floral bracts (linear-)lanceolate, obtuse to acute, 5–17 by 1–3 mm. Flowers opening widely, mainly pale yellow (sepals and petals often with purple veins; labellum often with maroon markings). Sepals sparsely scurfy-pubescent on the dorsal side; dorsal sepal strongly boat-shaped, elliptic, rounded to obtuse, 11.4–11.8 by 4.9–5.1 mm; lateral sepals boat-shaped, obliquely (elliptic-)oblong, obtuse, 10.4–11.2 by 4.2–4.5 mm. Petals falcately linear-oblong with recurved margins, rounded to obtuse, 9.9–10.2 by 3.2–3.5 mm. Labellum 9.2–9.5 mm long; hypochile with well-developed, erect, obliquely triangular, obtuse to acute side lobes, 2–2.4 by 4.8–5.3 mm when flattened; epichile 5.3–5.6 mm wide when flattened, porrect (continuing the line of the hypochile), ovate to shallowly 3-lobed at the middle, rounded, proximal part with erect sides, distal part flat with incurved margins, entire ventral surface glabrous and smooth. Column somewhat incurved, 10.1–10.6 mm long (to apex of anther); anther ovate in upper view, 2.2–2.3 mm long, apex abruptly obtuse; rostellum semicircular; receptive part of stigma trapezoid. Ovary (including pedicel) 1.5–2.9(–4) cm long, (sub)glabrous. Capsule pendent (to spreading), ellipsoid to fusiform, 1.7–3.6 cm long (excluding perianth remnants and pedicel), 0.4–0.9 cm in diameter; fruit pedicel 3–6 mm long.

description: Flowering shoots 14–30 cm tall; stem 0.5–1 mm in diameter just below rachis, bearing 3–10 scale-like leaves. Rachis 1.4–9 cm long, 3- to many-flowered, sparsely glandular-pubescent; floral bracts ovate-lanceolate to elliptic, obtuse to acuminate, mucronate, 2.9–5.4 by 1.6–2.3 mm. Flowers not opening widely, mainly (brownish-)white to cream (sepals often with purple markings; labellum usually white, sometimes with purple margins). Sepals subglabrous; dorsal sepal boat-shaped, lanceolate-oblong, obtuse, 4.2–4.7 by 1.8–2 mm; lateral sepals weakly boat-shaped, obliquely lanceolate-oblong, obtuse to rounded, keeled at apex, 3.5–4.3 by 1.7–1.8 mm. Petals slightly spreading, falcately lanceolate-oblong, subacuminate, 3.2–4.4 by 1.2–1.7 mm. Labellum 2.8–3.2 mm long; hypochile with well-developed, erect, obliquely linear-triangular, rounded to obtuse side lobes, 0.8–1.1 by 2.6–2.8 mm when flattened; epichile 2.6–2.9 mm wide when flattened, porrect (continuing the line of the hypochile), cordate with raised sides and rounded, often slightly hooded apex, entire ventral surface glabrous and smooth. Column slightly incurved, 2.3–2.4 mm long (to apex of anther); anther cordate in upper view, 0.8–1 mm long, apex rounded; rostellum broadly triangular; receptive part of stigma crescent-shaped. Ovary (including pedicel) 5.8–8 mm long, somewhat scurfy-pubescent. Capsule nodding to pendent, fusiform-terete, 0.9–1.1 cm long (excluding perianth remnants and pedicel), c. 0.2 cm in diameter; fruit pedicel 2–3 mm long.

description: Terrestrial, sometimes rheophytic herbs. Rhizome stout, producing many, densely aggregated flowering shoots. Stem erect, wiry to reed-like, covered by leaf sheaths, often swollen at base. Foliage leaves 6 to many, (sub)distichous, decreasing in size towards the proximal and distal part of the shoot, persistent, green, conduplicate, narrowly linear to linear lanceolate, herbaceous. Inflorescence terminal, racemose or paniculate, elongating gradually during flowering; floral bracts persistent, amplexicaul, much shorter than ovaries. Flowers opening in succession, resupinate, usually pinkish-white with the labellum being violet to magenta (especially towards apex) with a yellow blotch in its central part (but pale as well as very strongly coloured forms occur). Sepals free; lateral sepals more or less connivent behind labellum. Petals spreading, wider than sepals. Labellum trumpet-shaped, 3-lobed, not spurred or saccate; side lobes semi-obovate, rounded, enfolding column; mid-lobe emarginate to deeply cleft; disk ornamented by a few papillose-pubescent longitudinal keels. Column slender, erect, straight to somewhat incurved, dilated and narrowly winged towards apex, devoid of stelids and foot; anther terminal, incumbent; pollinia 8 in 2 groups, more or less waxy, with short caudicles and a common viscidium. Ovary (including pedicel) terete, slender. Fruit a distinctly pedicelled capsule dehiscing by longitudinal slits.</br></br>A probably monospecific genus; distribution as for A. graminifolia subsp. graminifolia (see below).
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Flowering shoots slender, (10–)35–50 cm tall; stem grass-like, unbranched, (2–)3–4 mm in diameter in its central part. Leaves 6 to many, narrowly linear, acute to acuminate, usually with revolute margins; largest leaf lamina 8–15.8(–23.2) by 0.4–0.5(–0.6) cm. Inflorescence racemose (rarely paniculate), 2- to many-flowered (rarely 1-flowered); peduncle bearing a single sheathing bract-like leaf; (main) rachis 1.4–9 cm long; floral bracts acute to acuminate, mucronate, 4–8 mm long. Flowers opening 1 at a time. Sepals: dorsal sepal oblanceolate, acute, (18–)20–24(–28) by 4–7 mm; lateral sepals falcately lanceolate, (sub)acuminate, 17–27 by 4–8 mm. Petals elliptic, acute to acuminate, 19–30 by (6–)7–9(–10) mm. Labellum 19–28 mm long; mid-lobe somewhat recurved, subquadrate, more or less emarginate, margins slightly irregular. Column more or less incurved, 12–16 mm long; receptive part of stigma transversely oblong. Ovary (including pedicel) c. 14 mm long. description: Terrestrial, rhizomatous herbs; rhizome irregularly shaped, rooting at nodes with many long fibrous roots. Flowering shoots terminal, erect. Foliage leaves 2–5, often erect, glabrous, plicate, narrowly oblong to narrowly lanceolate, sheathing at the base. Inflorescence racemose, terminal, erect; peduncle terete, with a few sterile bracts; rachis short, terete, simple or occasionally branched; floral bracts lanceolate, caducous. Flowers 2–3, resupinate, often showy, white, pink, purple, or yellow, glabrous; pedicel and ovary slender. Sepals free. Petals free, similar to sepals but slightly larger. Labellum firmly attached, not fused with column, often 3-lobed, porrect, without spur, often ornamented by longitudinal keels, lateral lobes erect and clasping the column. Column arcuate, clavate, winged, glabrous, without column foot; anther incumbent, 2-locular; pollinia 8 in 2 groups of 4, granular, oblong and laterally compressed, caudicles inconspicuous; stigma suborbicular to transversely elliptic; rostellum truncate, projecting forward over the stigma, not producing a viscidium. Ovary terete, glabrous. Fruit a capsule, oblong-fusiform, erect.</br></br>A genus of c. 5 species distributed from northern Myanmar, Indo-China and China to Japan; 1 species in Thailand.

description: Flowering shoots 10–20 cm tall; rhizome ovoid to globose, 1–1.8 cm in diameter. Foliage leaves 2–4, elliptic-lanceolate, 5–10 by 0.8–3 cm, apex acute to acuminate. Inflorescence glabrous; peduncle 5–12 cm long, slender; rachis simple, flexuous, 1–2 cm long; floral bracts oblong-lanceolate, 5–6 mm long, apex acute, often caducous. Flowers 1–3, suberect, pale purple; pedicel and ovary twisted, 0.7–1 cm long. Sepals white, tinged with purple especially at the apices, oblong-lanceolate, 10–12 by 2.5–3 mm, apex acute. Petals white, tinged with purple especially at the apices, lanceolate, 10–12 by 2.5–3.5 mm, apex acute. Labellum white with small purplish spots and purple apex, narrowly obovate, 10–13 by 5–6 mm, apex almost unlobed or obscurely 3-lobed, margin irregularly serrulate; disk with 3 longitudinal fimbriate keels. Column c. 1 cm long, dilated towards apex; rostellum large. Capsule oblong, erect.

description: Terrestrial, ephiphytic or lithophytic, more or less woody plants. Rhizome creeping, short to somewhat elongated. Stems simple, flexible to stiff, terete to laterally compressed, not swollen. Foliage leaves distichous, articulate, glabrous, herbaceous to hard-coriaceous, duplicate or bilaterally flattened. Inflorescence terminal, racemose, accrescent, usually simple, few- to many-flowered; rachis pubescent or mealy-hairy; bracts persistent, imbricate or very nearly so. Flowers resupinate, opening in succession or very few open at the same time, very short-lived. Sepals free, elliptic or oblong to linear-lanceolate, glabrous; lateral sepals slightly falcate. Petals free, elliptic or oblong to lanceolate, usually thinner than the sepals, glabrous. Labellum concave, 3-lobed; disk glabrous or with scattered hairs; side lobes often densely hairy or papillose; mid-lobe suborbicular to lingulate, more or less recurved, usually ornamented by a papillose or hairy elongate callus. Column long and slender, slightly incurved, with narrow lateral wings, but without foot; anther bilocular; pollinia 2, solid, more or less waxy, porate,  triangular-ovoid to ovate; viscidium large, semi-dome-shaped; stigma cup-shaped, with a pair of  triangular to suborbicular lateral flaps. Ovary slender. Fruit a cylindrical capsule, dehiscing by 6 longitudinal slits.</br></br>A genus of c. 27 species, distributed in Sri Lanka, Myanmar, Indo-China, Thailand,  Peninsular Malaysia, Borneo, Sumatra, Java, the Philippines, Maluku, New Guinea and Queensland; 5 species in Thailand.

description: Epiphytic or lithophytic, to 50 cm tall, often forming a large clump. Rhizome short, creeping, 3–5 mm in diameter. Stems flattened, internodes 1–4 cm long, basal part with 3–5 sheathing cataphylls. Foliage leaves 5–10, dorsoventrally flattened, sheathing at base; sheaths slightly longer than internodes; lamina narrowly oblong, 8–14 by 0.8–1.3 cm, coriaceous, apex deeply emarginate or unequally bilobed. Inflorescences to 12 cm long, rarely branched; floral bracts laterally compressed, regularly overlapping and clasping the rachis, boat-shaped, 5–10 mm long, glabrous. Flowers (creamy) white or yellowish, 1–2 open at the same time. Sepals oblong or oblong-oblanceolate, slightly concave, apex acute; dorsal sepal c. 20 by 6 mm; lateral sepals slightly falcate, c. 20 by 8 mm. Petals oblanceolate, slightly falcate, c. 20 by 5 mm, apex acute. Labellum obovate in overall outline when flattened, c. 18 by 10 mm, white or creamy; disk with a yellowish-green median papillose band extending to the base; side lobes large, front edges ciliate; mid-lobe suborbicular to ovate, 4–6 by 3.5–5 mm, central callus thick, margin ciliate, apex mucronate. Column 13‒15 mm long, glabrous, winged at the top; anther obcordate, c. 1 by 2‒2.5 mm; pollinia triangular-ovoid, c. 1.5 mm long; viscidium broad, winged, c. 1 by 2 mm. Ovary (including pedicel) 1.2–1.8 cm long, glabrous. Fruit c. 4.5 by 0.9 cm.

description: Epiphytic, to 15 cm high. Rhizome short, creeping, 1.5‒3.5 mm in diameter. Stems tufted; internodes 0.3‒1.2 cm long; basal part with 2–4 sheathing cataphylls. Foliage leaves 3‒7, bilaterally flattened, at acute angles to the stem; sheaths slightly longer than internodes; laminas hard-coriaceous, linear-lanceolate to linear, slightly recurved or sometimes strongly curved, 2.5‒7 by 0.4‒0.6 cm, apex acute. Inflorescences very short, c. 1.5 cm long, usually unbranched; floral bracts closely overlapping and clasping the rachis, boat-shaped, ovate when flattened, 4‒6 mm long, glabrous. Sepals oblong to lanceolate, slightly concave, apex acute-acuminate; dorsal sepal 17‒18 by 4‒4.5 mm; lateral sepals slightly falcate, 16‒20 by 4.5‒5.5 mm. Petals elliptic to oblong-lanceolate, 16‒18 by 4.5‒6.5 mm, apex acute-acuminate. Labellum ovate to elliptic in overall outline when flattened, 15‒18 by 10‒12 mm; disk with scattered hairs and a median band extending to the base; side lobes distinct; mid-lobe obovate to orbicular, 6‒7 by 5‒6 mm, central part ornamented by a warty yellow callus, papillose, apex obtuse to apiculate, slightly recurved, margin crenulate-undulate. description: Epiphytic, to 20 cm high. Rhizome short, creeping, 2‒3.5 mm in diameter. Sepals oblong to lanceolate, slightly concave, apex acute; dorsal sepal 11‒14 by 4‒4.5 mm; lateral sepals slightly falcate, 11‒13.5 by 4‒4.5 mm. description: Terrestrial or occasionally lithophytic, to 2 m high. Rhizome subterranean, 5–10 mm in diameter. Stems terete, 5‒9 mm in diameter, erect; internodes 1.5‒9 cm long, basal part with 3–5 sheathing cataphylls. Foliage leaves 4‒15 (and distally 3‒8 reduced to sheaths), dorsoventrally flattened, sheathing at base; sheaths usually shorter than internodes; laminas oblong or lanceolate-oblong, 3‒17 by 1‒4 cm, coriaceous, apex emarginate or unequally bilobed. Inflorescences usually erect, often branched, to 50 cm long; bracts laterally compressed, regularly overlapping and clasping the rachis, boat-shaped, 3–7 mm long, glabrous. Flowers (creamy) white, tinged with purple, 1–2 open at the same time. Sepals oblong-lanceolate, slightly hooded, apex acute to acuminate; dorsal sepal 35‒40 by 9‒10 mm; lateral sepals slightly falcate, 33‒38 by 9‒10 mm. description: Epiphytic, to 20 cm high. Rhizome short, creeping, 1.5‒3.5 mm in diameter. Stems tufted; internodes 0.2‒1.5 cm long. description: Terrestrial, lithophytic or rarely epiphytic herbs with pseudobulbous stems, deciduous or evergreen. Flowering shoots 12‒80(‒150) cm tall. Pseudobulbs ovoid, conical or cylindric, either insignificant and hidden by the bases of the foliage leaves or large and swollen, close together or rarely spaced on a creeping rhizome. Foliage leaves few, plicate, present or rarely absent during flowering, almost always uniformly green, petiolate, glabrous or hairy; lamina lanceolate, cuneate at base. Inflorescences unbranched, arising from a basal leaf axil, glabrous or pubescent, few- to many-flowered; floral bracts glabrous or hairy, persistent or caducous. Flowers medium-sized or large, resupinate; mostly with white, pink and yellow colours, often turning dark blue through damage or with age. Sepals free, often hairy (particularly on the outside). Petals similar but almost always glabrous. Labellum entire, 2- or 3-lobed, mid-lobe often bilobulate, labellum base most commonly extensively fused with the sides of the column, disk variously ornamented, sometimes clawed, almost always with saccate or elongate, glabrous or pubescent spur. Column glabrous or rarely hairy; anther versatile and incumbent, with 8 waxy clavate pollinia; rostellum beaked or bifid, with one viscidium; stigma in a cavity below the rostellum. Ovary often hairy, mostly indistinguishable from the pedicel.</br></br>Calanthe is a large genus of 207 species which are mainly found in Asia, northern  Australia and the Pacific Ocean Islands, with several occurring in Africa and Madagascar and  one in central America; 23 species in Thailand.

description: Flowering shoots glabrous, to 75 cm tall. Pseudobulbs insignificant, hidden by the bases of the foliage leaves. Foliage leaves 3‒4, lanceolate, acute, perennial, to 90 by 4‒9 cm; petioles to 18 cm long. Inflorescences semi-dense or lax; peduncles to 20 cm long; sterile bracts few, lanceolate-oblong, acute; rachis 13‒20 cm long, several- to many-flowered; floral bracts caducous, not seen. Flowers white or creamy white, labellum partly yellow. Sepals ovate-elliptic, shortly aristate-acuminate, 5-veined, to 15 by 4‒5 mm. Petals elliptic-ovate, acute, to 12 by 4‒5.5 mm. Labellum 3-lobed, spurred, free portion to 11 mm long, base extensively fused with the sides of the column; mid-lobe elliptic-reniform, apically retuse or slightly cleft, 5–7 mm wide; side lobes oval or rounded-square, to 2 by 3 mm; ornaments of broadly laminate semi-ovate ridges; spur clavate, straight or slightly curved, shorter than the pedicel plus the ovary, 9–10 mm long. Column 4–5 mm long; rostellum with a slender beak. Ovary 4‒7 mm long, weakly differentiated from the 7–11 mm long pedicel. Capsule not seen. description: Flowering shoots glabrous, spaced on a creeping rhizome, to 30 cm tall. Pseudobulbs insignificant, hidden by the bases of the foliage leaves. Foliage leaves 3–6, linear-lanceolate, acute or acuminate, perennial, 18–50 by 1–3.75 cm; petioles to 14 cm long. Inflorescences semi dense or lax; peduncle 15–23 cm long; sterile bracts 3–6, lanceolate-oblong, acute, to 2.5 cm long; rachis 5–7.5 cm long, to 25-flowered; floral bracts caducous, c. 40 mm long. Flowers white, labellum partly or entirely yellow, ornaments yellow. Sepals ovate-elliptic, acute or acuminate, 10–13 by 5–7 mm. Petals similar but shorter and broader, acute, 9.5–11 by 5.5–8 mm. Labellum 3-lobed, base extensively fused with the sides of the column, to 12.5 by 7–8 mm; mid-lobe obovate, apically cleft, 5–5.5 by 6.7–8 mm; side lobes oval or square, erect, 1.9–2.2 by 1.5–2.3 mm; ornaments in the form of 2 short keels at the base of the free labellum portion; spur 8–10 mm long, clavate. description: Flowering shoots 40–70 cm tall. Pseudobulbs insignificant, hidden by the bases of the foliage leaves, cylindric, 4–12 cm long. Foliage leaves 3–4, elliptic, acute or acuminate, perennial, glabrous, 12–40 by 4.6–10.3 cm; petioles to 15 cm long. Inflorescences lax, shortly pubescent; peduncle 20–35(–48) cm long; sterile bracts 3–4, lanceolate, acuminate, to 3.5 cm long; rachis 11–22 cm long, few- to many-flowered; floral bracts lanceolate, acuminate, persistent, to 20 by 1–3 mm. Flowers 20–35 mm in diameter; red to brown with yellow or violet spots, labellum pale violet, spur pink. Sepals oblong-elliptic, acuminate, pubescent on the outside, glabrous or sometimes puberulous on the inside, 15–18 by 5–9 mm. Petals oblong-lanceolate, clawed, acuminate, 15–16 by 3–6 mm. Labellum ovate to reniform, apically emarginate and therefore somewhat bilobed, base fused with the column foot, clawed, 19–25 by 20–26 mm; ornaments of 2 prominent or obscure keels in the centre of the labellum blade; spur conical, 2–4 mm long. Column 5–7 mm long, glabrous, with a prominent foot. Ovary (including pedicel) pubescent, 20–25 mm long. Capsule ellipsoid, c. 30 by 15 mm.

description: Flowering shoots (19–)30–68 cm tall. Pseudobulbs prominent, ovoid, 2.5–8.5 by 1.5–3 cm. Foliage leaves (1–)2–4, lanceolate-oblong, acute or acuminate, annual, glabrous, (15–)22–47 by 4–7 cm; petioles 3–6(–9) cm long. description: Flowering shoots glabrous, 28–80 cm tall. Pseudobulbs insignificant, hidden by the bases of the foliage leaves, spaced on an elongate rhizome. Foliage leaves 2–3, lanceolate-oblong, acute, perennial, 23–90 by 3.4–9.5 cm; petioles 13–20 cm long. Inflorescences arising directly from the rhizome next to the leafy shoot, raceme dense or semi-dense, cylindric; peduncles 21–30 cm long; sterile bracts 4–8, lanceolate-oblong, acute, tubular and inflated, 2.8–6 cm long; rachis 10.5–14 cm long, many-flowered; floral bracts lanceolate, acuminate, caducous, 30–50 by 3–8 mm. Flowers to 20 mm in diameter; yellow. Sepals ovate-elliptic, acuminate; dorsal sepal 9–14 by 4–6.7 mm; lateral sepals 10–15 by 4–6 mm. Labellum 3-lobed, base fused with lower half or two thirds of the column, 8–13.5 mm long; mid-lobe rectangular, emarginate, 3–5 by 3.5–5 mm; side lobes semi circular, 2–3 by 2–3 mm; ornaments of 2 short lamellate keels between the side lobes; spur clavate, apically slightly bifid or entire, 8–10 mm long. description: Flowering shoots glabrous, 40–60 cm tall. Pseudobulbs insignificant, hidden by the bases of the foliage leaves, spaced on an elongate rhizome. Foliage leaves 2–4(–5), elliptic, acuminate, perennial, (18–)30–40 by 2–6 cm; petioles to 22 cm long. Inflorescences arising directly from the rhizome next to the leafy shoot, densely globose to subcylindric; peduncles 9–18 cm long; sterile bracts (1–)2–5, ovate-lanceolate, acute, tubular, inflated, 1.8–3.7 cm long; rachis 1–3(–5) cm long, 12- to 25-flowered; floral bracts elliptic-lanceolate, acuminate, caducous, white, 10–20(–40) by 7–8(–20) mm. description: Flowering shoots 43–76(–125) cm tall. Pseudobulbs prominent, ovoid, 7–10 by 2–2.5 cm. Foliage leaves 1–4, lanceolate-elliptic, acuminate, annual, glabrous, 28–45 by (4–)7.6–12 cm; petioles 4–5 cm long. Inflorescences lax, nodding, softly pubescent; peduncles 27–52(– 85) cm long; sterile bracts 3–7, lanceolate-oblong, acuminate or acute, 2.1–4.7 cm long; rachis 16–30(–40) cm long, 5- to 15-flowered; floral bracts ovate-lanceolate, acuminate, persistent, 16–30 by 5–12 mm. Flowers to 55 mm in diameter, white or cream-coloured, base of the free labellum portion often with yellow or red blotch. Sepals ovate-elliptic, acuminate, pubescent on the outside; dorsal sepal 20–30 by 7–12 mm; lateral sepals 21–30 by 7–9.3 mm. Petals ovate-elliptic, obtuse, apiculate, 22–27 by 9–11 mm. Labellum 3-lobed, base extensively fused with the sides of the column, base pubescent, 24–32 by 19–36 mm; mid-lobe bilobulate, 10–14 by 17–24 mm; side lobes ovate-oblong, obtuse, spreading, 9–15 by 8–12 mm; ornaments of 3 longitudinal keels; spur cylindric, pubescent, strongly curved forwards, 20–30 mm long. Column glabrous or pubescent, 10–12 mm long; rostellum bilobed. Ovary (including pedicel) pubescent, 35–54 mm long. Capsule not seen.

description: Terrestrial herbs with condensed underground rhizomes and fibrous roots; sometimes mycoheterotrophic (including all species found in tropical Asia south and south-east of the Himalayas and Himalayan foothills). Foliage leaves alternate, well-developed to vestigial. Inflorescence racemose, 1- to many-flowered. Flowers erect to spreading, resupinate, not always opening fully. Sepals and petals free. Labellum firmly attached, differentiated into hypochile and epichile, both usually ornamented by longitudinal ridges or keels; hypochile more or less  saccate; epichile more or less recurved. Column elongate, glabrous, without a column foot; anther dorsal, elongated, versatile; pollinia 2, soft and mealy, partly cleft, devoid of caudicles; rostellum well-developed to strongly reduced, neither producing stipe nor viscidia; receptive part of stigma concave with protruding margins. Ovary sessile, twisted through 180°. Fruit an erect capsule, dehiscing by 6 longitudinal slits.</br></br>A genus of c. 15 species distributed from Europe and Mediterranean North Africa to southern and eastern Asia, with a single species in western North America; 1 species in Thailand.

description: Plant mycohetrotrophic with a few, unbranched, slenderly fusiform roots. Flowering shoot 3–14 cm tall; vegetative parts white (sometimes with a faint greenish tinge in backlight). Foliage leaves 1–2, sheathing; lamina strongly reduced, boat-shaped, (ovate-)triangular, acute to obtuse, 0.3–0.9 by 0.2–0.6 cm. Inflorescence 0.9–4 cm long, 1- to 4-flowered (rarely 5-flowered), often somewhat secund; floral bracts narrowly lanceolate-oblong, acute, 12–13.9 by 3–4.2 mm. Flowers suberect (to spreading), white with pale brown markings on the labellum. Sepals somewhat spreading, glabrous and smooth; dorsal sepal lanceolate, subacuminate, 11–21 by 3.9–5.7 mm; lateral sepals lanceolate, slightly oblique, somewhat channelled towards the apex, acuminate, 12–20.1 by 4.1–6.1 mm. Petals porrect, glabrous and smooth, narrowly elliptic oblong, slightly recurved distally, obtuse, 9.3–15.5 by 3.1–5.2 mm. Labellum porrect; hypochile distinctly saccate with erect, falcately triangular, obtuse to subacute side lobes and a median ruminate ridge, glabrous and smooth (except for the slightly papillose apices of the side lobes), 2.9–4.6 mm long, 9.5–14 mm across side lobes when flattened; epichile cordate with erect sides  and recurved apex, obtuse, densely papillose and ornamented by 3–5 longitudinal keels on the ventral side, 4.3–8.3 by 4.9–9.9 mm. Column semiterete, straight to slightly incurved, 8–9.6 mm long (including anther); anther obliquely ellipsoid, obtuse to subacute; pollinia strongly elongate, 2.7–2.8 mm long; rostellum well-developed, protruding below the anther. Ovary terete,  striated, 11.6–12.6 mm long.

description:
Terrestrial or lithophytic herbs with several-noded cane-like stems, subglabrous or hirsute. Foliage leaves in the upper stem part, few, perennial, plicate, elliptic-lanceolate, acuminate, their petioles forming a pseudostem. Inflorescences lax, racemose, few- to many-flowered, arising laterally on the cane-like stem, hairy; peduncles with a few tubular sterile bracts; floral bracts caducous. Flowers medium-sized, resupinate, in Thai species usually yellow or orange-yellow, often turning dark blue when old or through damage. Sepals and petals similar, spreading, free, pubescent or not. Labellum 3-lobed, almost entirely free from the column and only fused with it at the very base, spurless, with erect side lobes that are partly wrapped around the column, ornaments (if present) as two basal ridges. Column more or less hairy, anther incumbent and versatile, pollinia 8, waxy, clavate. Ovary distinct from the pedicel or not.

Five species from NE India to Maluku and northwards as far as China, Taiwan, the Philippines and S Japan; 2 species in Thailand.

Notes: a more comprehensive version of this account was published before, and also several of its illustrations have been reproduced; see “A precursory study of the Calanthe group (Orchidaceae) in Thailand”; Adansonia, sér. 3, 32: 57–107. 2010, http://dx.doi.org/10.5252/a2010n1a4

description: Flowering shoots 30–50 cm tall. Stems many-noded, 0.4–0.8 cm in diameter. Foliage leaves 5‒8, elliptic-lanceolate, subacuminate, glabrous, 7.5–20 by 2‒5 cm. Inflorescences pseudoterminal or lateral, 10‒20 cm long, lax; rachis 10- to 15-flowered; floral bracts caducous, narrowly lanceolate, long-acuminate, 15‒17 by 5‒7 mm. Flowers to 15 mm in diameter, shortly and laxly pubescent on the outside; yellow or orange-yellow. Sepals ovate-lanceolate, acute to acuminate, 6‒10 by 2.5–3.8 mm. Petals ovate-lanceolate from a broadly clawed base, acute, 5‒9 by 2‒3.3 mm. Labellum 3-lobed, to 8.5 by 7.3 mm; mid-lobe orbicular-quadrate, margin undulate, 1.5‒2 by 2‒3 mm, with a claw with entire margins; side lobes flabellate, truncate, front and sides irregularly erose, 1.5‒3.5 by 1‒2.5 mm; ornaments of 2 smooth fleshy ridges in the basal half. Column hairy on the dorsal side, 3‒3.3 mm long. Ovary pubescent, rather distinct from the pedicel, together 18‒23 mm long. Capsule not seen.

description: Flowering shoots 50–100 cm tall. Stems fusiform-cylindric, 37–55 by 0.5–1 cm. Foliage leaves 3–9, elliptic-lanceolate, acuminate, glabrous, mostly 22–47 by 3–5.7 cm, in the upper stem portion; petioles 3–11(–20) cm long; pseudostem 2–5 cm long. Inflorescences 1–2, lateral, 30–66 cm long, lax, hirsute; peduncles (15–)25–45 cm long; sterile bracts (3–)4–8, elliptic-lanceolate, acute, subglabrous or sparsely hairy, (0.6–)2.1–4.6 cm long; rachis 15- to many flowered, (5–)10–20 cm long; floral bracts caducous, lanceolate, acuminate, glabrous. Flowers 20–30 mm in diameter; yellow or orange-yellow, rarely brownish-yellow and labellum white with brown markings, once recorded as white and turning yellow with age. Sepals linear or oblong-elliptic, acute, outside hairy and inside glabrous or subglabrous, 10–19 by 3–6.8 mm. Petals obovate-lanceolate, acute, hairy or subglabrous, 10–18 by 2–4.5 mm. Labellum 3-lobed, hairy at the base, 8–15(–18) by 5–10(–14) mm; mid-lobe flabellate, deeply emarginate, margin crispate, 3.5–8 by 5–10 mm, with a claw with entire margins; side lobes falcate with forwards-pointing tips, 1.7–5 by 1–3 mm; ornaments of 2 fleshy longitudinal ridges on the disk. Column densely pubescent, 3–6 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) densely hairy, (15–)18–26 mm long. Capsule not seen.

description: Terrestrial, rarely epiphytic herbs with a creeping rhizome; vegetative parts (except floral bracts) consistently glabrous. Pseudobulbs ascending, each bearing either a single leaf or an inflorescence. Foliage leaves convolute, plicate, petiolate, long-lived; petiole channelled. Inflorescence erect, racemose, (fairly) lax, both peduncle and rachis elongating during flowering; floral bracts persistent, entire. Flowers resupinate, bilaterally symmetrical, wide-open or nearly so. Sepals and petals free, subsimilar, obtuse to acute, entire, glabrous. Labellum elastically attached, clawed, 3-lobed, spurless; claw with distinctly undulate margins; side lobes and mid-lobe entire, obtuse to retuse. Column stout to fairly slender, strongly incurved to nearly straight, the ventral side basally ornamented by 2 fleshy keels that are extended onto a spurred column foot (spur with a narrow entrance); anther subterminal, incumbent, versatile; pollinia 2, solid, devoid of caudicles; rostellum slightly protruding, neither producing stipe nor viscidia; receptive part of stigma concave. Ovary (including pedicel) fusiform-terete, curved, twisted, glabrous. Fruit a distinctly pedicelled capsule dehiscing by longitudinal slits.</br></br>A genus of 4 species distributed in most of Indo-Malesia and the south-western Pacific islands (to Fiji); 1 species in Thailand.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Pseudobulbs 4.8–5.8 cm long, 0.6–0.9 cm in diameter. Leaves: petiole 7–12.4 cm long; lamina (elliptic-)lanceolate, acuminate, 12.8–29.6 by 4.4–8.8 cm. Inflorescence 27–53(–75) cm tall, 12- to many-flowered; rachis 4.5–19 cm long; bracts (ovate-)lanceolate, acute to acuminate, 5.8–14.3 mm long, glabrous. Flowers yellowish-green with white to yellow labellum and column (sepals and petals often maroon-dotted, labellum often with purple markings). Sepals: dorsal sepal linear-lanceolate, 10.9–17.6 by 3.3–4.8 mm; lateral sepals falcately (linear-)lanceolate, 9.3–15.2 by 3–5 mm. Petals falcately (ovate-)lanceolate, 9.7–15.4 by 4.8–6 mm. Labellum abruptly recurved at the middle, glabrous, 8.5–11 mm long, 6.8–10.4 mm wide across side lobes when flattened, ornamented by a low median keel and 2 lateral (partly higher and undulate) keels, all entire and extending from (near) the labellum base onto the mid-lobe; side lobes erect, obliquely triangular to falcately oblong, 2.1–4.3 mm wide; mid-lobe boat-shaped, broadly oblong to transversely elliptic when flattened, 4–7.9 mm wide. Column 6–6.7 mm long, with the front margins forming lateral wings, each of which has an obliquely triangular to oblong or hook-like process; column foot 1.5–2.3 mm long, with a broadly conical, rounded, 0.5–1.6 mm long spur; anther ovate in upper view, acuminate in front; stigma with entire margins. Ovary (including pedicel) 6.5–12 mm long. Capsule pendent, fusiform-terete, furrowed, 21–26 mm long, 4–6 mm in diameter.

description: Sympodial herbs, initially terrestrial, but becoming scandent or epiphytic. Rhizome up to several m long, sturdy, covered with pale brown papery sheaths, rooting from the nodes, producing leafy shoots at intervals. Foliage leaves long-lived, distichous, plicate, many-veined, proximally tapering into a petiole-like sheathing base. Inflorescence terminal on a leafy shoot, racemose or paniculate with few branches, pubescent; floral bracts stiff, persistent. Flowers opening 1 or 2 in succession, fleshy, pale green and whitish, often with more or less conspicuous dark green veins in all perianth parts. Sepals free, pubescent on the dorsal side. Petals free, narrower than sepals. Labellum firmly attached, 3-lobed (to subentire). Column incurved, pubescent proximally on the ventral surface (otherwise glabrous), without a column foot; anther subterminal, incumbent, versatile; pollinia 2, solid, deeply cleft, devoid of caudicles; rostellum with thickened margins, producing a reniform viscidium, but no stipe; receptive part of stigma concave. Ovary and pedicel pubescent. Fruit a capsule dehiscing by longitudinal slits.</br></br>A genus of 2 species distributed in most of Malesia (mainly excluding Java and the Lesser Sunda Islands); 1 species in Thailand.

description: Rhizome climbing, up to 3 m long, producing leafy shoots 20 cm or more apart; flowering shoots 16–58 cm long. Foliage leaves 3–6, glabrous, (ob)lanceolate, acuminate, 12.5–39.5 by 1.9–6.3 cm. Inflorescence many-flowered; rachis of primary shoot 2.5–15 cm long; lateral branches (if present) 2.2–15 cm long; floral bracts broadly ovate-triangular to crescent-shaped, rounded to subacute, 2–2.5 mm long, pubescent on the dorsal side. Sepals more or less spreading; dorsal sepal oblong to oblanceolate, obtuse to subacuminate, 18–24 by 6–8 mm; lateral sepals obliquely to falcately (lanceolate-)oblong, subacute to short-acuminate, often mucronate, 16–20 by 7–9 mm. Petals incurved over the column, oblanceolate, rounded to acuminate, 17–21 by 4–6 mm, (sub)glabrous. Labellum recurved from a (sub)erect saccate base, 14–16 mm long, 10–21 mm wide across side lobes when flattened; side lobes erect, obtuse to rounded; mid-lobe transversely oblong to reniform, retuse to emarginate, up to 5.5 by 15 mm; disk ornamented by an oblongoid, pubescent, longitudinally grooved and proximally bifurcated callus; sac hemispherical to broadly cylindric, rounded, 2–3 mm long, 2–3 mm in diameter. Column semiterete, hooded at apex, 15–16 mm long; anther cordate in upper view, rounded in front, c. 2 mm long; rostellum saddle-shaped. Ovary (including pedicel) terete, finely longitudinally furrowed, 13–24 mm long. Capsule short-pedicelled, terete, c. 4.5 cm long, c. 0.7 cm in diameter.

description: Epiphytes or sometimes lithophytes or terrestrials. Pseudobulbs consisting of 1 internode, close together to wide apart on a creeping rhizome, much shorter than the leaves, 1- to 2-leaved, when young covered by scale leaves. Leaves 1 or 2, convolute, plicate or duplicate; petiole channelled; nerves 3–15, prominent below. Inflorescence a raceme, erect to pendulous; usually glabrous, in sect. Verrucosae with scattered minute scale-like hairs, in sect. Tomentosae subglabrous to densely tomentose; peduncle in some sections with persistent imbricate scale leaves at the base; rachis straight or zig-zag, in some sections with persistent imbricate scale leaves at its base and sometimes also at its top; floral bracts caducous or persistent. Flowers resupinate, (1–)3 to many, 0.6–13 cm across, open simultaneously or in succession. Sepals more or less concave, ovate-oblong to ovate-lanceolate, the lateral ones oblique. Petals linear to ovate lanceolate. Labellum 3-lobed; side lobes erect, usually projecting in front; epichile (mid-lobe) usually shorter than the hypochile; ornaments of longitudinal keels, median on the labellum, incised and/or undulate, broken up, papillous, warty or provided with hair-like structures; mid lobe often with additional keels. Column somewhat curved, often as long as the hypochile, footless, winged (but without stelids); wing widest in upper half. Anther subterminal, incumbent; pollinia 4, solid, each provided with a caudicle, median with a depression; rostellum prominent, not producing a stipe.</br></br>A genus of c. 200 species, distributed throughout SE Asia, Malesia and the western Pacific islands to Samoa; 35 species in Thailand.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: [Sect. Elatae Pfitzer]. Pseudobulbs 2–3 cm apart, ovoid, 5–7 by 2.5–3 cm. Leaves 2; petiole 3–5 cm; lamina lanceolate, 12–17 by 4–6 cm, acute; midrib below prominent. Inflorescence hysteranthous; peduncle to 10 cm; rachis zig-zag, 8–10 cm, its base enclosed by c. 18 persistent imbricate scale leaves, internodes 0.9–1 cm. Floral bracts caducous. Flowers 7–10, open simultaneously, 3–4 cm in diameter, fragrant, glabrous; sepals and petals creamy white; labellum white with yellow to orange markings; column yellowish cream. Dorsal sepal more or less parallel to the column, ovate-lanceolate, acute, c. 20 by 8 mm. Lateral sepals oblong, acute, c. 20 by 6 mm. Petals linear, acute, c. 19 by 1–2 mm. Labellum 3-lobed, c. 19 by 14 mm; side lobes semi-elliptic with rounded top; mid-lobe suborbicular, c. 9 by 11 mm, margins undulate, finely dentate, top broadly rounded, apex slightly retuse; ornaments of 2 keels, continuing to halfway along mid-lobe, margin straight, irregular. Column c. 12 mm, winged; apex rounded, not incised.

description: [Sect. Longifoliae Pfitzer & Kraenzl.]. Pseudobulbs 2.5–5 cm apart, ellipsoid to fusiform, 5–12.5 by 1–1.5 cm. Leaves 2, leathery; petiole 1.5–2.5 cm; lamina elliptic, 6.5–12 cm by 2–4 cm, (sub)acute; nerves 7–9. Inflorescence hysteranthous; peduncle erect, terete, 10–17 cm; rachis erect, slightly zig-zag, 5–17.5 cm, its base with 1–4 sterile scale leaves, internodes 0.7–1.4 cm. Floral bracts caducous. Flowers 4–17, open in succession, 3–4 cm in diameter, glabrous; all parts white except the keels yellow-brown. Dorsal sepal parallel to the column, oblong-lanceolate, acute, 25–30 by 6–7 mm. Lateral sepals oblong, acute, 25–30 by 6–7 mm. Petals linear, obtuse, 25–30 by 3–4 mm. Labellum 3-lobed, 25–30 by 10 mm; side lobes descending to the back, in front with rounded top, sinus c. 3 mm; mid-lobe suborbicular, c. 10 by 10 mm, margins undulate, irregular; top shallowly retuse, apex acute; ornaments of 2 short keels, from top of disk to base of or halfway along mid-lobe, margin slightly irregular. Column 17–21 mm, winged; apex rounded.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert
bibliographicCitation: Coelogyne anceps . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 2, 2014. Pg. 390. Accessed 2022-04-21

description: [Sect. Fuscescentes Pfitzer]. Pseudobulbs close together, elongated fusiform, 6–7 by 1.5–2 cm. Leaves 2, herbaceous; petiole 1.5–3 cm; lamina elliptic-lanceolate, 16–25 by 3.5–6 cm, acuminate; nerves 3–5, midrib prominent. Inflorescence proteranthous; peduncle 10–15 cm, about halfway to almost entirely enclosed by scale leaves; rachis zig-zag, curved or pendulous, 10–15 cm, internodes 2–4.5 cm. Floral bracts caducous. Flowers 3–8, open simultaneously, fragrant, 5–7 cm in diameter, glabrous; sepals, petals and column white to pale greenish or pale ochrish; labellum white to pale ochrish, with bold brown markings, sometimes with orange on base of mid-lobe, keels often pinkish. Dorsal sepal parallel to the column, oblong-lanceolate, 32–40 by 9–17 mm, acute. Lateral sepals oblong-lanceolate, 28–35 by 6–12 mm, acute. Petals linear, 30–36 by 2–4 mm, acute. Labellum 3-lobed, 30–32 by 16–20 mm; side lobes semi-elliptic with triangular top, sinus 2–3 mm; mid-lobe transversely elliptic to almost quadrangular, 12–16 by 15–18 mm, claw 2–3 mm, margins entire, top truncate to retuse, apex triangular; ornaments of 3 keels, low and broad, producing big drops of nectar, median shorter, laterals continuing on base of mid-lobe. Column 20–25 mm; top winged, apex slightly lobed.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: [Sect. Brachypterae D.A.Clayton]. Pseudobulbs 1–3 cm apart, cylindric, 6–16 by 1–2.5 cm, 4-angled, tapering. Leaves 2, herbaceous; petiole 1–1.5 cm; lamina elliptic-lanceolate, 12–25 by 2.5–6 cm; nerves 5–7. Inflorescence curved, hysteranthous; peduncle 4–8 cm, base halfway to entirely covered by 5–9 persistent imbricate scale leaves; rachis 3–15 cm, internodes 1.7–4 cm. Floral bracts persistent, lanceolate, 17–40 mm long, acute. Flowers 2–7, open simultaneously, 5–6 cm in diameter, fragrant, glabrous; sepals greenish-yellow to bright green; labellum whitish with red-brown or black markings, base orange; column green, base red-brown. Dorsal sepal patent, ovate-lanceolate, 30–38 by 5–11 mm, subacute. Lateral sepals oblong-lanceolate, 30–38 by 5–11 mm, acute. Petals linear, acute, 28–32 by 3–5 mm. Labellum 3-lobed, 21–25 by 10–15 mm; side lobes erect, semi-elliptic with rounded top, sinus 3–5 mm; mid-lobe 15–17 by 13–15 mm, claw 2–3 mm, blade ovate, semi-elliptic to semi-circular, margins undulate, top acute to broadly rounded, apex small, acute; ornaments of 3 keels, median one with 2–3 rows of  projections, lateral ones at base elevated, more or less dentate, between side lobes undulate, on  mid-lobe irregular. Column 14–16 mm long; top winged, apex truncate, finely crenate.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert
bibliographicCitation: Coelogyne brachyptera . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 2, 2014. Pg. 392. Accessed 2022-04-21

description: [Sect. Fuscescentes Pfitzer]. Pseudobulbs c. 1–2.5 cm apart, cylindric-oblong to fusiform, 4–11 by 1.5–2 cm. Leaves 2; petiole 0.5–4 cm; lamina broadly lanceolate to elliptic-oblong, 8–28 by 3.5–7 cm, acute; nerves 3–5, midrib prominent. Inflorescence proteranthous; peduncle 3,5–7 cm, to about halfway enclosed by scale leaves; rachis slightly zig-zag, curved to pendulous, c. 5–12 cm, internodes 1–2.5 cm. Floral bracts caducous. Flowers 4–8, open simultaneously, smelling of sawdust, c. 6 cm in diameter, glabrous; sepals, petals and column pale greenish or pale ochrish; labellum white to pale ochrish or pinkish, with bold light (orange-)brown markings, keels often pinkish. Dorsal sepal parallel to the column, oblong, 32–40 by 9–12 mm, acute. Lateral sepals oblong-lanceolate, 30–36 by 7–10 mm, acute. Petals linear, 27–35 by 1–2 mm, acute. Labellum 3-lobed, c. 30–35 by 12–17 mm; side lobes semi-elliptic with triangular top, sinus 3–5 mm; mid-lobe almost terete to spathulate, 12–15 by 15–20 mm, margins entire, claw almost absent to 4 mm, top rounded, truncate to retuse, apex triangular; ornaments of 3 low and  broad keels, producing big drops of nectar, almost equal in length, ending on disk or on the claw of the mid-lobe. Column c. 20 mm; top winged, apex entire.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: [Sect. Coelogyne]. Pseudobulbs 1–3 cm apart, ovoid, 2–7.5 by 1.5–4 cm, shiny, collar usually yellow. Leaves 2; petiole 1.5–6 cm; lamina lanceolate, 9–19 by 2–4 cm, acute; nerves  5. Inflorescence synanthous; peduncle 6–10 cm, the larger part enveloped by imbricate scale leaves; rachis 1.5–15 cm, internodes 1.3–2.2 cm. Floral bracts caducous. Flowers 2–5, open almost simultaneously, 6–7 cm in diameter, fragrant, glabrous; sepals and petals white; labellum and column white with yellow to orange markings. Dorsal sepal patent, elliptic-lanceolate, 33–40 by 8–15 mm. Lateral sepals oblong, acute, 33–40 by 10–11 mm. Petals linear, acute, 32–38 by 8–9 mm. Labellum 3-lobed, 28–35 by 20–25 mm; side lobes semi-elliptic with rounded top, sinus c. 3 mm; mid-lobe ovate, 15–17 by 12–17 mm, margins undulate, top broadly rounded, apex acute; ornaments of 3 keels on hypochile, continuing to 1/4 to halfway along mid-lobe, undulate, mostly with 2 short additional keels on mid-lobe. Column 18–21 mm; top winged, apex irregular.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert
bibliographicCitation: Coelogyne cumingii . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 2, 2014. Pg. 396. Accessed 2022-04-21

description: [Sect. Fuliginosae Lindl.]. Pseudobulbs c. 2–5 cm apart, ovoid to ellipsoid, 2–4 by 1–2 cm. Leaves 2; petiole 0.3–1 cm; lamina oblong-lanceolate, 5–12 by 1–3 cm, acute; nerves 5, midrib prominent. Inflorescence hysteranthous; peduncle c. 2.5 cm, largely covered by persistent imbricate sheaths; rachis zig-zag, c. 2.5 cm, internodes 1–1.4 cm. Floral bracts caducous. Flowers 1–3, open in succession, 2.5–3.5 cm in diameter, smell musky; sepals, petals, labellum and column whitish, yellowish or pale green, the labellum usually with bold brown markings, side lobes veined brown, keels darker brown. Dorsal sepal subparallel to the column, ovate-lanceolate, 16–23 by c. 4–7 mm, acute. Lateral sepals ovate-lanceolate, acute, 16–21 by 4–7 mm. Petals linear-lanceolate, acute, 16–20 by 0.7–1 mm. Labellum 3-lobed, 13–21 by 13–20 mm; side lobes semi-elliptic with triangular, fimbriate top and rounded tip; mid-lobe orbicular to rounded rectangular, 5–7 by 5–6 mm, fimbriate, top retuse, apex triangular; ornaments of 3 keels, median short, laterals ending halfway along the mid-lobe, undulate, sometimes 2 additional keels on mid-lobe. Column 10–15 mm; top winged, apex irregular.

description: [Sect. Flaccidae Lindl.]. Pseudobulbs close together, ovoid, cylindrical-oblong or fusiform, 5–15 by 2–4 cm. Labellum 3-lobed, 17–23 by 15–17 mm; side lobes semi-elliptic with rounded top, sinus 1–2 mm; mid-lobe ovate, 8–10 by 6–8 mm, margins undulate, claw c. 1 mm, with usually denticulate margins, top acute, apex rounded; ornaments of 3 keels on hypochile, continuing on the claw and sometimes on base of mid-lobe, undulate. Column 16–18 mm; top winged, apex irregular.

description: [Sect. Flaccidae Lindl.]. Pseudobulbs close together, ovoid, slightly compressed, 4–8 by 3–4 cm. description: [Sect. Lawrenceanae D.A.Clayton] Pseudobulbs 2–4.5 cm apart, ovoid-oblong to fusiform, slightly furrowed, 5–11.5 by 2–3.5 cm. Leaves 2, rather leathery; petiole 1–7 cm; lamina lanceolate to linear-oblanceolate, 12.8–40 by 2.1–5.5 cm, acuminate to acute; nerves 7, prominent. Inflorescence hysteranthous, erect or curved at the top; peduncle terete, 11.5–20  cm; rachis 3–18.2 cm, internodes 2–4.8 cm, at base with 1–3 persistent scale-leaves. Floral bracts caducous. Flowers 1–3, open in succession, fragrant, 9–13 cm in diameter; sepals and petals yellow-brown to pale salmon or light green, labellum mainly white to cream, disk yellow-orange, side lobes often with a brown marginal band and scattered brown markings, mid-lobe claw with brown markings, junction of claw with lamina with a brown band or an (yellow-)orange band bordered by brown (the keel laciniae there often darker brown), column greenish to cream. Dorsal sepal more or less parallel to the column, ovate-lanceolate, 55–71 by 13–25 mm, (sub)acute. Lateral sepals ovate-oblong to ovate-lanceolate, 55–68 by 13–23 mm, acute. Petals obliquely (lanceolate-)linear, 52–66 by 3–8 mm, acute. Labellum 3-lobed, 53–65 by 28–36 mm; side lobes triangular with rounded top, sinus 4–7 mm; mid-lobe spathulate, 30–38 by 20–36 mm, claw usually distinct, 3–6 by 8–19 mm, top retuse to rounded or truncate, apex  triangular; ornaments of 3–5 keels (and usually 2 additional short keels on mid-lobe claw), on disk moderately incised, on base of mid-lobe deeply incised to laciniate. description: [Sect. Lentiginosae Pfitzer]. Pseudobulbs 1–2.5 cm apart, (narrowly) cylindrical to fusiform, 5–12 by 1.5–2 cm. Dorsal sepal more or less parallel to the column, oblong-lanceolate, 20–30 by 7–10 mm, acute. Lateral sepals oblong-lanceolate, 20–30 by 7–10 mm, acute. Petals lanceolate, 22–25 by 3–5 mm, acute. Labellum 3-lobed, 15–21 by 10–14 mm; side lobes semi-elliptic with rounded  top, sinus c. 1 mm; mid-lobe semi-orbicular, 9–11 by 12–14 mm, margins undulate, claw 2–3 mm, top broadly rounded, apex triangular; ornaments of 3 keels, median usually slightly shorter, laterals continuing almost halfway along the mid-lobe. description: [Sect. Proliferae Lindl.]. Pseudobulbs 2–8 cm apart, cylindric to (narrowly) fusiform, 2.5–10.5 by 0.6–2 cm. Labellum 3-lobed, flattened, 12–15 by 8–12 mm; side lobes in front with rounded top, sinus 1–2 mm; mid-lobe rounded subrectangular to subelliptic obcordate, 4–7 by 4–6 mm, margins erose, top rounded to retuse; ornaments of (2–)3 keels, median very short or absent, laterals from labellum base to 2/3 of mid-lobe, especially in basal half undulate. description: [Sect. Fuliginosae Lindl.]. Pseudobulbs c. 5–7 cm apart, (narrowly) ovoid-fusiform to fusiform, 5–10 by 1–2 cm. description: [Sect. Fuliginosae Lindl.]. Pseudobulbs c. 3.5–7 cm apart, narrow cylindrical-fusiform, 5.5–8 by 1–1.5 cm. description: [Sect. Brachypterae D.A.Clayton]. Pseudobulbs c. 1.5–2 cm apart, cylindric, 7.5–15 by 1–1.5 cm, 4-angled, tapering. Leaves 2, herbaceous; petiole c. 1 cm; lamina elliptic to lanceolate, 12–21 by 2.5–6 cm; nerves 5–7. Inflorescence hysteranthous, curved; peduncle 4.5–9 cm, base covered by 7–9 persistent imbricate scale leaves; rachis 2.5–6 cm, internodes c. 2 cm. Floral bracts persistent, lanceolate, 20–25 mm, acute. Flowers 2–6, open simultaneously, 5–7 cm in diameter, glabrous; sepals greenish-yellow to bright green; labellum whitish, red-brown to black markings, base orange; column green, base red-brown. Labellum 3-lobed, 24–29 by 12–17 mm; lateral lobes erect, in front projecting c. 5 mm, semi-elliptic with rounded top; mid-lobe 14–19 by 12–17 mm, claw to 2 mm, blade semi-elliptic, margins undulate, top broadly rounded, apex small, acute; ornaments of 3 keels, median one formed by 2–3 rows of wart-like projections, lateral ones at base dentate, between side lobes entire, on mid-lobe broken up in conical tooth-like projections, often with several additional rows of radiating tooth-like projections. Column 16–19 mm long; top winged, apex truncate, finely crenate.

description: [Sect. Elatae Pfitzer]. Pseudobulbs 2.5–5 cm apart, (elongated) ovoid, 4.7–10 by 1–2.6 cm. Labellum 3-lobed, 27–32 by 25–30 mm; side lobes in front with acute to rounded top, sinus c. 10–13 mm; mid-lobe subrectangular, narrower at base, 16–18 by 12–16 mm, margins plicate, irregular; top truncate, median retuse; ornaments of 3 keels, median at labellum base, short and swollen, laterals from base of disk to halfway along mid-lobe. description: [Sect. Proliferae Lindl.]. Pseudobulbs 1–2.5 cm apart, (elongated) ovoid to fusiform, 2–9 by 1.5–3 cm. description: [Sect. Tomentosae Pfitzer]. Pseudobulbs close together, spindle-shaped to long ovoid, 7–25 by 2–3 cm. Inflorescence proteranthous to synanthous, hairy; peduncle short, largely enclosed by imbricate scale leaves; rachis 25–110 cm, internodes 1.5–4.5 cm. Floral bracts persistent, 19–36 by 14–28 mm. Flowers (10–)15–55, open simultaneously, 5–6.5 cm in diameter, glabrous, ovary hairy; sepals, and petals yellowish-brown to (greenish-)ochre, labellum outside mainly white (side lobes brown in front), inside mainly median white (side lobes dark brown with whitish veins and white margin, mid-lobe brown with white base and margin). Dorsal sepal patent, lanceolate, 23–36 by 5–10 mm, acute. Lateral sepals lanceolate, 23–33 by 5–9 mm, acute. Petals narrowly elliptic, 23–33 by 2–7 mm, acute or rounded. description: [Sect. Lentiginosae Pfitzer]. Pseudobulbs close together, ovoid, slightly tetragonal, 4–7 by 1.5–2.5 cm. description: [Sect. Longifoliae Pfitzer & Kraenzl.]. Pseudobulbs 1–3 cm apart, elongated fusiform, 6.5–8 by c. 1 cm. Labellum 3-lobed, 13–17 by 13–15 mm; side lobes in front with rounded top, sinus c. 2 mm; mid-lobe suborbicular to spathulate, 7–11 by 9–14 mm, margins slightly undulate, top broadly rounded to slightly retuse, apex triangular; ornaments of 3 keels, median slightly shorter, laterals continuing almost halfway along the mid lobe. description: [Sect. Elatae Pfitzer]. Pseudobulbs 3–6 cm apart, cylindric-oblong, 6–12.5 by 1.3–4 cm. description: [Sect. Tomentosae Pfitzer]. Pseudobulbs 2–6 cm apart, spindle-shaped, 5–20 by 2.5–3 cm. Leaves 2, herbaceous; petiole 1–9 cm; lamina broadly obovate to elliptic, 9–32 by 4–12.5 cm, shortly acuminate; (5- to) 7-nerved, midrib prominent. description: [Sect. Lentiginosae Pfitzer]. Pseudobulbs close together, globose ovoid with drawn-out top, 1.3–2 by 1.2 cm. Leaves 2, soon dropped in autumn, slightly leathery; petiole indistinct; lamina elliptic-lanceolate, 5–10 cm by c. 0.9 cm, acute; midrib prominent. Inflorescence synanthous, erect; peduncle c. 3 cm, (almost) entirely covered by imbricate scale leaves; rachis 1.5 cm. Floral bracts persistent, ovate, 15–17 by 7–8 mm. Flower one, 4–5 cm in diameter, glabrous; sepals and petals pale green or yellowish-ochre; labellum white, side lobes with narrow brown veins and brown margins bordered with white, mid-lobe yellowish with brown markings at the base, a brown band bordering the basal centre, and radiating brown streaks, sometimes with a median light green wedge, its margin brown; column green. Dorsal sepal erect, oblong-lanceolate, 25–28 by 8–12 mm, acute. Lateral sepals oblong-lanceolate, c. 25–28 by 6–8 mm, acute. Petals, narrowly linear, c. 22 by 2 mm, acute. Labellum 3-lobed, 23–28 by 16–18 mm; hypochile when flattened 10–11 by 10–12 mm, side lobes erose, in front rounded, sinus 1–2 mm; mid-lobe about orbicular, 13–16 by 16–17 mm, margins undulate, erose, claw 2–3 mm, top deeply retuse, apex triangular; ornaments of 3 keels, median shorter, laterals continuing almost to base of mid-lobe. description: [Sect. Proliferae Lindl.]. Pseudobulbs 1–4 cm apart, ovoid to ellipsoid, globose, 1.5–8 by 1–2.3 cm. Leaves 2, leathery; petiole 0.5–6 cm; lamina oblong to elliptic-lanceolate, 4.5–18.5 by 1–3 cm, acute to acuminate; 5- to 7-nerved, midrib prominent. Inflorescence hysteranthous; peduncle 3–25 cm; rachis at base and top covered by 8–12 persistent coriaceous imbricate scale leaves, 4–10 cm, next 1–3 seasons extending and flowering, internodes 0.8–1.6 cm. Floral bracts caducous. Flowers 4–9 per flowering period, several open simultaneously, 1.5–3 cm in diameter, glabrous; yellowish, brownish or white; side lobes of labellum with brownish margin and veins, yellow on mid-lobe. Dorsal sepal parallel to the column, oblong-lanceolate, 10–18 by 6–9 mm, acute to acuminate. Lateral sepals oblong-lanceolate, 10–18 by 6–9 mm, acute to acuminate. Petals linear, 10–18 by 0.6–2 mm, acute. Labellum 3-lobed, 10–18 by 6–14 mm; side lobes in front with acute to rounded top, sinus c. 2–4 mm; mid-lobe spathulate to suborbicular, 7–10 by 8–11 mm, margins undulate, top retuse, apex sometimes triangular; ornaments of 2 keels on basal half of mid-lobe. Column 7–12 mm, winged; apex entire to notched.

description: [Sect. Speciosae Lindl.]. Pseudobulbs to 1 cm apart, ovoid-oblong, slightly tetragonal, 4.3–9 by 2–3 cm. Leaf 1, herbaceous; petiole 2.2–4.7 cm; lamina (obovate-)lanceolate to long-elliptic, 23–42 by 4–12.5 cm, acuminate; 5- to 7-nerved, midrib prominent. Inflorescence synanthous, pendulous; peduncle 8–39 cm; rachis 2–32 cm, internodes curved, 1.7–2.3 cm. Floral bracts caducous. Flowers up to 20, open in succession, 4–5 cm in diameter, finely papillose, smell musky; sepals and petals pale to light green, yellow or cream-colour, labellum side lobes inside light brown, disk lighter so with orange base, keel hairs to the front darker brown, claw of mid-lobe with an undulating transverse darker brown band on junction with the whitish blade. Dorsal sepal parallel to the column, ovate-oblong, 35–48 by 15–28 mm, acute. Lateral sepals ovate-oblong, 34–46 by 13–21 mm, acute. Petals linear, 32–44 by 2–3 mm, acute. Labellum 3-lobed, c. 34–43 by 36–44 mm; side lobes semi-elliptic, in front with rounded top, sinus 7–12 mm; mid-lobe spathulate to suborbicular, c. 12 by 17 mm, claw usually distinct, to 5 mm long, top retuse to rounded or truncate, apex triangular; ornaments of 5–7(–8) curved keels, the 2 keels flanking the median keel ending on the base of the blade of the mid-lobe, the others shorter, all on the disk with long hair-like projections, to the top changing into a row of plate-like projections. Column 27–35 mm; apex rounded.

description: [Sect. Lentiginosae Pfitzer]. Pseudobulbs 2–6 cm apart, ovoid, 5–10 by 2–4 cm, grooved. Leaves 2, herbaceous; petiole 3.5–6 cm; lamina obovate-lanceolate, 15–38 by 4–6.8 cm, acuminate; midrib prominent. Inflorescence synanthous; peduncle c. 4–10 cm; rachis zig-zag, 7–11 cm, internodes 0.5–1 cm. Floral bracts soon caducous. Flowers 6–15, open simultaneously, sweet fragrant, 2–2.5 cm in diameter, glabrous; flower white, labellum keels light yellow, sometimes a yellow patch on base of labellum mid-lobe. Dorsal sepal parallel to the column, oblong-lanceolate, 14–19 by 5–7 mm, acuminate. Lateral sepals oblong-lanceolate, 14–19 by 4–7 mm, acuminate. Petals lanceolate, 12–18 by 3–7 mm, acute. Labellum hardly 3-lobed, 12–13 by 6–10 mm; side lobes slightly developed, low, in front receding to rounded and slightly projecting, sinus if present to 0.5 mm; mid-lobe strongly reflexed, broadly ovate to orbicular, c. 7–8 by 6–7 mm, claw indistinct to 1 mm, margins subcrenate, top triangular; ornaments of 3 keels on hypochile, continuing far on the mid-lobe and there with 2 additional keels, all strongly undulate. Column c. 6–8 mm; top winged, apex irregular.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: [Sect. Elatae Pfitzer]. Pseudobulbs 2–3.5 cm apart, ovoid, 3–6.5 by 1.5–2 cm, angular. Leaves 2, thin leathery; petiole 1–3 cm; lamina lanceolate, 7.5–30 cm by 1.6–5 cm, acute; nerves 5, median prominent. Inflorescence hysteranthous; peduncle 2–11.5 cm; rachis erect, zig-zag, 2–9 cm, its base enclosed by 5–18 persistent, imbricate, leathery scale leaves, internodes 0.8–1 cm. Floral bracts caducous. Flowers 4–6, open simultaneously, c. 2 cm in diameter, fragrant, glabrous; sepals, petals, labellum and column greenish- or ochrish-yellow, labellum with brownish  markings. Dorsal sepal patent, oblong-lanceolate, acute, 10–15 by 3–5 mm. Lateral sepals oblong, acute, 10–15 by 3–5 mm. Petals linear, acute, 10–15 by 0.7–1 mm. Labellum 3-lobed, 12–14 by 8–10 mm; side lobes with triangular top, sinus c. 1.5–2 mm; mid-lobe subobovate, 5–7 by 5–7 mm, margins undulate, subentire, claw indistinct, 0.1–0.2 mm, top rounded to shallowly retuse, apex acute; ornaments of 3 keels, median very short on labellum base, laterals continuing halfway to 3/4 of mid-lobe, margin undulate. Column 7–9 mm, winged; apex irregular.

description: [Sect. Tomentosae Pfitzer]. Pseudobulbs close together, (elongated) ovoid, 4–15 by 2–4 cm. Leaves 2, herbaceous; petiole 4–17 cm; lamina ovate to long-elliptic, 13.5–70 by 2.5–10 cm, acute or acuminate; 5- to 7-nerved, midrib prominent. Inflorescence heteranthous, hairy; peduncle short, hidden in persistent scale leaves; rachis 28–55 cm, moderately tomentose, internodes 1.5–3.5 cm. Floral bracts persistent, (transversely) elliptic, 14–40 by 12–22 mm, obtuse. Flowers 10–30, open simultaneously, 4–7 cm in diameter, glabrous except ovary mostly sparsely hairy; sepals, petals and column cream-colour, pale yellow or green, labellum inside dark brown, median yellowish, veins on side lobes and keels yellowish. Dorsal sepal patent, elliptic, 23–42 by 6–11 mm, acute. Lateral sepals elliptic, 23–40 by 7–11 mm, acute. Petals narrowly elliptic to oblanceolate, 24–39 by 3.5–8 mm, acute to acuminate. Labellum 3-lobed, 21–31 by 14–23 mm; side lobes semi-elliptic, in front with rounded top, sinus 1–2 mm; mid-lobe elliptic to transversely elliptic, rarely spathulate, 5–11 by 5–14 mm, margins more or less irregular, top rounded to retuse, apex triangular; ornaments of 3 keels, at base high, serrate, continuing low with blunt processions, on mid-lobe changing to a patch of blunt molar-like processions. Column 15–21 mm long, winged; apex notched.

description: [Sect. Flaccidae Lindl.]. Pseudobulbs c. 1–3 cm apart, ovoid, angular, 3–8 by 3–4.5 cm. Leaves 2, herbaceous; petiole 2–12 cm; lamina linear–lanceolate, 12–45 by 3–4.5 cm, acute; nerves 3, below prominent. Inflorescence proteranthous; peduncle 4–7 cm, largely to entirely covered by scale leaves; rachis zig-zag, curved, 4–8 cm, internodes 1–2.5 cm. Floral bracts caducous during anthesis, lanceolate, to 25 by 8 mm. Flowers 5–8, open simultaneously, sweet  fragrant, 3–4 cm in diameter, glabrous; sepals, petals and column white to pale pink or pale green; labellum white, usually with yellow margins on claw, brown side lobes and brown on mid-lobe. Dorsal sepal patent, elliptic-lanceolate, 20–25 by 6–8 mm. Lateral sepals oblong, acute, 20–25 by 5–7 mm. Petals linear-lanceolate, acute, 18–20 by 2–3 mm. Labellum 3-lobed, 20–22 by 14–16 mm; side lobes semi-elliptic, in front receding, without sinus; mid-lobe ovate to transversely elliptic, 6–7 by 6–8 mm, margins undulate, claw 2–3 mm long with irregular margins, top broadly acute, apex rounded; ornaments of 3 keels on disk, median shorter, laterals continuing to halfway or almost the top of the mid-lobe, undulate, addadditional keels on mid-lobe 0–4. Column 16–18 mm; top winged, apex notched, irregular.

description: [Sect. Fuliginosae Lindl.]. Pseudobulbs c. 1.5–3.5 cm apart, (narrowly) ovoid-fusiform to fusiform, 2.8–6.3 by 1–2 cm. Leaves 2, herbaceous; petiole 0.5–0.8 cm; lamina elliptic oblong to narrowly elliptic-lanceolate, 6.5–11.5 by 2–4 cm, acute to acuminate; nerves 5–7, mid-rib prominent. Inflorescence hysteranthous; peduncle 3.3–4.5 cm, for c. 3/4 covered by 1–2 imbricate scale leaves; rachis somewhat zig-zag, to 7.5 cm long, internodes 2.5–3 cm. Floral bracts caducous. Flowers 1–2, open in succession, 4–5 cm in diameter; sepals, petals, labellum and column yellowish, ochrish, greenish-yellow or brownish-yellow, labellum usually with a large brown area on mid-lobe or mid-lobe (almost) entirely brown, side lobes veined brown, keels usually darker brown. Dorsal sepal patent, lanceolate, 35–43 by 13–14 mm, acute. Lateral sepals lanceolate, 35–41 by 11–13 mm, acute. Petals linear, 34–38 by 1–3 mm, acute. Labellum 3-lobed, 26–29 by 35–40 mm; side lobes in front spreading, with high triangular, broadly rounded top, with shortly fimbriate front margin, sinus c. 3 mm deep; claw short; mid-lobe somewhat spathulate, c. 13–19 by 11–18 mm, shortly sparsely fimbriate up to 0.3 mm, top obtuse, apex triangular; ornaments of 3 undulate keels, median short, laterals ending at 3/4 of mid-lobe, undulate, less so on mid-lobe. Column c. 20 mm; top winged, apex irregular.

description: [Sect. Proliferae Lindl.]. Pseudobulbs close together, ovoid to fusiform, 2.5–4 by c. 1.5 cm. Leaves 2, thin leathery; petiole 1–3 cm; lamina elliptic-lanceolate, 4–6 by 1.5–2 cm, acuminate; nerves 5. Inflorescence hysteranthous; peduncle 4–7 cm; rachis erect, more or less zig-zag, 3–5 cm, its base enclosed by several persistent, imbricate, leathery scale leaves, internodes 0.5–0.8 cm. Floral bracts caducous. Flowers 4–8, open simultaneously, 0.6–1 cm in diameter, glabrous, without scent; sepals and petals pale yellow-green to yellowish to light brown, labellum yellow, side lobes with dark brown margin, mid-lobe dark brown. Dorsal sepal patent, oblong-lanceolate, acute, 6–8 by 2–4 mm. Lateral sepals oblong, acute, 6–8 by 2–4 mm. Petals linear, acute, c. 5 by 0.5 mm. Labellum 3-lobed, c. 6 by 6 mm; side lobes with triangular top, sinus c. 0.5 mm; mid-lobe about semi-elliptic, c. 2 by 4 mm, margins irregular, claw indistinct, top shallowly retuse; ornaments of 2 short keels on base of mid-lobe, margin entire. Column c. 5 mm, winged; apex rounded.
