description: [Sect. Tomentosae Pfitzer]. Pseudobulbs close together, more or less ovoid, 4.5–10 by 2.3 cm. Leaves 2, herbaceous; petiole 3–13 cm; lamina obovate to (long) elliptic, 16–38 by 3.5–10.5 cm, acuminate; (5- to) 7-nerved, midrib prominent. Inflorescence heteranthous; peduncle short, hidden in persistent scale leaves; rachis 20–60 cm, densely hairy with velutinous hairs, internodes 1.5–3.5 cm. Floral bracts persistent, ovate to suborbicular, 15–28 by 13–27 mm, acute to rounded. Flowers 8–26, open simultaneously, 4.5–5 cm in diameter, glabrous except pedicel and ovary; sepals, petals and column pink or cream-colour, labellum pale pink or white, inside brown but median white, veins on side lobes broad and white or pinkish, keels white or yellowish, mid-lobe with a brown margin. Dorsal sepal more or less parallel to the column, narrowly elliptic, 25–33 by 6–11 mm, acute. Lateral sepals narrowly elliptic, 25–33 by 6–10 mm, acute. Petals narrowly elliptic, 25–32 by 3–8 mm, acute. Labellum 3-lobed, 22–26 by 16–20 mm; side lobes in front with rounded top, sinus 0.1–0.2 mm; mid-lobe ovate to almost orbicular, 6–9 by 6–10 mm, margins more or less entire, top broadly acute; ornaments of 3 keels, continuing to 3/4 of mid-lobe, at base high, serrate, continuing lower, shorter serrate, on mid-lobe higher, serrate, with 0, 2 or 4 additional keels. Column 16–21 mm long, winged; apex irregular.

description: [Sect. Flaccidae Lindl.]. Pseudobulbs c. 1–3 cm apart, ovoid-pear shape, 3–7 by 2–3 cm. Leaves 2, herbaceous; petiole 2–5 cm; lamina narrowly linear, 19–35 by 1–2 cm, acute; nerves 5–9, midrib prominent. Inflorescence proteranthous; peduncle 3.5–7.5 cm, largely covered by scale leaves; rachis curved, 3–5 cm, internodes 1–2 cm. Floral bracts caducous. Flowers 2–4, open simultaneously, fragrant, 5–6 cm in diameter, glabrous; sepals, petals and column white to pale pink; labellum white, base of mid-lobe and front of side lobes yellow, side lobes veined brown, keels on mid-lobe brown. Dorsal sepal patent, elliptic-lanceolate, 27–30 by 8–10 mm. Lateral sepals oblong, acute, 27–30 by 6–10 mm. Petals linear-lanceolate, acute, c. 25–30 by 4–5 mm. Labellum 3-lobed, 16–22 by 14–17 mm; side lobes semi-elliptic with triangular top, sinus c. 2 mm; mid-lobe ovate, 7–11 by 5–8 mm, margins entire, claw 2–3 mm, top acute to acuminate; ornaments of 3 keels, median equally long or shorter, laterals continuing on base of the mid-lobe, undulate. Column c. 15 mm; top winged, apex notched.

description: [Sect. Speciosae Lindl.]. Pseudobulbs to 1.5 cm apart, (elongated) ovoid, more or less tetragonal, 4–8 by 2–4 cm. Leaf 1, herbaceous; petiole 3.5–9 cm; lamina obovate-lanceolate to long-elliptic, 20–37 by 4–10 cm, acuminate; 3- to 5-nerved, midrib prominent. Inflorescence synanthous, pendulous; peduncle 7–15 cm; rachis 2–6 cm, internodes 1.6–2.3 cm. Floral bracts caducous. Flowers 1–4, open in succession, 5–8 cm in diameter, glabrous; sepals and petals pale pink to salmon, labellum inside dull dark brown to very dark bluish-brown. Dorsal sepal parallel to the column, elliptic to oblong, 43–56 by 16–24 mm, acute. Lateral sepals ovate oblong, 40–60 by 13–23 mm, acute. Petals linear, 42–55 by 2–3.5 mm, acute. Labellum 3-lobed, 36–52 by 35–50 mm; side lobes semi-elliptic, in front with rounded top, sinus 3.5–5.5 mm; mid lobe spathulate to suborbicular, 13–21 by 18–21 mm, with scattered tiny warts, margins slightly erose, top retuse to rounded, apex triangular; ornaments of 2 keels, undulating, ending halfway along the mid-lobe. Column 25–39 mm; apex notched.

description: Terrestrial, rarely epiphytic herbs; rhizome creeping. Pseudobulbs alternating, 1–6 with a leaf and 1 with an inflorescence, articulate at junction with petiole or peduncle, scales 1 per pseudobulb, tubular, early caducous. Foliage leaves 1 per pseudobulb, convolute, plicate, petiolate. Inflorescence racemose, erect, unbranched, both peduncle and rachis elongating during anthesis; floral bracts persistent during anthesis. Flowers few to many, more or less resupinate, turned to all sides, yellow, green, white, pink, or purple, widely opening, often somewhat asymmetrical. Lateral sepals inserted on column foot. Petals free. Labellum not movable, narrowly attached to column foot, entire or 3-lobed; hypochile basal portion claw-like with straight parallel margins, front part with lateral lobes, ornamented by 2 lateral keels, from the base elevating into an entire lobe or into an oblique structure hollow in front, from there continuing to the front, median keel absent or present; epichile recurved. Column semiterete; with a seam in front laterally on either side; column foot with a spur; anther subterminal, incumbent, 2-locular; pollinia 2, hard, waxy, obliquely conical with an obtuse top and a hollow base. Ovary longitudinally grooved, glabrous. Fruit a capsule, fusiform.</br></br>A genus of c. 14 species distributed from NE India, S China, northern Indo-China, Taiwan, Japan and the Malesian region to the SW Pacific; 2 species in Thailand.

description: Flowering shoots 15–25 cm tall; rhizome terete, slender, 3–4 cm in diameter. Pseudobulbs cylindric, 4–5 cm by 2–4 mm. Foliage leaves ovate to ovate-oblong, 10–15 by 5–7 cm, apex acute, base rounded or cordate, lamina green with purple patches; petiole 1–2 cm long, base covered with sheaths. Inflorescence glabrous, to 15 cm long; peduncle 12–18 cm long, with 2–4 membranous sheaths at base; rachis 4–5 cm long; floral bracts ovate-lanceolate, 1–1.5 cm long, apex acuminate. Flowers 4–6, suberect; pedicel and ovary subtwisted, 0.8–1.5 cm long. Sepals green, dorsal sepal oblong-lanceolate, 10–13 by 2.5–3 mm, apex acute, 4- to 5-nerved; lateral sepals falcate-oblong, more or less of the same size as dorsal sepal. Petals green, oblong lanceolate, 10–11 by 2–2.5 mm, apex acute to acuminate. Labellum 3-lobed, obcordate-obovate, 9–13 by 9–12 mm, epichile white, hypochile light yellow, with bright yellow median ornaments and reddish-purple stripes on each side; side lobes deltoid, obtuse to rounded, 2–4 mm long, much shorter than mid-lobe. Column light yellow, 5–8 mm long, slightly dilated towards apex, with triangular teeth on both sides near apex; column foot with a cylindric green spur.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Flowering shoots 30–50 cm tall; rhizome terete, slender, 2–3 cm in diameter. Pseudobulbs cylindric, 1.5–4 cm by 2–4 mm. Foliage leaves ovate-lanceolate or oblong-lanceolate, 6–20 by 3–7 cm, apex acute to acuminate, base rounded or cordate, lamina green with purple patches; petiole 1–4 cm long, base covered with tubular sheaths. Inflorescence glabrous, to 45 cm long; peduncle 20–35 cm long, with several sheaths at base; rachis to 40 cm long; floral bracts lanceolate, 4–5 mm long, apex acuminate. Flowers 10–16; pedicel and ovary subtwisted, 0.9–1.5 cm long. Sepals green, dorsal sepal narrowly oblong-lanceolate, 15–18 by 2–3 mm, apex acuminate, 3- to 4-nerved; lateral sepals falcate-oblanceolate, slightly wider and shorter than dorsal sepal, apex acuminate, 3- to 4-nerved. Petals green, oblong-oblanceolate, 15–17 by 2–2.2 mm, apex acute to acuminate, 3-nerved. Labellum light purple, 3-lobed, suborbicular, 10–15 by 10–17 mm; side lobes obliquely ovate, 6–8 mm long, with triangular acute apex, apical margin irregularly serrate; mid-lobe obovate, 5–6 mm long, margin irregularly serrate; ornaments of 2 lateral keels on hypochile, raising high at base of epichile, then continuing as a low broad cushion on proximal part of epichile. Column pink, c. 10 mm long, slightly dilated towards apex, with triangular curved teeth on both sides near apex; column foot with a conical green spur with darker apex.

description: Plant terrestrial, often producing several reed-like stems from the same short rhizome. Roots fasciculate and wiry. Leaves several per stem, more or less distichous, (sub)sessile, plicate, sheathing at base, fairly tough, more or less furfuraceous. Inflorescences 1–4 per flowering shoot, lateral, paniculate, much shorter than the leaves; floral bracts boat-shaped, ovate to (triangular-)lanceolate, veins often prominent on the dorsal side. Flowers distichous on each panicle branch (but pedicels twisted to make the flowers appear secundly arranged). Sepals and and petals of subequal length; dorsal sepal very shortly adnate to petals and column; petals usually broader than sepals. Labellum spathulate; claw embracing the column. Column at least 3 times as long as anther, slender and straight, slightly shorter than the labellum, with a pair of subterminal auricles; anther dorsal, versatile, elongated; pollinia 2, sectile, slender; rostellum erect, bifid, producing a long, more or less semiterete hamule and an elliptic-oblong to ovate viscidium; stigma transverse, with 2 recurved triangular lobules in front. Capsule strongly 6-ribbed.</br></br>A genus of 6 species with a pantropical distribution that includes South and Central America, tropical Africa, Madagascar, the Mascarenes, Indo-Malesia, Queensland and the W Pacific islands (south-east to Samoa); 1 species in Thailand.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Flowering shoots 50–300 cm tall. Leaves lanceolate to elliptic, acuminate (to acute), 15–49 by 4–14.2 cm, margins straight. Inflorescences with 2–8 straight primary branches (and occasionally with a few branches of second order); the entire inflorescence 4–19 cm long and  3–20 cm across, 7- to many-flowered; peduncle hidden in a leaf sheath, dorsiventrally flattened. Flowers (greenish-)white, fragrant in the evening. Sepals more or less spreading from connivent bases; dorsal sepal linear-spathulate to narrowly oblong-spathulate, acute to obtuse, sometimes mucronate, 28.1–49 by 4.3–7 mm; lateral sepals 28.8–49.8 by 4.4–6.8 mm, obliquely linear-spathulate to narrowly oblong-spathulate, acute, sometimes mucronate. Petals distally recurved to reflexed, obliquely linear-spathulate to obovate, 28.8–46.5 by 5.8–7.9 mm, acute (to acuminate), margins of distal part undulate. Labellum 28.4–44 by 11.2–17.3 mm; dilated distal part ovate to suborbicular, constituting 1/3 to 1/2 of the total labellum length, obtuse to acute or short acuminate, margins undulate; claw channelled, ornamented by 2 parallel keels that continue and diverge proximally on the distal labellum part. Column slenderly clavate, 23.8–38.5 mm long; anther slenderly oblongoid-ovoid, subacute, 5.2–6.1 mm long. Capsule oblongoid, 1.5–4.8 cm  long, 0.4–0.7 cm in diameter.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Terrestrial herbs with corms connected by a rhizome. Foliage leaves 1–2 per corm (leaves absent in one mycoheterotrophic species endemic to Japan), convolute, plicate, petiolate, deciduous, present at the time of flowering; lamina lanceolate to elliptic. Inflorescence arising laterally from the corm, racemose. Flowers nodding to pendent, resupinate, slenderly campanulate (i.e. with sepals, petals and labellum elongate, subequal in length and only slightly spreading). Sepals and petals free. Labellum firmly attached, spathulate with 3-lobed distal part, spurless (but concave to saccate at base). Column straight, elongate, nearly as long as labellum, without column foot; anther subterminal, incumbent, versatile; pollinia 4, closely appressed in 2 pairs, solid, without distinct caudicles; rostellum producing a hamule and a viscidium; receptive part of stigma concave. Fruit not seen.</br></br>A genus of c. 5 species distributed from the southern Himalayas to Sakhalin and the Kuril Islands; 1 species in Thailand.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Corms clustered, ovoid to terete, 1.5–3.7 cm long, 1–2.3 cm in diameter, producing fibrous roots. Leaves 1(–2) per corm, long-petiolate; petiole(s) covered by 2 cataphylls to form a pseudostem; lamina lanceolate, acute to acuminate, 11.7–15 by 2.5–5.4 cm, with 3–5 distinct (and many indistinct) veins. Inflorescence 26–42 cm tall, lax, 15- to 20-flowered; peduncle bearing 2–3 sheathing, scale-like leaves; rachis 11–18 cm long; floral bracts suberect, linear-triangular to lanceolate, acuminate, 6–11 by 1–2 mm. Flowers fragrant, pale purple to orange brown. Sepals glabrous; dorsal sepal linear-oblanceolate, obtuse to acuminate, 28–34 by 3–5 mm; lateral sepals obliquely linear-oblanceolate, acuminate, 25–33 by 2.5–4 mm. Petals obliquely linear-oblanceolate, (sub)acuminate, 27–33 by 2.5–3.5 mm, glabrous. Labellum deeply 3-lobed  at apex, 24–31 mm long, 3–7 mm wide across side lobes when flattened, glabrous; side lobes porrect, obliquely linear to linear-triangular, acute to acuminate, 3–4 mm long; mid-lobe porrect, lanceolate to elliptic, subacute, 5–10 mm long, ornamented by a small, oblongoid, smooth callus at base. Column 22–27 mm long, semiterete with the front margins extended to form 2 narrow subdistal wings on the ventral side; anther cordate in upper view, c. 1.5 mm long; rostellum producing a broadly ovate hamule and a sagittate viscidium; receptive part of stigma broadly elliptic. Ovary (including pedicel) slenderly terete, flaccid, 8–12 mm long, glabrous.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Epiphytic, lithophytic or terrestrial herbs, rarely mycoheterotrophic. Pseudobulbs ovoid to spindle-shaped, occasionally absent, often concealed within the leaf bases. Roots thick, velamen-covered. Cataphylls several, surrounding the young growth. Leaves up to 13, distichous, duplicate, linear-elliptic or narrowly ligulate to elliptic, acuminate to strongly bilobed, articulated. Inflorescences racemose, usually arising from within the cataphylls but occasionally from within the axils of the leaves. Flowers 1 to many, long-lasting (all open at the same time), often large, showy and sometimes fragrant, each subtended by a small bract. Sepals and petals free, subsimilar, spreading or with the petals porrect. Labellum 3-lobed (to subentire), free or proximally fused to the base of the column; side lobes erect and weakly clasping the column; mid-lobe often recurved; ornaments usually of 2 parallel ridges from near the base of the labellum to the base of the mid-lobe, rarely replaced by a shallow depression or a single ridge. Column arcuate, weakly or strongly winged, glabrous, foot short or absent; pollinia usually 2, partly cleft, or completely cleft to form 4 very tightly coupled pollinia, hard and bony, attached by short caudicles to a usually triangular viscidium (stipe absent). Capsule fusiform to ellipsoidal or oblong-ellipsoidal, narrowing at the base to a short pedicel and at the apex to a short beak formed by the persistent column.</br></br>Some 52 species distributed from the NW Himalayas to Japan, and south through Indo China and Malesia to the Philippines, New Guinea and Australia; 20 species in Thailand.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Medium-sized, epiphytic herb. Pseudobulbs 6–9 by 3–4 cm, ovoid, bilaterally flattened. Leaves 4–5 per pseudobulb, 40–100 by 1.5–4.5 cm, ligulate, obtuse to emarginate and unequally bilobed at the apex, coriaceous, rigid, arching. Inflorescence 30–70 cm long, pendulous except at the base, with 20–45 flowers; rachis 24–76 cm long; bracts 2–5 mm long. Flowers 3.5–4.2 cm across; lightly scented; sepals and petals pale yellow to cream with a broad, central, maroon-brown stripe, often with darker streaks; labellum white or cream, side lobes and mid-lobe veined maroon, mid-lobe yellow at the base; ridges and disk yellow. Dorsal sepal 19–24 by 5–8.5 mm, narrowly oblong to narrowly ligulate-elliptic, obtuse, mucronate, erect; lateral sepals similar, oblique, spreading. Petals 18–20 by 5–8.5 mm, narrowly elliptic, obtuse to acute, sometimes mucronate, porrect and almost parallel above the column. Labellum 15–23 by 10–14 mm when flattened, saccate at the base, minutely papillose to minutely pubescent; side lobes acute to acuminate, exceeding the column and the anther; mid-lobe 8.4–12 by 6.5–9 mm, ovate, acute to obtuse, often mucronate, usually recurved, margin entire; ornaments usually of 2 sigmoid ridges often broken in the middle and inflated only towards the base and the apex. Column 10–12 mm long; pollinia 2. Capsule 4–7 by 2–3 cm, oblong-ellipsoidal.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Large, epiphytic or rarely lithophytic herb. Pseudobulbs up to 10 by 6 cm, ovoid, bilaterally flattened. Leaves usually 7–9 per pseudobulb, up to 50–90 by 1.5–4 cm, ligulate, obtuse and unequally bilobed at the apex, coriaceous, rigid, arching. Inflorescence 28–75 cm long, arching to pendulous, with 10–33 flowers; rachis 20–55 cm long; bracts 1–4 mm long. Flowers 3.5–4.5 cm across; usually coconut-scented; sepals deep maroon to dull yellow-green with strong maroon staining; labellum white, becoming yellow with age, side-lobes stained maroon-purple, mid-lobe yellow in front of the ridges and blotched with maroon; ridges bright yellow in front, stained maroon behind. Dorsal sepal 28–33 by 7–10 mm, narrowly ligulate elliptic, obtuse, suberect, margins revolute; lateral sepals similar, falcate and oblique, pendulous and porrect. Petals 25–30 by 7.5–11 mm, narrowly elliptic, subacute, weakly porrect, margins sometimes revolute. Labellum 21–25 by 13–15 mm when flattened, usually broadest across the mid-lobe, minutely papillose to minutely pubescent, the longest hairs on the side-lobe tips; side lobes erect, much shorter than the column, apices obtuse and appearing truncated; mid-lobe 11–13 by 13–14 mm, broadly ovate to rhomboid, obtuse to emarginate, weakly recurved, margin entire; ornaments of 2 sigmoid, raised ridges that are rounded and confluent at the apices and merge gradually with the base of the mid-lobe. Column 16–18 mm long; pollinia 2.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Medium-sized, epiphytic herb. Pseudobulbs 5–7 by 1.6–2.9 cm, slenderly ovoid, slightly bilaterally flattened. Leaves 5–7 per pseudobulb, subsessile, 7.4–53.9 by 1.6–3.7 cm, oblong-lanceolate to narrowly linear-oblanceolate, acuminate, mucronate, coriaceous, arching. Inflorescence c. 70 cm long, arcuate, with c. 11 flowers; rachis c. 30 cm long; bracts 7–23 mm long. Flowers 8–9 cm across, weakly and rather unpleasantly scented; sepals and petals olive-green to olive-brown, petals with dark purple dots at base; labellum mainly cream with dark purple spots on mid-lobe and distal part of side lobes, disk white with dark purple markings at base and mainly white ornaments with dark purple mid-line and minutely purple-dotted keels. Dorsal sepal 53–55 by 12–14 mm, oblanceolate, acuminate, minutely mucronate, incurved; lateral sepals similar, oblique, acute, spreading. Petals 49–51 by 10–11 mm, obliquely oblanceolate, acuminate, spreading, slightly incurved. Labellum 34–37 by 30–32 mm when flattened, finely papillose on the ventral side, usually fused to column at the very base; side lobes very obliquely triangular-oblong, rounded, slightly exceeding the column and anther; mid-lobe 16–17 by 16–17 mm, broadly ovate, acuminate, with somewhat raised, undulate sides; ornaments of 2 well-defined, almost parallel ridges extending from the base of the labellum to the base of the mid-lobe. Column 32–34 mm long; pollinia 2.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Medium-sized, epiphytic herb. Pseudobulbs up to 5 by 2.5 cm, elongate-ovoid, bilaterally flattened. Leaves 5–7 per pseudobulb, sessile, up to 30–68 by 1.2–2.9 cm, narrowly ligulate, obtuse, unequally bilobed to oblique at the apex, cartilaginous, stiff, arching. Inflorescence 10–50 cm long, arching to pendulous, with 5–26 flowers; rachis 8–33 cm long; bracts 1.5–4.5 mm long. Flowers 2.5–4.5 cm across; lightly fruit-scented; sepals and petals pale yellow to cream, with a broad, weakly defined central stripe of maroon-brown; labellum cream, the side lobes finely mottled with maroon, the mid-lobe white to yellow at the base, variously spotted or blotched with maroon; ridges cream to yellow, often finely mottled behind with red-brown. Dorsal sepal 16.5–28 by 4–6.5 mm, narrowly oblong to narrowly obovate-ligulate, obtuse to subacute, often mucronate, erect; lateral sepals similar, oblique, spreading. Petals 15–21.5 by 4–6.2 mm, narrowly oblong to narrowly elliptic, obtuse to acute, weakly porrect and spreading. Labellum 12.5–18 by 9.5–15.5 mm when flattened, saccate at the base, minutely papillose to pubescent; side lobes shorter than or as long as the column but not exceeding the anther, obtuse (to subacute); mid-lobe 5.2–8.7 by 6–9.6 mm, broadly elliptic, rounded, usually recurved, minutely papillose to shortly glandular-pubescent, sometimes with an undulating margin; ornaments of 2 ridges that are entire and almost parallel to sigmoid, minutely papillose to minutely pubescent. Column 9–12 mm long, with a column foot; pollinia 2. Capsule 4–6 by 2–3 cm, oblong-ellipsoidal.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Terrestrial herb. Pseudobulbs subterranean, inconspicuous. Leaves usually 5–8 per pseudobulb, up 32–51 by 0.9–1.5 cm, linear-elliptic, acute, erect, margin entire, conduplicate at the base but not petiolate, the lowest leaves making a gradual transition between the cataphylls and the true leaves. Inflorescence 23–43 cm tall, erect, with 4–7 flowers produced in the apical third; bracts 3–22(–25) mm long, often exceeding the pedicel and ovary in length. Flowers about 4–5 cm across; lemon-scented; sepals and petals pale yellow with 5–7 longitudinal red-brown lines; labellum pale green or whitish, sometimes pale yellow, with red-purple streaks on the side lobes that become confluent at the margin, and red-purple spots and blotches on the mid-lobe. Dorsal sepal 25–35 by 5–8 mm, narrowly oblong-elliptic, acute, erect; lateral sepals similar, spreading. Petals 19–29 by 6–9 mm, ovate to elliptic, acute, usually equal to or narrower than the sepals, porrect, usually closely shading the column. Labellum 17–22 mm long when flattened; side lobes rounded, usually angled at the apex, sparsely pubescent or papillose (at least apically); mid-lobe 9–13 by 8–11 mm, oblong to broadly ovate, obtuse or subacute, often as broad as the side lobes when the labellum is flattened, recurved, with some small papillae that are occasionally sparse and almost confined to the apical region, margin entire; disk ornamented by ridges converging in the apical half to form a short tube at the base of the mid-lobe. Column 10–15 mm long; pollinia 4. Capsule 5–7 cm long, fusiform, erect.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Epiphytic herb. Pseudobulbs c. 4 by 2.5 cm, fusiform, slightly bilaterally compressed. Leaves 5–8, sessile, 40–95 by 0.7–1.6(–2.4) cm, linear-elliptic, slightly obliquely acute to acuminate, thickened and coriaceous, dark green, the mid-vein prominent below. Inflorescence 18–30 cm long, peduncle short, suberect to horizontal, with 5–15 flowers; bracts 2–10 mm long. Flowers 4–5 cm across; not usually scented; sepals and petals white or cream with a central maroon stripe that does not reach the apex, rarely suffused wine-red; labellum white, with an orange or yellow spot at the base; side lobes white, veined maroon, with a maroon margin; mid-lobe deep maroon with a basal, triangular, pale yellow stripe that does not reach the apex; ridges white or cream. Dorsal sepal 25–34 by 6–8 mm, narrowly elliptic to oblong-lanceolate, acute or shortly acuminate, margin slightly erose towards the base, erect; lateral sepals similar, oblique and pendulous. Petals 18–28 by 5–7.5 mm, narrowly oblong to elliptic, obtuse to acute, apiculate, porrect and tending to cover the column. Labellum 15–22 by 10–15 mm when flattened; side lobes as long as the column, with porrect, triangular tips subacute at the apex and minutely papillose; mid-lobe 8–12 by 7–9 mm, recurved, ovate, entire, subacute, mucronate to acuminate, minutely papillose, often with minute hairs towards the base and with 2 lines of longer, often glandular, hairs extending from the ridge apices to the centre of the mid-lobe; ornaments of 2 parallel ridges extending from the base of the labellum to the base of the mid-lobe, covered in glandular hairs. Column 11–14 mm long; pollinia 2. Capsule 4–6 by 1.5–2 cm, ellipsoid.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Lithophytic or epiphytic herb. Pseudobulbs represented by a swelling of the base of the shoot, c. 3 by 2 cm; new growths bilaterally flattened, c. 2–3 cm broad, composed of folded, flattened and keeled, distichous, purple cataphylls, from which the 2–4 true leaves emerge. Leaves suberect, 20–49 cm long including the channelled petiole; lamina 17–30 by 3.5–6.2 cm, elliptic, coriaceous, smooth, with a prominent mid-vein, obtuse to subacute, oblique, mucronate, margin entire. Inflorescence 24–44 cm long, pendulous, with about 15–35 closely spaced flowers; bracts 2–5 mm long. Flowers 2.5–3.5 cm across, usually orientated towards one side; not scented; sepals and petals pale yellow to dull green, lightly to heavily mottled with purple brown; labellum purple, the side lobes and the disk cream with maroon mottling, the mid-lobe maroon with 2 deep purple spots at the base. Dorsal sepal 20–29 by 7–10 mm, elliptic, obtuse, erect, with recurved margins; lateral sepals similar, oblique, spreading, pendulous. Petals 16–22 by 6–10 mm, subrhombic, subacute to acute, oblique, spreading. Labellum broad, 14–16(–20) by 10–15 mm, rhombic, papillose, attached to the column foot; side lobes obscure; mid-lobe c. 8 by 8 mm, triangular-ovate, decurved to weakly recurved, obtuse to mucronate; ornaments reduced to 2 swellings at the base of the mid-lobe. Column 11–14 mm long, with a short foot; pollinia 2. Capsule 3.5 by 2 cm, oblong-ellipsoidal.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert
bibliographicCitation: Cymbidium devonianum . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 2, 2014. Pg. 453. Accessed 2022-04-21

description: Terrestrial herb. Pseudobulbs to 3 by 1.5 cm, ovoid, often inconspicuous, occasionally subterranean. Leaves 2–4 per pseudobulb, sessile, up to 29–94 by 0.8–2.5 cm, erect, distally arching, linear-elliptic, acute, the margin usually serrulate towards the apex. Inflorescence 15–67 cm long, with 3–8 flowers in the apical third; bracts 0.4–2.2 cm long. Flowers 3–3.5 cm across; often strongly scented; sepals and petals pale straw-yellow or light brown to green, usually with 5 longitudinal red veins, the petals often with a stronger central stripe and red-brown spots and blotches towards the base; labellum pale yellow or off-white, side lobes streaked red, with a red margin, mid-lobe with red blotches or transverse spots; the red-brown pigment occasionally absent from the flowers, which are then pale green and white in colour. Dorsal sepal 19–31 by 4.6–8.8 mm, narrowly elliptic, acute to oblong, obtuse or mucronate, erect; lateral sepals similar, spreading, almost horizontal. Petals 14–26 by 5.5–9 mm, ovate-elliptic, subacute, shorter and broader than the sepals, porrect but not closely covering the column. Labellum 14–22 mm long when flattened; side lobes rounded, papillose; mid-lobe 6–12 by 6–10 mm, ovate to triangular, acute, minutely papillose, margin undulate, entire; ornaments of 2 ridges, converging in the apical half to form a short tube at the base of the mid-lobe. Column 10–15 mm long; pollinia 4. Capsule c. 6 by 2 cm, fusiform, strongly ridged.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert
bibliographicCitation: Cymbidium ensifolium haematodes. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 2, 2014. Pg. 455. Accessed 2022-04-21

description: Epiphytic or lithophytic herb. Pseudobulbs up to 8 by 5 cm, ovoid, bilaterally flattened. Leaves 4–7, sessile, up to 36–100 by 2.7–6 cm, ligulate, obtuse to emarginate and unequally bilobed at apex, coriaceous and rigid, almost erect. Inflorescence 20–140 cm long, sharply pendulous, with 12–26 well-spaced flowers; rachis c. 25–110 cm long, usually slender and zig-zag above; bracts 1–3 mm long. Flowers 4–5.7 cm across; usually fruit-scented; sepals and petals dull green to straw-yellow, usually suffused with red-brown towards the tips of the sepals and along the centre of the petals; labellum white, side lobes suffused and veined with purple red, mid-lobe yellow in front of the ridges and with a submarginal, U-shaped, purple-red apical blotch and often some other reddish spotting; ridges bright yellow in front, stained purple-red  behind. Dorsal sepal 25–33 by 7–11 mm, narrowly ligulate-elliptic, obtuse, erect, margins revolute; lateral sepals similar, oblique, spreading. Petals 24–30 by 7–11 mm; narrowly elliptic to ovate, obtuse to subacute, porrect, margins revolute. Labellum 24–28 by 14–18 mm when flattened, usually broadest across the side lobes, papillose or with some minute hairs; side lobes usually also exceeding the anther, tips triangular, acute to acuminate, porrect; mid-lobe 11–14 by 11–14 mm, broadly elliptic, obtuse to emarginate, mucronate, recurved, margin undulate; ornaments of 2 parallel, well-defined, raised ridges that terminate abruptly at the base of the mid lobe. Column 15–18 mm long; pollinia 2. Capsule 5–10 by 3–4 cm, oblong-ellipsoidal.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert
bibliographicCitation: Cymbidium finlaysonianum . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 2, 2014. Pg. 457. Accessed 2022-04-21

description: Epiphytic or lithophytic herb. Pseudobulbs 3–6 cm long, 1.5–3.5 cm in diameter, elongate-ovoid, bilaterally flattened. Leaves 4–8 per pseudobulb, sessile, up to 80 by 1.4–2.1 cm, linear-elliptic, acute. Inflorescence up to 70 cm long; rachis slender, arching to pendant, slightly flattened, bearing 6–15 flowers; bracts up to 4 mm long. Flowers up to 14 cm across, with a strong fresh scent; sepals and petals clear apple-green with some deep red spots towards the base, occasionally lightly shaded with red-brown; labellum cream-coloured, becoming greenish at the margin, flushing strong purplish-pink after pollination, side lobes spotted deep maroon, mid-lobe with a submarginal ring of red-brown blotches and spots, and a broken central line of confluent red blotches, base of labellum bright yellow with maroon spots; ridges cream with reddish spots. Dorsal sepal 56–60 by 17–19 mm, narrowly obovate, acute, porrect; lateral sepals similar, spreading. Petals 53–56 by 12–14 mm, ligulate or very narrowly obovate, slightly curved, spreading. Labellum fused to the column base for 4.5–5 mm; side lobes 11–16 mm broad, triangular, acute and porrect, margins ciliate (cilia over 1 mm long), papillose or shortly hairy especially towards the apex; mid-lobe 17–20 by 27–29 mm, broadly ovate-cordate, mucronate, recurved, papillose, sometimes with scattered hairs, never with the central lines of hairs present, margin erose and strongly undulate; ornaments of 2 ridges, tapering to the cavity at the base of the labellum, strongly hairy along the top. Column 33–40 mm long; pollinia 2. Capsule up to 13 by 4 cm, fusiform-ellipsoidal.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert
bibliographicCitation: Cymbidium hookerianum . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 2, 2014. Pg. 458. Accessed 2022-04-21

description: Epiphytic or lithophytic herb. Pseudobulbs up to 13 by 5 cm, bilaterally flattened. Leaves about 9, sessile, up to 90 by 3.5 cm, linear-elliptic, acute. Inflorescence up to 100 cm or more long, suberect to horizontal arching; rachis bearing 12–30(–40) flowers; bracts c. 3 mm long. Flowers up to 10 cm across; not scented; sepals and petals bright apple-green to yellowish or off white, sometimes lightly shaded with red-brown; labellum yellowish to white, side lobes not marked, the mid-lobe with a sharply delimited, deep red, broad, V-shaped, submarginal patch, and a central red line to the ridge apices; the base of the labellum bright yellow or orange, spotted with red-brown; ridges cream or white, occasionally with a few red spots. Dorsal sepal 48–57 by 16–18 mm, narrowly obovate, acute, concave, porrect; lateral sepals similar, spreading. Petals 48–53 by 11–13 mm, ligulate to narrowly obovate, acute, curved, spreading. Labellum fused to the column base for 3–4.5 mm; side lobes 14–16 mm broad, triangular, apex rounded, margin not distinctly fringed, velvety hairy at the front; mid-lobe 14–18 by 15–21 mm, cordate, mucronate, porrect to deflexed, with the indumentum in 2 zones comprising silky hairs in the centre and base and dense velvety hairs on the V-shaped, coloured region, margin of the mid-lobe erose, minutely undulating; ornaments of 2 ridges, not reaching the base of the labellum, spreading behind, dilated at the apex, finely hairy. Column 30–35 mm long; pollinia 2. Capsule c. 6–8 by 3–4 cm, fusiform-ellipsoid.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert
bibliographicCitation: Cymbidium lowianum . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 2, 2014. Pg. 461. Accessed 2022-04-21

description: Terrestrial holomycotroph, without leaves or pseudobulbs. Roots often absent, occasionally produced towards the apex of the rhizome. Rhizome 3–8 mm in diameter, soft, fleshy, tuberculate, with nodes 2–15 mm apart, usually branching, whitish, subterranean. Inflorescence 7–32 cm long, erect, with 3–6 flowers, usually produced terminally on the rhizome or on its side branches; peduncle covered with 4–8, mostly overlapping cataphylls, of which 1–4 are above ground; cataphylls 13–27 mm long, ovate, cymbiform, with a cylindrical sheathing base and a loosely sheathing, spreading, cymbiform apex; bracts 2–17 mm long. Flowers 3–4 cm across; sepals and petals cream to pale yellow or brownish pink with a diffuse, central, purple-red stripe to near the apex; labellum white with red spots on the mid-lobe and purple-red stripes on the side lobes, which become confluent at the margin; ridges white, sometimes stained pink. Dorsal sepal 19–26 by 4–6 mm, narrowly obovate to ligulate, acute, erect; lateral sepals similar, spreading. Petals 14–20 by 5–7 mm, narrowly elliptic, oblique, acute, usually porrect and covering the column. Labellum 12–17 by 9–11 mm when flattened, almost rhombic in outline, subentire to 3-lobed, papillose; side lobes erect, obtuse to subacute at the apex; mid-lobe 5–7 by 4–6 mm, triangular to ligulate, acute to obtuse, recurved, the margin usually undulating; ornaments of 2 ridges, convergent towards the apex, forming a short tube at the base of the mid-lobe. Column 9–13 mm long; pollinia 4. Capsule 3–5 by 0.9–1.2 cm, fusiform to ellipsoid, erect.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert
bibliographicCitation: Cymbidium macrorhizon . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 2, 2014. Pg. 463. Accessed 2022-04-21

description: Epiphytic or lithophytic herb. Pseudobulbs stem-like and inconspicuous within the numerous persistent leaf bases, growing indeterminately, with cauline roots, the older growth appearing flattened and elongated. Leaves 16–17, distichous, up to 64 by 1.8 cm, arching, narrowly ligulate, tapering to an acute, usually unequally bilobed apex with a mucro in the  sinus. Inflorescence c. 25–30 cm long; rachis 5–10 cm long, arcuate or pendulous, not strongly exerted from the sheaths, with 5–15 closely spaced flowers; bracts 2–7 mm long. Flowers c. 6 cm across, not opening widely; almond-scented; petals and sepals white or faintly pink; labellum white, usually with a yellow central patch at the base of the mid-lobe, and bright yellow ridges. Dorsal sepal 43–52 by 8–11 mm, narrowly oblong-elliptic to narrowly obovate, acute, concave, not spreading except towards the tips; lateral sepals similar, curved. Petals 39–49 by 5–7 mm, narrowly ligulate or narrowly obovate, slightly curved, porrect. Labellum 40–44 by 20–24 mm, fused to the base of the column for 3–5 mm; side lobes 10–12 mm broad, lightly clasping the column, minutely hairy, apex broadly rounded to subacute and porrect, margin minutely fringed at the front; mid-lobe 10–13 by 10–13 mm, ovate, rounded or mucronate, porrect, minutely hairy with a dense central and basal patch of short hairs, margin undulating; ornaments of 2 slightly raised, well-separated ridges behind, sometimes minutely auriculate and forming a small trough shaped depression at the base, inflated and converging towards the hairy apex at the base of the mid-lobe. Column 33–36(–40) mm long; pollinia 2. Capsule broadly ellipsoid, c. 3 by 2.5 cm.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert
bibliographicCitation: Cymbidium mastersii . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 2, 2014. Pg. 464. Accessed 2022-04-21

description: Medium-sized, epiphytic herb. Pseudobulbs c. 5 by 2 cm, elongate-ovoid, bilaterally flattened. Leaves 7–9 per pseudobulb, up to 60 by 0.8–1.4 cm, narrowly ligulate, unequally bilobed to oblique at the apex, V-shaped in section, coriaceous, rigid, arching. Inflorescence to c. 50 cm long, suberect to horizontal (often pendulous in fruit), with up to 17 flowers; rachis up to c. 40 cm long; bracts 2–3 mm long. Flowers 3.5–4 cm across; sepals and petals pale yellow  to cream with a broad, central, maroon stripe; labellum white to cream with a yellow central stripe, a single apical maroon spot and usually some sparse maroon markings at the base. Dorsal sepal 17–20 by 7–8 mm, narrowly oblong to elliptic, obtuse or weakly mucronate, erect; lateral sepals similar, oblique, spreading. Petals 17–18 by c. 6 mm, narrowly elliptic, acute, sometimes mucronate, porrect but not covering the column. Labellum c. 15 mm long; side lobes obtusely angled and appearing truncate at the apex, shorter than the column; mid-lobe 8–9 by 5–5.5 mm, ligulate, acute, recurved, minutely papillose margin undulate towards the base; ornaments of 2 entire sigmoid ridges, less inflated in the centre than at either the base or apex. Column c. 8 mm long; pollinia 2. Capsule not seen.

description: Terrestrial herb. Pseudobulbs up to 8 cm long, 5 cm in diameter, ovoid, lightly bilaterally flattened, with 6–10 leaves. Leaves sessile, up to 100 by 0.7–1.8 cm, narrowly linear-elliptic, tapering to an acute apex. Inflorescence 100–150 cm long; peduncle erect, up to 120 cm long, robust; rachis 17–40 cm long, arching, becoming slender towards the tip, with up to 27 closely spaced flowers; bracts 3–15 mm long. Flowers 7 cm across; not scented; sepals and petals white, sometimes with some red spots at the base and over the mid-vein; labellum white, side lobes usually strongly veined maroon-red, mid-lobe yellow at the base and in the centre, striped maroon-red, ridges bright yellow at the tips, paler behind. Dorsal sepal 27–29 by 20–23 mm, obovate, acute, concave, erect or porrect; lateral sepals similar, spreading, slightly drooping. Petals 27–29 by 20–23 mm, narrowly obovate, acute, spreading. Labellum fused to the base of the column for 2–4 mm; side lobes 12–22 mm broad, papillose or minutely hairy, broadly rounded, margin not fringed; mid-lobe 9–10 by 12–13 mm, shortly clawed, triangular to subcircular, acute, recurved, papillose, with a basal and central patch of short, dense hairs, margin entire and undulating; ornaments of 2 ridges, inflated at the apex, tapering to the base, densely hairy. Column 30–32 mm long; pollinia 2. Capsule 4–5 cm long, round to oblong-fusiform.

description: Terrestrial herb. Pseudobulbs up to 3 by 2 cm, ovoid. Leaves 2–4 per pseudobulb, sessile, 40–103 by 2–3.2 cm, linear-elliptic, arching, dark green, glossy. Inflorescence 40–80 cm tall, erect, robust, usually with 8–26 flowers produced in the apical half or third and held above the leaves; bracts 0.4–2.5 cm long. Flowers c. 5 cm across; scented; sepals usually purple-brown, sometimes dark, petals paler, often showing darker veins, occasionally sepals and petals straw-yellow with dark red veins; labellum cream or pale yellow, side lobes streaked red with a solid red margin, mid-lobe heavily spotted and blotched with dark red. Dorsal sepal 26–39 by 5.7–8.7 mm, elliptic, acute, erect to porrect, margins revolute; lateral sepals similar, spreading. Petals 23–34 by 7.1–11 mm, ovate, broader than the sepals, porrect, often forming a hood over the column. Labellum 21–29 mm long when flattened; side lobes erect, rounded, often reduced, papillose or pubescent; mid-lobe broad, 12–16 by 9–13 mm, oblong with an obtuse mucronate apex to ovate, with an acute apex, recurved, often as broad as the side lobes when the labellum is flattened, papillose or with papillose hairs, margin entire and undulating or kinked; ornaments of  2 ridges, converging in the apical half to form a small tube at the base of the mid-lobe. Column 12–16 mm long; pollinia 4. Capsule c. 6 cm long, fusiform, ridged, erect.

description: Lithophytic herb. Pseudobulb up to 3 by 3 cm, lens-shaped, with 2–6 distichous leaves and 4–5 cataphylls; the lower leaves and cataphylls deciduous; mature pseudobulbs wrinkled,  usually with 2–4 apical leaves, not covered by the leaf bases, with nodes towards the base and the apex only. Leaves up to 17–22 by 3–3.5 cm, narrowly elliptic, twisted. Inflorescence 12–23 cm long; peduncle (sub)erect; rachis usually longer than the peduncle, with 2–5 large, distant  flowers; bracts 4–9 mm long. Flowers 4–5 cm across; honey-scented; sepals and petals olive-green to mustard, shaded red-brown and spotted towards the base with purple-brown; labellum white, turning pink on pollination, with almost entirely purple-brown side-lobes, and spots and transverse dashes of red-purple on the mid-lobe; ridges white, spotted purple. Dorsal sepal 37–42 by 8–13 mm, narrowly obovate with recurved margins, obtuse or subacute, mucronate, suberect, curved over the column; lateral sepals similar, narrowly elliptic, decurved, not fully spreading. Petals 34–40 by 5–10 mm, narrowly elliptic, acute, often covering the column. Labellum fused to the base of the column for about 3 mm; side lobes 10–13 mm broad, rounded to subacute, tapering sharply towards the base, erect but not clasping the column, papillose, mid-lobe 12–15 by 11–15 mm, oblong, papillose, recurved, mucronate, margin undulate; ornaments of 2 well-defined, almost parallel, glabrous, inflated ridges extending from the base of the labellum to the base of the mid-lobe. Column 25–30 mm long; pollinia 2.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Epiphytic or lithophytic herb, often with erect aerial roots near the base. Pseudobulbs 5–15 by 2–6 cm, elongate-ovate, bilaterally flattened. Leaves 5–11, sessile, up to 95 by 4 cm, linear elliptic, acute, mid-green. Inflorescence up to 130 cm long, suberect, arching; rachis bearing 10–20 flowers; bracts c. 3 mm long. Flowers up to 15 cm across; scent strong, sweet; sepals and petals yellowish-green to olive-green, strongly stained with irregular, dull, red-brown veins and spots; labellum pale yellow to cream, side lobes veined dark red-brown, mid-lobe marked with scattered spots and vertical dashes of red-brown, with a central reddish stripe almost to the front of the ridges; ridges cream, spotted with red along the crests. Dorsal sepal concave, porrect, 55–80 by 14–19 mm, narrowly obovate, acute; lateral sepals similar, asymmetric and twisted. Petals spreading or reflexed, 54–72 by 8–14 mm, ligulate, usually falcate. Labellum fused to the column for the basal 4–5.5 mm; side lobes 11–16 mm broad, triangular, acute and porrect, margins hairy (hairs over 2 mm long), indumentum otherwise shorter with the hairs mainly pigmented red brown and confined to the veins; mid-lobe 18–21 by 18–30 mm, elliptic, mucronate, recurved, with scattered hairs on the upper surface, except in the centre where there are 3 rows of long hairs from the ridges to the centre of the mid-lobe, margin finely erose, undulate and partially reflexed; ornaments of 2 ridges, tapering towards the base and dilated towards the apex, densely covered in long hairs, with a third line of hairs between them. Column 34–44 mm long; pollinia 2. Capsule up to 15 by 6 cm, fusiform-ellipsoid, stalked, with a 2 cm apical beak.

description: Plant up to 53 cm tall. Stems cane-like, erect-spreading, indeterminate in growth, leafy, up to 42 cm long and 2.7 cm in diameter. Leaves 11–19, distichous, ligulate, unequally bilobed at apex, 6–23.5 by 1.9–2.7 cm; sheaths clasping, 3–5.3 cm long. Inflorescences erect, axillary from upper leaf sheaths, 1- or 2-flowered; peduncle covered by sheaths, cymbiform above; rachis up to 4.4 cm long. Flowers 8–8.5 cm across, sepals and petals pale rose-pink with darker margins; labellum white with an orange-yellow disk and purple spots around the margins; pedicel and ovary 28–38 mm long. Dorsal sepal oblong-oblanceolate, acute, mucronate, 71–72 by 24–27 mm; lateral sepals obliquely oblong, acute, mucronate, 64–65 by 21–23 mm, abaxially costate. Petals obliquely oblanceolate, acute, 66–67 by 21–24 mm. Labellum 3-lobed, fused to column for 4 mm, 66–67 by 21–24 mm; side lobes erect, subtriangular, obtuse, minutely hairy adaxially; mid-lobe porrect, ovate-triangular, acute, undulate, 18–19 by 21 mm; ornaments of 2 parallel ridges confluent and triangular in front, papillose. Column slightly curved, c. 46 mm long, papillose; pollinia 2, deeply cleft.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Very small to medium-sized epiphytic or lithophytic (rarely terrestrial) herbs with short to elongated rhizomes and 1-leaved, clustered to well-spaced pseudobulbs. Foliage leaves long lived, duplicate or (sub)terete, much longer than pseudobulbs. Inflorescences synanthous (to hysteranthous) or heteranthous, racemose, several- to many-flowered, usually arcuate with nodding to pendent rachis; floral bracts persistent, glumaceous, more or less scarious. Flowers usually distichous, less than 2 cm across, often fragrant, most flowers in an inflorescence open at the same time. Sepals and petals free (except for connate lateral sepals in one Philippine endemic). Labellum versatile or firmly attached, entire to fiddle-shaped or 3-lobed, not sigmoidly curved at base, neither spurred nor saccate (except in one Philippine endemic). Column straight to moderately incurved, with or without a pair of stelids (and often prolonged into an apical wing or hood), with or without a solid column foot; anther subterminal, incumbent, versatile; pollinia 4, superposed, entire, solid, with obscure to distinct caudicles; rostellum more or less protruding, producing neither a stipe nor a viscidium; receptive part of stigma concave with more or less elevated margins. Fruit a short-pedicelled, ellipsoid to spherical capsule dehiscing by longitudinal slits.</br></br>A genus of c. 280 species distributed throughout Malesia and reaching Myanmar in the north-west and Taiwan in the north-east; 4 species in Thailand.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert
bibliographicCitation: Dendrochilum  . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 2, 2014. Pg. 474. Accessed 2022-04-21

description: Pseudobulbs clustered on a condensed rhizome, ovoid, 1.3–1.8 cm long, 1–1.3 cm in diameter. Leaves petiolate; petiole 1.2–1.8 cm long; lamina (linear-)lanceolate, (sub)acute, 6.3–9.1 by 1.3–1.4 cm. Inflorescence synanthous; peduncle 3.7–4.5 cm long; rachis 6–7.6 cm long, with 1 appressed non-floriferous bract at base; floral bracts elliptic, acute, mucronate, 4.8–5 mm long, 6- to 7-veined from the base. Flowers (yellowish-)green to greenish-brown with greenish-white column and partially brown labellum. Sepals 3-veined from the base; dorsal sepal lanceolate, acute to acuminate, 6.5–7.1 by 1.6–2 mm; lateral sepals obliquely lanceolate, acuminate, 6.6–7.1 by 1.9–2.3 mm. Petals obliquely lanceolate, acute to acuminate, 6.1–6.3 by 1.7–2.1 mm, subentire, 3-veined from the base. Labellum 3-lobed, 5.6–6.2 mm long, 3.2–3.3 mm wide across side lobes; side lobes falcately linear-triangular, acuminate, 1–1.2 mm long, with erose-dentate hind margins; mid-lobe straight to slightly recurved, broadly elliptic to obovate, rounded, apiculate, 3.4–3.7 mm long, finely rugose-papillose; disk ornamented by 2 fleshy keels united at base with elevated mid-vein to form an M-shape, terminating near the middle of the mid-lobe. Column 3–3.4 mm long, with a bifid apical wing; stelids appearing from the mid portion of column proper, obliquely linear, obliquely subtruncate, reaching the level of the anther or of the apical column wing; anther rounded in front.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Pseudobulbs clustered on a condensed rhizome, fusiform (to subterete), 11–12.8 cm long, (0.6–)1.4–1.8 cm in diameter. Leaves petiolate; petiole 7–10 cm long; lamina narrowly and sometimes obliquely (ob)lanceolate, acute, 33.2–42.5 by 3.8–6.2 cm. Inflorescence synanthous; peduncle 20–31 cm long; rachis 15–22.5 cm long, with 1–2 appressed non-floriferous bracts at base; floral bracts broadly ellipsoid, rounded, sometimes mucronate, 3–5.7 mm long, 7- to 15-veined from the base. Flowers pale green to greenish-yellow with whitish-green column and partially brown labellum. Sepals 3-veined from the base; dorsal sepal linear-lanceolate, acuminate, 6.5–8.7 by 2–2.3 mm; lateral sepals obliquely (linear-)lanceolate, acuminate, 6.6–8.1 by 2.3–2.8 mm. Petals obliquely (linear-)lanceolate, subacute to subacuminate, 6.2–7.5 by 1.6–2.1 mm, (sub)entire, 3-veined from the base. Labellum 3-lobed, 5.9–7.5 mm long, 2–2.5 mm wide across side lobes; side lobes obliquely linear-triangular, acuminate, 0.8–0.9 mm long, entire; mid-lobe straight to slightly recurved, broadly elliptic to obovate, acute to abruptly acuminate, 3.7–4.8 mm long, finely rugose-papillose; disk ornamented by 2 low fleshy keels along outer nerves, extending from just above labellum base and terminating on lower portion of mid-lobe, median vein elevated and thickened for a short distance. Column 4.1–4.5 mm long, with a 4-dentate apical wing; stelids appearing from the mid-portion of column proper, obliquely triangular-oblong, very obliquely subacuminate, reaching the level of the anther; anther obtuse to subacuminate in front.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Pseudobulbs 0.6–5 cm apart on an elongated, often branched rhizome, fusiform to slenderly ovoid or ellipsoid, 1.3–3.3 cm long, 0.2–1.2 cm in diameter. Leaves subsessile to short-petiolate (petiole up to 1.5 cm long); lamina (linear-)lanceolate to oblanceolate (rarely elliptic), acute to obtuse, often mucronate, 4.2–10.8 by 0.8–2.9 cm. Inflorescence heteranthous; peduncle 1–1.9 cm long (almost completely hidden by scale-like cataphylls); rachis 4.8–13.5 cm long, without non-floriferous bracts at base; floral bracts triangular-ovate to semicircular, (sub) acuminate, 1.4–2.8 mm long, 1-veined from the base. Flowers pale yellowish-white to yellow or green. Sepals 2- to 3-veined from the base; dorsal sepal oblanceolate-oblong, obtuse to acute, 2.8–4.7 by 1–1.3 mm; lateral sepals (oblanceolate-)oblong, slightly oblique, obtuse to acute. Petals falcately oblanceolate, rounded to subacute, 2.2–3.5 by 0.7–0.9 mm, 1-veined from the base. Labellum oblong to slightly fiddle-shaped, widest below the middle, obtuse to acute, in its proximal half ornamented by a pair of high, finely rugose-papillose longitudinal keels, otherwise glabrous and smooth. Column 1.2–1.5 mm long, with an emarginate to bifid apical wing; stelids appearing from the mid-portion of column proper, falcately linear-lanceolate, subacuminate, reaching the level of the anther; anther rounded to obtuse in front.

description: Pseudobulbs clustered on a condensed rhizome, oblongoid-fusiform to slenderly fusiform, 3.1–5.5 cm long, 0.4–1.6 cm in diameter. Leaves petiolate; petiole 4.5–7.5 cm long; lamina linear-lanceolate, acute to obtuse, 19.7–28.5 by 1.9–2.6 cm. Inflorescence synanthous; peduncle 24.5–26 cm long; rachis 12–15.8 cm long, with 1 non-floriferous bract at base; floral bracts ovate-oblong, acute to acuminate, sometimes mucronate, 3.2–4.8 mm long, 3- to 7-veined from the base. Flowers bright green to whitish. Sepals  3-veined from the base; dorsal sepal linear to linear-lanceolate, acuminate, sometimes mucronate, 6.8–7.7 by 1.4–1.6 mm; lateral sepals linear-lanceolate, slightly oblique, acute, apically keeled and mucronate, 6.3–7.4 by 1.5–1.8 mm. Petals linear, obtuse to acute, 5.9–7.1 by 1.3–1.5 mm, subentire, 3-veined from the base. Labellum linear to slightly fiddle-shaped with erose margins in its proximal half, rounded, the distal half coiled-up like a butterfly’s proboscis, 5.3–6.5 by 1.5–1.6 mm, minutely rugose papillose, ornamented by 2 keels extending from the base to about half-way to the apex of labellum (and sometimes with a shorter and lower median keel). Column 2.7–2.8 mm long, with a 3- to 4-dentate apical wing; stelids subbasal, obliquely linear, rounded to obtuse, reaching the level of the apical column wing; anther acute to acuminate in front.

description: Small terrestrial, mycoheterotrophic achlorophyllus herbs; rhizome tuberous, oblong to fusiform, fleshy, gradually narrowed to apex; roots filiform. Stems simple, erect, slender, leafless, glabrous. Inflorescence terminal, racemose, with 1 to few flowers; peduncle terete; rachis short, congested, sometimes thickened; floral bracts small. Flowers resupinate, small, erect or spreading. Sepals and petals adnate near their base, forming a 2-lobed short tube; upper lobe formed by dorsal sepal and petals, more or less porrect, adnate for around half their length; lower lobe formed by lateral sepals, porrect, weakly spreading or with distal portions deflexed, connate for slightly more than half their length along ventral margins. Labellum 3-lobed or entire and retuse, mostly broader than long, free from sepals and petals; disk with a 2-lobed callus, sometimes papillate distally. Column elongate, glabrous, with long decurved, falcate stelids  on either side of stigma; without column foot; anther incumbent, born on a distinct filament, blunt; pollinia 4 in 2 pairs, granular, without caudicles; stigma near column apex, funnel-shaped; rostellum small, erect, transverse, viscidium well developed. Fruit a capsule, fusiform to oblong; fruit pedicel erect, strongly elongating until seed dispersal.</br></br>A genus of c. 8 species distributed from Indo-China, southern Japan and Taiwan to Borneo and Sumatra; 3 species in Thailand.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Flowering shoots 20–60 cm tall, erect, dark brown, 3–5 mm in diameter at base, unbranched, nodes with sheaths; sheaths glabrous, ovate, 2–3.5 mm long, acute, chartaceous, base amplexicaul but not very distinct; rhizome fusiform. Inflorescence glabrous; rachis 2–5 cm long, 5- to 10-flowered; bracts triangular-ovate, 1–1.5 mm long, glabrous, caducous. Flowers short- to long-pedicelled, 3–8 mm long; sepals and petals brown with red stripes, white at base of lobes inside. Sepals glabrous; dorsal sepal ovate, 6–7 by 2.5–4 mm, 3-veined, apex obtuse; lateral sepals ovate-oblong, 6–6.5 by 3.5–4.5 mm, 3-veined, apex obtuse. Petals glabrous, orbicular-ovate, more or less of the same size as dorsal sepal, 3-veined. Labellum 3-lobed, 4.5–5 by 6–6.5 mm, with 3 main veins; side lobes white, entire, apex rounded to subtruncate, much  longer than mid-lobe; mid-lobe oblong-lanceolate, apex upcurved, ornamented by a conspicuous yellow 2-lobed callus at base between side lobes. Column white, glabrous, 3–3.5 mm long, erect; with long linear, acute stelids which point downwards on either side of stigma. Capsule dark brown, oblong, 2.5–3.5 cm long, 5–8 mm in diameter.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Flowering shoots 10–28 cm tall, erect, dark brown, 2–4 mm in diameter at base, unbranched, nodes with 2–3 sheaths; sheaths brown, glabrous, very short; rhizome suboblong; roots often with small globose thickenings. Inflorescence glabrous; rachis 0.5–2.5 cm long, 3- to 12-flowered; bracts triangular, 1–2 mm long, glabrous, persistent. Flowers short- to long pedicelled, 0.2–1.2 cm long, brown; sepals and petals white with light brown apex outside, white inside. Sepals glabrous, minutely tuberculate outside; dorsal sepal ovate, 5–5.5 by 2.5–3 mm, 3-veined, apex obtuse or rounded; lateral sepals obovate-oblong, 5.5–6 by 2–2.5 mm, 3-veined, apex rounded. Petals glabrous, orbicular-ovate, slightly wider than dorsal sepal, 3-veined. Labellum unlobed or obscurely 3-lobed, narrowly wedge-shaped, 4.5–5 by 2–2.5 mm, apex truncate or emarginate, slightly inrolled over 2 large pear-shaped calli at apex, with 3 main veins, the middle part thickened and raised throughout the length, base ornamented by 2 small light purple calli near the base of column; side lobes usually obscure, if present deflexed and much shorter than mid-lobe. Column white, glabrous, 3–4 mm long, erect, with long linear, acute stelids which point downwards on either side of stigma. Capsule brown, oblong, 2–2.5 cm long, 2.5–3.5 mm in diameter.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Flowering shoots 10–30 cm tall, erect, dark brown, 2–4 mm in diameter at base, unbranched, nodes with 2–4 sheaths; sheaths brown, glabrous, tubular, 1–2 mm long, chartaceous, base amplexicaul; rhizome fusiform. Inflorescence glabrous; rachis 0.5–1.5 cm long, 3- to 8-flowered; bracts triangular, 0.5–1.5 mm long, glabrous, persistent. Flowers short-to long-pedicelled, 0.2–1.2 cm long, brown; sepals and petals usually brown on both sides, rarely light brown outside and white inside. Sepals glabrous, minutely tuberculate outside; dorsal sepal ovate, 6–8.5 by 3–4 mm, 3-veined, apex acute or obtuse; lateral sepals broadly ovate, 6–7.5 by  3.5–5 mm, 3-veined, apex acute to rounded. Petals glabrous, obliquely orbicular-ovate, much wider than dorsal sepal, 3-veined. Labellum 3-lobed, 6–6.5 by 6.5–7 mm, with 3 main veins; side lobes obliquely quadrangular, 2.5–3 mm broad, white, apex irregularly denticulate, much longer than mid-lobe; mid-lobe suboblong, emarginate, ornamented by a conspicuous white to light purple 2-lobed callus below apex. Column white, glabrous, 3–4 mm long, erect; with long linear, acute stelids which point downwards on either side of stigma. Capsule brown, oblong, 2.5–3 cm  long, 2–3.5 mm in diameter.

description: Small terrestrial, mycoheterotrophic achlorophyllus herbs; rhizome tuberous, horizontal, fusiform to oblong, fleshy; roots filiform, white. Stems simple, erect, slender, leafless, glabrous. Inflorescence terminal, racemose, with 2 to several flowers; peduncle terete; rachis short; floral bracts small, triangular. Flowers resupinate, small, spreading, open in succession, white to pale yellowish-brown. Sepals and petals similar, elliptic-ovate; dorsal sepal and petals united at the very base; lateral sepals united for up to 1/3 of their length and with the base of column foot. Labellum 3-lobed, broadly cuneate, fleshy, attached to the apex of column foot and articulate at joint, apex truncate or slightly emarginate; disk ornamented by irregular papillose calli at base and at apex. Column stout, glabrous, with a distinct column foot, dilated at apex and with 2 wings, wings attenuate into stelids which point downwards on either side of stigma; column foot elongate, with rows of tiny red blotches; anther terminal; pollinia 4, granular; rostellum small, erect, transverse; stigma broad, placed directly below rostellum. Fruit a capsule.</br></br>A genus of 1 species distributed from Hainan to Indo-China; 1 species in Thailand.

description: Flowering shoots 10–25 cm tall, erect, green, 1–2 mm in diameter at base, unbranched, nodes with 3–5 sheaths; sheaths glabrous, ovate, 1–2 mm long, acute, chartaceous, base amplexicaul; rhizome irregularly fusiform, 3–7 by 0.5–1 cm. Inflorescence glabrous; rachis  0.5–1 cm long, 3- to 10-flowered; bracts triangular-ovate, 0.5–1.5 mm long, glabrous, persistent. Flowers spreading, short- to long-pedicelled, 0.5–1.2 cm long; sepals and petals white, 3-veined. Sepals glabrous; dorsal sepal ovate, 3–5 by 0.8–1.2 mm, apex obtuse; lateral sepals ovate-elliptic, 3.5–5 by 0.9–1.5 mm, apex obtuse to rounded. Petals glabrous, obliquely ovate-elliptic, 3.5–6 by 1–1.2 mm, apex acute to obtuse. Labellum 3-lobed, broadly cuneate, 10–12 by 5–7 mm, attached  to column foot and articulate at joint; side lobes suboblong, white, entire, upwards and inwards curved, apex rounded to subtruncate, much longer than mid-lobe, 4- to 5-veined; mid-lobe short, pale yellowish-brown, apex emarginate, margin undulate; disk ornamented by 2 large irregular papillose calli at base between side lobes and scattered minute calli at apex. Column white, stout, glabrous, 1.5–2 mm long; with long broad stelids which point downwards on either side of stigma; column foot deflexed, 4–5 mm long, with rows of tiny red blotches.

description: Terrestrial, achlorophyllous, mycoheterotrophic, rhizomatous, erect herbs; rhizome tuberous, fusiform or moniliform; roots arising from neck between rhizome and aerial stem; aerial stem slender, with a few scale-like sheaths near base, leafless, glabrous. Inflorescence terminal on the new shoot, racemose; floral bracts small. Flowers resupinate, spreading. Sepals and petals connate at base, forming a short tube; upper 3 lobes formed by dorsal sepal and petals, joined for approximately half their length, more or less porrect; lower 2 lobes formed by lateral sepals, joined for more than half their length, porrect, deflexed distally, adnate to column foot; perianth lobes more or less tuberculate. Fruit an erect capsule; pedicel elongating rapidly during fruit-ripening.</br></br>A genus of c. 12 species distributed from S Africa, tropical Africa, Madagascar and tropical mainland Asia through Malesia to Australia and the SW Pacific islands; 5 species in Thailand.

description: Flowering shoots 10–12 cm tall, erect; rhizome tuberous, cylindric to fusiform, 3–4 by 0.2–0.6 cm; roots few, filiform, arising from neck at the top of rhizome; aerial stem erect, leafless, slender, with 3–5 scale-like sheaths, glabrous; sheaths tubular, 1–2 mm long, acute. description: Terrestrial, rarely lithophytic or epiphytic herbs; rhizome short. Stems tall, clustered, stout, cylindrical, glabrous, leafy above, covered by sheaths below. Inflorescence terminal, racemous or sparingly to much branched, many-flowered; peduncle terete, with several sterile bracts; rachis cylindrical; bracts longer than ovaries, spathaceous, conspicuous, papery, caducous. Petals free, linear-lanceolate, smaller than sepals. Labellum 3-lobed, without spur; mid-lobe entire, apex reflexed; disk ornamented by 3–5 smooth to verruculose keels from base to apex of labellum; side lobes erect. Column clavate, somewhat incurved, narrowly winged; without column foot; anther 4-locular; pollinia 8 in 2 groups of 4, solid, bilaterally compressed, without caudicles; stigma semi-circular; rostellum a broad flap, not forming a stipe or viscidium. Fruit a capsule, subglobose to ellipsoid.</br></br>A genus of c. 8 species distributed from Indo-China, Borneo, Maluku, Java, Sumatra, Philippines, Sulawesi to New Guinea; 1 species in Thailand.

description: Flowering shoots 1–1.5 m tall, terrestrial or low-growing epiphyte; rhizome short. Stems stout, placed close together on rhizome, 6–7 mm in diameter; sheaths 3–6 cm long, apex acute. Foliage leaves mostly elliptic-lanceolate, the lower ones near stem base ovate, 9–15 by 3–6 cm, apex acute to acuminate, base often sessile. Inflorescence terminal, erect, to 15 cm long, with a few or no branches; peduncle with several sterile bracts; rachis slender, 3–6 cm long; floral bracts ovate-lanceolate, 2–2.5 cm long, apex acute to acuminate, concave. Flowers 10–15, usually facing the same way, not opening widely; pedicel and ovary slender, 10–20 mm long. Sepals lanceolate, 25–30 by 6–8 mm, apex acute, dull yellow inside, more or less purplish-pink outside. Petals similar to sepals but slightly narrower. Labellum yellow or yellowish-green marked with purplish-red, 3-lobed, suboblong, 15–20 by 7–12 mm, ornamented by 3 keels which extend almost the whole length; side lobes triangular, erect, incurved; mid-lobe red with yellow erose margins, ovate, apex recurved. description: Small to very large terrestrial, autotrophic (east of Wallace’s line also leafless mycoheterotrophic) herbs with underground rhizomes. Stems scrambling or climbing. Leaves numerous, duplicate, distichous, brittle-fleshy. Inflorescences lateral from upper leaf axils, racemose, lax. Flowers resupinate, most or all open at the same time. Sepals and petals subsimilar, with pink to purple or brown spots which are bold on the dorsal surface, weak on the ventral surface. Labellum proximally 3-lobed in front of a concavity or shallow sac; disk pressed tightly against the column, fleshy, ornamented by 1 or 2 calli at base and 2 pubescent lateral keels that mostly converge before terminating on the mid-lobe; side lobes porrect, held alongside the column; mid-lobe usually saddle-shaped, more or less hairy. Column porrect, stout, slightly recurved, without a foot, ventral side concave at base and with a pubescent mound centrally and rounded lateral wings for part of its length; anther versatile; pollinia 2, partly cleft, with tiny caudicles; stipe a V- or U-shaped tegule with 2 arms arising from a rectangular to transversely oblong body; viscidium small, slipper-shaped.</br></br>A genus of c. 21 species distributed from Indo-China across all of Malesia to eastern Australia and the SW Pacific islands; 2 species in Thailand.

description: Flowering shoots 40–60(–80) cm tall, slightly compressed, leafy throughout or basal part covered in dry sheaths. Leaves erect; lamina linear, acute, 12.3–23.2 by 0.8–1.6 cm. Inflorescences erect, longer than leaves, 6- to 8-flowered; floral bracts 3–5 mm long. Flowers mainly white to cream with pink to purple spots (column yellow in apical part). Sepals straight to recurved, glabrous; dorsal sepal oblong, obtuse to rounded, 18.1–19.6 by 7–7.3 mm; lateral sepals obliquely (obovate-)oblanceolate, obtuse to acute, 21.3–24.6 by 6.1–7.8 mm. Petals more or less recurved, obliquely oblanceolate, acute, 19–20.9 by 6.1–6.8 mm. Labellum 22.8–25 by 8.4–9 mm when flattened, shallowly saccate at base; disk densely villose-velvety, becoming tomentose distally, basal callus hemispherical and slightly longitudinally furrowed, lateral keels arising from front of callus and merging on base of mid-lobe; side lobes obliquely (linear-)triangular, obtuse to rounded, 1.8–2.5 mm long (measured along the front margin); mid-lobe saddle-shaped, ovate-elliptic when flattened, subacuminate to obtuse, 15.1–17.1 mm long, densely villose throughout its median part, lateral parts glabrous. Column 8–10 mm long, winged in its distal third; anther in front prolonged into a beak about half as long as the body; stipe (tegule) V-shaped, c. 1.5 mm long, arms (linear-)oblong, about twice as long as the body. Ovary (including pedicel) terete, 21–25 mm long.

description: Terrestrial (very rarely lithophytic), sympodial herbs producing erect leafy shoots from a wiry, rooting rhizome. Foliage leaves alternate, sessile, plicate. Inflorescences terminal on leafy shoots, racemose, lax, often secund; rachis pubescent; floral bracts herbaceous. Flowers resupinate, spreading to pendent, mainly greenish or yellowish (sometimes with purple to maroon suffusion or markings). Sepals and petals free; sepals more or less pubescent on the dorsal side. Labellum firmly attached, porrect, differentiated into hypochile and epichile. Column stout (less than 3 times as long as anther), without column foot; anther dorsal, elongated, versatile, yellow; pollinia 2, mealy, partly cleft, pyriform to clavate, devoid of caudicles; rostellum producing a diffuse viscidium, but no stipe; receptive part of stigma flat. Ovary and pedicel more or less pubescent, pedicel twisted through 180. Fruit a capsule dehiscing by 6 longitudinal slits.</br></br>A genus of c. 25 species with a natural distribution encompassing an area ranging from Europe and the Mediterranean through southern and eastern Asia to Japan and NE Russia, an area ranging from the southern corner of the Arabian peninsula to tropical Africa, and an area in western North America (besides, one species has colonized much of North America as a naturalized exotic); 1 species in Thailand.

description: Leafy shoots densely gregarious from a branched, creeping rhizome, 18–85 cm tall; stem bearing 2–3 cataphylls, 4–7 sheathing foliage leaves and 0–2 small, non-sheathing leaves. Foliage leaves ovate to elliptic or linear-lanceolate, acute to acuminate, 1.7–11.2 by (0.3–)0.5– 5.8 cm. Inflorescence 1- to 14-flowered; rachis flexuous, 3.5–21 cm long; floral bracts spreading to suberect, ovate to lanceolate or elliptic, acute to acuminate, 5–47 mm long. Flowers long pedicelled, wide-open, mainly greenish-yellow (sepals and petals often with maroon margins, labellum cream to pale yellow and often with orange to maroon markings/suffusion). Sepals shallowly boat-shaped; dorsal sepal lanceolate (to lanceolate-oblong), (sub)acute, 8–10.1 by 2.5–3.9 mm; lateral sepals obliquely ovate to falcately lanceolate, acute, 8.9–11 by 2.7–4.6 mm. Petals recurved (apices often meeting behind the dorsal sepal), lanceolate to oblong, obtuse to rounded, 7–9.4 by 2.3–3.8 mm. Labellum 8.3–9.8 mm long, 6.3–8.2 mm wide across side lobes when flattened; hypochile concave with 2 erect, obliquely oblong to subtriangular, rounded side lobes, in its proximal to middle part ornamented by 2 adjoining keels furnished with tiny orange warts and ending in 2 oblongoid calli; epichile elastically attached, broadly oblanceolate to oblong-subspathulate, obtuse to rounded, ornamented by 2 marginal ridges proximally and a small shiny drop-like callus just above the middle. Column 5.4–6.2 mm long; stigma with 2 low swellings at base. Ovary (including pedicel) slenderly fusiform, 11–17 mm long.

description: Terrestrial, mycohetrotrophic herbs with a horizontal corm; devoid of roots. Flowering shoots erect; stem hollow, fragile, glabrous, pale brownish-white. Leaves alternate, membranous, scale-like, sheathing (below) or non-sheathing (above). Inflorescence racemose, usually lax; floral bracts membranous, glabrous. Flowers resupinate or non-resupinate, pendent. Sepals and petals free, glabrous. Labellum with (at least partially) papillose ornaments, spurred at base. Column stout, glabrous, without stelids and column foot; anther subterminal, versatile; pollinia 2, granular, longitudinally furrowed, with filiform caudicles; receptive part of stigma flat. Ovary long-pedicelled, glabrous. Fruit a capsule dehiscing by 6 longitudinal slits; pedicel not elongating during fruit ripening.</br></br>A genus of 3–4 species distributed in tropical Africa and from Europe across Siberia to Kamchatka and Japan, further south through E and SE Asia to Malesia, NE Australia and the SW Pacific Islands (east to Fiji); 1 species in Thailand.

description: Corm ellipsoid (to oblongoid), 1.4–3.9 cm long, 0.6–1.9 cm in diameter. Flowering shoots 13–48 cm tall; stem 2–9 mm in diameter at base, 1–4 mm just below rachis; scale leaves 5–9. Inflorescence 3- to many-flowered; rachis 4–20 cm long; floral bracts lanceolate to ovate or broadly elliptic, obtuse to acuminate, 5–17.3 by 2–8.7 mm, entire. Flowers resupinate, not opening fully, translucently white, labellum sometimes with purplish markings. Sepals 3-veined from the base; dorsal sepal linear, rounded to subacute, 7.7–10.2 by 1.9–2.1 mm; lateral sepals narrowly linear-lanceolate, slightly oblique, obtuse to subacuminate, 8.4–10.6 by 1.7–1.8 mm. Petals linear-lanceolate, slightly oblique, rounded to subacute, 7.4–9.6 by 2.1–2.3 mm, 3-veined from the base. Labellum boat-shaped, ovate, at apex abruptly tapering into a broad, rounded to obtuse apiculum, 8.9–10.4 by 7.4–8.5 mm when flattened, more or less erose, ornamented by 2 longitudinal, papillose keels throughout its length and distally with a much shorter, papillose median keel; spur parallel to the ovary, cylindric to subclavate, rounded to slightly indented at apex, 3.1–3.6 mm long. Column incurved, 2.4–2.8 mm long; anther strongly vaulted, broadly elliptic-oblong in upper view, rounded to truncate in front, 1.8–2.2 mm long, releasing the pollinia directly onto the stigma. Ovary ellipsoid, 3.5–8.5 mm long; pedicel 1.5–9 mm long. Capsule ellipsoid, 5–8 mm long, 4–6 mm in diameter.

description: Epiphytic herbs with pseudobulbous stems, evergreen. Flowering shoots to 70 cm tall. Pseudobulbs adjacent, with several fibrous leaf sheaths. Foliage leaves normally 2 on the apex of the pseudobulb, plicate, perennial, lanceolate-elliptic, petiolate, present during flowering. Inflorescences erect, unbranched or branched, arising from the base of the leafy shoot, usually as long as or longer than the foliage leaves; floral bracts persistent. Flowers few, medium-sized or large, resupinate, strongly veined with red or brown. Dorsal sepal free, hood-like; lateral sepals spreading, basally connate to form a short mentum together with the column foot. Petals free, reflexed. Labellum simple, spurless, without ornaments, mobile. Column with a prominent column foot, glabrous; anther incumbent, versatile, with 8 pollinia in 2 groups of 4.</br></br>A monotypic genus distributed in the eastern Himalayas, Myanmar, Thailand, Vietnam and SW China.

description: Flowering shoots 50–70 cm tall. Pseudobulbs conical-ovate, sometimes 5-angled, glabrous, 2.8–4.5 by 2.5–3 cm. Foliage leaves lanceolate-elliptic, acute, glabrous, 48–66 by (2.2–)3.8–6.9 cm; petioles 8–20 cm long. Inflorescences lax, pubescent; peduncles 20–30 cm long; sterile bracts mostly 6, lanceolate, acute, to 3.5 cm long; rachis 20–40 cm long, 4- to 20-flowered; floral bracts lanceolate, acute, 7–16 by 3–7 mm. Flowers 20–25 mm in diameter; fragrant; yellow or green with prominent red or brown longitudinal lines. Sepals elliptic-lanceolate, subacute, pubescent on the dorsal side and subglabrous or sparsely pubescent on the ventral side; dorsal sepal (13.5–)15–18.5 by 3–5 mm; lateral sepals 12–16.5 by 3–6 mm. Petals linear-oblong, obtuse, glabrous, 13–17.5 by 1–2 mm. Labellum entire, elliptic, strongly curved, mobile, apex ornamented by 2 small lateral callosities, glabrous, to 15 by 3–5 mm. Column broadly winged, 5–7.5 mm long, with a column foot 4–7 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) pubescent and with hair-like ramentae, 28–41 mm long. Capsule ellipsoid, 18–40 by 5–7 mm.

description: Terrestrial, sympodial herbs with corms, a fleshy rhizome or pseudobulbs that are naked or covered with thin sheaths; autotrophic or mycoheterotrophic. Foliage leaves permanently absent in mycoheterotrophic taxa; in autotrophic taxa 1 to few per corm or pseudobulb, plicate or duplicate, deciduous, present or absent at the time of flowering; leaf bases usually forming a pseudostem. Inflorescence lateral, erect, racemose or paniculate, lax to moderately dense. Flowers resupinate, all or nearly all open at the same time. Sepals and petals free, more or less spreading, devoid of markings (at least on the dorsal side). Labellum firmly attached, not fused with column, saccate or spurred at base. Column glabrous, straight to slightly incurved, devoid of stelids; column foot flat or spurred, sometimes absent; anther subterminal, incumbent, versatile, usually with 2 small horn-like processes on top; pollinia 2, hard and bony, partly cleft; rostellum producing a strap-shaped, rounded to acute (rarely emarginate) tegule and a usually obtriangular to crescent-shaped or transversely linear viscidium; fertile part of stigma concave. Fruit a capsule dehiscing by longitudinal slits.</br></br>A genus of c. 230 species distributed in tropical and southern Africa, Madagascar, the Mascarenes, the Arabian peninsula, Indo-Malesia (with extensions to adjoining temperate parts of Asia), northern and western Australia, the SW Pacific islands and tropical America; 14 species in Thailand.

description: Plant with pseudobulbs above ground (or partly buried). Pseudobulbs obliquely terete conical to (conical-)fusiform, 2.5–8 cm long, 1.3–2.9 cm in diameter. Foliage leaves 3–7, present at anthesis, leaf bases forming a 1–6 cm long pseudostem; free part of each leaf linear to narrowly lanceolate, acute to acuminate, (3–)5.5–20(–44.5) by 0.5–1.4(–1.9) cm. Inflorescence racemose,  (15–)24–74 cm tall, lax, 5- to many-flowered; peduncle green, 7.5–24.5 cm long; floral bracts shorter than ovaries. Flowers suberect to spreading, opening widely, mainly green to brownish-green (labellum white with green margins and maroon veins). Sepals acute to acuminate, sometimes mucronate; dorsal sepal linear to narrowly lanceolate, 11–16.2 by 1.2–3.7 mm; lateral sepals obliquely linear to (ob)lanceolate-linear, 12.2–18.6 by 1.5–3.8 mm. Petals obliquely (linear-)lanceolate, acute to acuminate, sometimes mucronate, 9–13.8 by 1.8–3.7 mm, glabrous. Labellum 3-lobed, 8–12.2 by 5–11.6 mm when flattened, widest across mid-lobe, spurred at  base, glabrous on the ventral surface; mid-lobe obovate to elliptic or suborbicular, rounded, margins undulate; ornaments of 3 entire to somewhat warty keels starting from the labellum base and terminating on the mid-lobe (lateral keels shorter than the median); spur subclavate, straight to slightly incurved, 3–4 mm long. Column 3–4.8 mm long; column foot subequal to column proper, not forming a spur. Ovary (including pedicel) 10–24 mm long. Capsule pendent, (ellipsoid-)fusiform, 2.5–2.9 cm long (excluding pedicel and perianth remnants), 1–1.4 cm in diameter.

description: Plant with pseudobulbs above ground. Pseudobulbs conical, slightly compressed, c. 6 cm long, c. 3.5 cm in largest diameter. Foliage leaves 4–5, present at anthesis, leaf bases forming a short pseudostem; free part of largest leaf narrowly linear to linear-oblanceolate, acute to acuminate, 20–30 by 1–2 cm. Inflorescence stout, racemose, 25–39 cm tall, lax, 7- to 14-flowered; peduncle green, 16–19 cm long; floral bracts shorter than ovaries. Flowers spreading, opening widely, mainly olive-green flushed dull brown (labellum white with brown markings). Sepals acuminate, mucronate; dorsal sepal linear, 9.4–11 by 1.5–1.8 mm; lateral sepals obliquely linear-lanceolate, 11–12.2 by 1.6–1.9 mm. Petals obliquely (linear-)lanceolate, acuminate, 7.5–8.9 by 1.4–1.9 mm, glabrous. Labellum 3-lobed, 7.4–7.7 by 3.9–4.5 mm when flattened, widest across side lobes, spurred at base, glabrous on the ventral side; mid-lobe oblanceolate, rounded to subtruncate, margins straight; ornaments of 3 fleshy, slightly undulate keels extending from the labellum base to about half-way along mid-lobe; spur subcylindric, slightly complanate, slightly incurved, 3–4 mm long. Column 3.7–4.5 mm long; column foot much shorter than column proper, flat. Ovary (including pedicel) to c. 16 mm long. Capsule not seen.
