description: Plant with underground corms. Corms fusiform to conical, 3.5–7 cm long, 1.3–3.2 cm in diameter. Foliage leaf solitary, produced after anthesis, at base tapering into a c. 35 cm long petiole; lamina linear, acute to acuminate, c. 50 by c. 1.2 cm. Inflorescence racemose, 85–91 cm tall, dense, 16- to 18-flowered; peduncle green, 77–84 cm long; floral bracts subequal to or longer than ovaries. Flowers suberect to nodding, opening about half-way, mainly green to pale  purplish or white (sepals and petals with darker veins, labellum with purple keels and veins). Sepals acute to acuminate; dorsal sepal (linear-)oblanceolate, 12.2–16.6 by 3.2–4 mm; lateral sepals obliquely (linear-)oblanceolate, 13.7–19 by 3.9–5.1 mm. Petals obliquely (rhombic-)obovate, rounded to acute, 10.5–11.2 by 5–6 mm, glabrous. Labellum 3-lobed, 11.5–14 by 7.3–10.9 mm when flattened, widest across side lobes, slightly spurred at base, glabrous on the ventral surface; mid-lobe broadly obovate to suborbicular, retuse to emarginate, margins more or less undulate; ornaments of 2 prominent (proximally confluent) keels extending from bottom of spur to distal part of disk, and 3 warty, keel-like callosities extending from distal part of disk to mid-lobe; spur conical, straight, 1–1.5 mm long. Column 5.5–6 mm long; column foot at least half as long as column proper, not forming a spur. Ovary (including pedicel) 10–17.8 mm long. Capsule not seen.

description: Plant with underground corms. Corms ovoid to subspherical, 2.5–3.2 cm long, 2–3.5 cm in diameter. Foliage leaves unknown. Inflorescence slender, racemose, 39–43 cm tall, lax, 12- to many-flowered; peduncle maroon without any trace of green, 16–24 cm long; floral bracts shorter than ovaries. Flowers suberect to pendent, opening widely, mainly brown to yellowish-green (labellum with bright yellow disk and mid-lobe). Sepals acute; dorsal sepal linear-oblanceolate, c. 9 by c. 2.5 mm; lateral sepals obliquely linear-lanceolate, c. 9 by c. 2.5 mm. Petals linear to linear-lanceolate, subacute, c. 7.5 by c. 1.5 mm, glabrous. Labellum 3-lobed, 7.5–8 by 4.5–5 mm when flattened, widest across side lobes, spurred at base, glabrous on the ventral side; mid lobe oblong to broadly ovate, rounded, margins straight to slightly undulate; ornaments of 3 low, minutely tuberculate keels extending from the spur mouth to near the labellum apex; spur cylindric, slightly to strongly incurved, c. 3.5 mm long. Column c. 4 mm long; column foot absent. Ovary (including pedicel) 10–15 mm long. Capsule not seen.

description: Plant with underground corms. Corms irregularly subterete, 5–7 cm long, 1.1–1.7 cm in diameter. Foliage leaves 2–3, not present at anthesis, leaf bases forming a pseudostem; free part of each leaf linear-lanceolate, acuminate. Inflorescence racemose, 38–96 cm tall, lax, 4- to 13-flowered; peduncle (glaucous-)green flushed reddish, 26–70 cm long; floral bracts shorter than ovaries. Flowers more or less spreading, opening widely, mainly brown to maroon (petals cream turning light brown; labellum pink in centre, green laterally; column white). Sepals rounded to  subacuminate; dorsal sepal elliptic-oblong to broadly oblanceolate, 14–18.9 by 3.8–6.6 mm; lateral sepals obliquely oblong to oblanceolate, 14–20.2 by 3–7 mm. Petals obliquely (ovate-) oblong, rounded, 11.2–16 by 5.3–9.4 mm, glabrous. Labellum entire (to obscurely 3-lobed), ovate, rounded, 10–15 by 8.8–13.8 mm when flattened, broadly saccate at base, glabrous on the ventral side, margins straight to somewhat undulate; ornaments of 2 (in their middle part prominent) entire keels starting from the bottom of the sac and terminating close to the labellum apex. Column 7–9.5 mm long; column foot much shorter than column proper, not forming a spur. Ovary (including pedicel) 14–25 mm long. Capsule not seen.

description: Plant with underground corms. Corms irregularly ovoid to obconical, 3–8 cm long, 3–8 cm in diameter. Foliage leaves 2–4, developing during anthesis, leaf bases forming a 12–30 cm long pseudostem; free part of each leaf oblong-lanceolate to oblong-elliptic, acuminate, 25–50 by 4.5–10 cm. Inflorescence racemose, 30–170 cm tall, lax, many-flowered; peduncle green, 13–70 cm long; floral bracts shorter than ovaries. Flowers spreading to nodding, opening widely, lemon-yellow with purple or crimson spots inside labellum sac. Sepals  acute; dorsal sepal narrowly elliptic, 34.6–35.7 by 13.8–14.3 mm; lateral sepals obliquely elliptic, 35.5–37.5 by 14.9–16.1 mm. Petals obovate, rounded, 28.6–29.1 by 19.2–19.8 mm, glabrous. Labellum 3-lobed, 29.1–30.8 by 26.5–31 mm when flattened, widest across side lobes, saccate at base, verrucose inside sac; mid-lobe broadly spathulate, rounded to retuse, margins straight; ornaments of 3 verrucose keels extending from near the labellum base to about half-way along mid-lobe (median keel sometimes obscure, especially towards the labellum base). Column 16–17 mm long; column foot much shorter than column proper, flat. Ovary (including pedicel) 31–41 mm long. Capsule not seen.

description: Plant with pseudobulbs above ground (or partly buried). Pseudobulbs (conical-)ovoid to oblongoid, 3–8.5 cm long, 2–4.6 cm in diameter. Foliage leaves 4–5, present at anthesis, leaf bases forming a 1–5 cm long pseudostem; free part of each leaf narrowly linear to linear lanceolate, acuminate, 11–46 by 0.3–1 cm. Inflorescence racemose or paniculate, 39–79 cm tall, lax, 12- to many-flowered; peduncle green, 16–41 cm long; floral bracts shorter than ovaries. Flowers spreading, opening widely, mainly (brownish-)green (labellum white with mostly purplish-red ornaments). Sepals acuminate, often mucronate; dorsal sepal linear-oblanceolate, 10.5–14.3 by 2–3 mm; lateral sepals linear-oblanceolate, slightly oblique to slightly falcate, 11.2–15.5 by 2.2–2.8 mm. Petals obliquely lanceolate, acuminate, 9.6–10.9 by 2.6–3.3 mm, glabrous. Labellum 3-lobed, 10.4–13.5 by 7–8.4 mm when flattened, widest across side lobes, spurred at base, glabrous on the ventral side; mid-lobe broadly elliptic to obovate, rounded to obtuse, often apiculate or mucronate, margins undulate; ornaments of 3–5 prominent, often branched keels extending from the labellum base to the mid-lobe where they produce numerous long tubercles; spur subclavate, slightly incurved, 3.1–3.5 mm long. Column 4.7–5 mm long; column foot much shorter than column proper, not forming a spur. Ovary (including pedicel) 11.2–21 mm long. Capsule pendent, ellipsoid, 1.6–3.1 cm long (excluding pedicel and perianth remnants), 0.7–1.2 cm in diameter.

description: Plant with underground corms. Pseudobulbs ovoid to conical, 1.4–2.8 cm long, 1–2.2 cm in diameter. Foliage leaves 2–3, present at anthesis, leaf bases forming a 6–13 cm long pseudostem; free part of each leaf (linear-)lanceolate, acuminate, 11.5–23 by 0.8–3 cm. Inflorescence racemose, 22–35 cm tall, lax, 3- to 11-flowered; peduncle green, 15–26 cm long; floral bracts shorter than, as long as or longer than ovaries. Flowers spreading to suberect, opening widely, mainly (yellowish-)green (petals white, labellum white flushed yellowish-green at base). Sepals acuminate; dorsal sepal linear-lanceolate, 16–21 by 2.8–4 mm; lateral sepals obliquely linear-lanceolate, 16–23 by 3–4 mm. Petals obliquely elliptic-oblong, rounded to acuminate, 12–14 by 3.5–6 mm, glabrous. Labellum 3-lobed, 12–17 by 6–8 mm when flattened, widest across side lobes, spurred at base, densely papillose to tuberculate on all longitudinal veins, indumentum continuing as 5–7 rows onto the mid-lobe; mid-lobe broadly oblong, rounded to retuse, margins straight; labellum devoid of ornaments other than papillae/tubercles; spur cylindrical to subclavate, straight to slightly curved, 2–3 mm long. Column 7–8 mm long; column foot much shorter than column proper, flat. Ovary (including pedicel) 13–27 mm long. Capsule not seen.

description: Plant with underground corms. Corms ellipsoid-fusiform, 1.5–1.8 cm long, 0.5–0.7 cm in diameter. Foliage leaves 3–4, present at anthesis, leaf bases forming a 3–7 cm long pseudostem; free part of each leaf narrowly (oblanceolate-)linear, acute to acuminate, 4–45 by 0.3–0.7 cm. Inflorescence racemose, 25–51 cm tall, lax, 1- to 3-flowered; peduncle green, 20–43.8 cm long; floral bracts shorter than ovaries. Flowers suberect, opening widely, mainly green to purplish-red (labellum white with purple centre). Sepals obtuse to acute; dorsal sepal linear-oblanceolate, 23–28 by 4–6.1 mm; lateral sepals obliquely linear-oblanceolate, 21–28.1 by 4–6 mm. Petals obliquely oblong to oblanceolate, obtuse to acute, 15.5–19.7 by 6–8.9 mm, pubescent along the mid-line on the ventral side. Labellum fiddle-shaped, widest in its distal part, rounded to retuse, 19–25 by 15–17.5 mm when flattened, spurred at base, continuously papillose-pubescent to pilose on major parts of the ventral side, margins straight in proximal part, more or less undulate in distal part; ornaments of 5–7 low (sometimes obscure) keels extending from the labellum base to near the apex; spur cylindric, slightly incurved, 8.5–15 mm long. Column 7–9.2 mm long; column foot absent. Ovary (including pedicel) 14–21 mm long. Capsule not seen.

description: Plant with underground corms. Corms subspherical, c. 2 cm in diameter. Foliage leaf solitary, present at anthesis, proximal part of petiole together with cataphylls (of which the uppermost one may have a lamina up to 10 cm long) forming a 10–30 cm long pseudostem; lamina linear-lancelate to oblanceolate, acute, 25–45 by 1.9–4.3 cm. Inflorescence racemose, 38–72 cm tall, lax, 7- to 12-flowered; peduncle green, 28–52 cm long; floral bracts shorter than, as long as or longer than ovaries. Flowers nodding to pendent, opening about half-way, mainly cream to greenish-yellow or pale brown (labellum usually mauve to purple). Sepals obtuse; dorsal sepal elliptic, c. 14 by c. 7 mm; lateral sepals obliquely elliptic, c. 14.5 by c. 6 mm. Petals obliquely obovate-elliptic, rounded, c. 11 by 5.8–6.4 mm, glabrous. Labellum linear-oblong, rounded, 14.6–15 by 4.6–6.1 mm when flattened, spurred at base, glabrous on the ventral side, margins straight to slightly undulate; ornaments of 3–5 parallel, low (sometimes obscure) keels extending from (near) the labellum base to near the apex where they become verrucose-tuberculate; spur cylindric, geniculate in its distal part, 3.3–4.5 mm long. Column c. 7 mm long; column foot absent. Ovary (including pedicel) 15–23 mm long. Capsule not seen.

description: Plant with underground corms. Corms subterete to more or less ovoid, 1.2–2.8 cm long, 0.5–2 cm in diameter. Foliage leaves 2–4, present at anthesis, leaf bases forming a 1–7 cm long pseudostem; free part of each leaf narrowly linear to linear-lanceolate, acute to acuminate, 4–35 by 0.3–0.7 cm. Inflorescence racemose, 24–43 cm tall, lax, 2- to 8-flowered; peduncle green, 17–30 cm long; floral bracts shorter than or subequal to ovaries. Flowers suberect to  spreading, opening widely, mainly brown (labellum usually pink with green spur, rarely white with pink indumentum; sepals often greenish distally, petals often pink distally). Sepals obtuse to acute; dorsal sepal narrowly oblanceolate, 15.5–17 by 1.1–3.3 mm; lateral sepals obliquely oblanceolate to linear, 15.4–18 by 1.2–3.3 mm. Petals oblong to obliquely oblanceolate, rounded, 10.9–11.5 by 2.4–4.8 mm, glabrous. Labellum oblanceolate to somewhat fiddle-shaped, rounded to emarginate, 11–13.7 by 4–7.7 mm when flattened, spurred at base, almost continuously papillose-pubescent to pilose on the ventral surface, margins straight in proximal part, more or less undulate in distal part; ornaments of 5(–7) low (sometimes obscure) keels extending from the labellum base to near the apex; spur cylindric, straight to slightly incurved, 4–5.2 mm long. Column 4.8–6 mm long; column foot absent. Ovary (including pedicel) 14–25 mm long. Capsule pendent, fusiform, 2.7–3.5 cm long (excluding pedicel and perianth remnants), 0.7–1.1 cm in diameter.

description: Plant with underground corms. Corms subspherical to ellipsoid, 3–4.5 cm long, 1.3–3.9 cm in diameter. Foliage leaves 2–3, present at anthesis, leaf bases forming a 6–31 cm long pseudostem; free part of each leaf narrowly lanceolate, acuminate, 6–52 by 0.7–7.2 cm. Inflorescence racemose, 19–75 cm tall, lax, 6- to 16-flowered; peduncle green, 11–49 cm long; floral bracts shorter than or subequal to ovaries. Flowers spreading, opening half-way or less, mainly rose-coloured to dark reddish-green or purplish-red (petals and labellum often whitish, labellum often with purplish veins and tinged yellow at centre); apochromic forms occur occasionally. Sepals acuminate; dorsal sepal (linear-)lanceolate, 17.3–30 by 4.5–7 mm; lateral sepals obliquely to falcately (linear-)lanceolate, 19.2–34 by 4–5 mm. Petals obliquely ovate to oblanceolate, obtuse to acute, 17.8–23 by 7–8.5 mm, glabrous. Labellum (oblong-) ovate to somewhat fiddle-shaped or weakly 3-lobed, rounded to retuse, 17–27 by 14–15 mm when flattened, spurless, glabrous on the ventral side, margins straight in proximal part, undulate in distal part; ornaments of 5–9 (often low) keels extending from the labellum base to near the apex where they are verrucose. Column 8–10 mm long; column foot subequal to column proper, forming a prominent, obliquely conical spur. Ovary (including pedicel) 14–29 mm long. Capsule not seen.

description: Plant with an underground rhizome. Rhizome horizontal, fleshy, 7–16 cm long, 1.5–2.5 cm in diameter. Foliage leaves never recorded in Thailand. Inflorescence stout, racemose, 38–74 cm tall, dense to fairly lax, 13- to many-flowered; peduncle purplish-red to yellowish-brown or greenish, 21–47 cm long; floral bracts shorter than, equal to or longer than ovaries. Flowers suberect to nodding, opening widely, dull purplish-red to brownish-yellow. Sepals acuminate; dorsal sepal elliptic, 15–22.4 by 7–11.3 mm; lateral sepals obliquely oblong, 18–24.7 by 5.8–11.5 mm. Petals obliquely obovate, obtuse to acuminate, 12–17.6 by 7–11.1 mm, glabrous. Labellum 3-lobed, 14.8–19 by 14.8–19.8 mm when flattened, widest across side lobes, with a sac-like spur at base, more or less continuously pubescent on ventral surface (except for the marginal zone); mid-lobe (triangular-)semielliptic, obtuse to acute or subacuminate, margins straight to slightly undulate; ornaments of 2 keels extending from spur or proximal part of disk to mid-lobe, in central part of disk raising to form distinct ridges (1–5 other longitudinal veins may be slightly thickened); spur obliquely conical, 4.5–5.8 mm long. Column 7–7.7 mm long; column foot slightly to distinctly shorter than column proper, not forming a spur. Ovary (including pedicel) 12–23 mm long. Capsule not seen.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Terrestrial, achlorophyllus, mycoheterotrophic herbs; rhizome horizontal, tuberous, fusiform to oblong; roots arising from neck between rhizome and aerial stem, filiform; aerial stem erect, with a few scale-like sheaths near base, leafless. Inflorescence terminal, racemose; floral bracts small. Flowers resupinate or non-resupinate. Sepals forming a tubular synsepal, often verrucose outside; distal part shallowly 3-lobed; the 2 anterior lobes separated by a deep sinus. Petals apparently attached on the sinus between dorsal and lateral sepals, usually smaller than sepals (and therefore, in reality, fused with sepals for almost their entire length). Labellum attached to apex of column foot and free from sepals and petals or attached on the sinus between lateral sepals, without spur, usually ornamented by 2 calli near base, often with thickened median  band-like keels or calli distally. Column elongate, winged distally, with a pair of tooth-like stelids at apex, with a distinct column foot; anther born on a filament, incumbent, subquadrate, more or less retuse; pollinia 2, granular, without caudicles; stigma shield-like, born on a raised projection at base of column; rostellum porrect, transverse, producing a suborbicular viscidium. Fruit an erect capsule; pedicel elongating rapidly during fruit ripening.</br></br>A genus of c. 65 species distributed from NE India through E Himalaya, S China, Taiwan, Japan, E Siberia and SE Asia to E Australia and the SW Pacific islands; also in tropical Africa, Madagascar and the Mascarenes; 6 species in Thailand.

description: Flowering shoots 10–40 cm tall, erect; rhizome tuberous, 2–5 by 0.2–0.8 cm; roots 3–5, filiform, to 3 cm long, white, arising from neck at the top of rhizome; aerial stem erect, leafless, slender, with 3–6 scale-like sheaths, glabrous; sheaths tubular at base of stem, bract-like above, 1–2.5 mm long, acute. Inflorescence laxly 3- to 15-flowered, glabrous; floral bracts ovate to ovate-lanceolate, to 5 mm long, tuberculate outside, acute to rounded, concave, caducous. Flowers white to whitish-pink, urn-shaped, 0.8–1 cm long, opening in succession (only one at a time); pedicel and ovary 2–5 mm long. Sepals connate, forming a tube, 9–10 mm by 6–7 mm; free portion shallowly 3-lobed, ovate, rounded, margins erose to laciniate, 3-veined; the 2 anterior lobes separated from each other by a deep sinus; tube slightly gibbous at base. Petals attached on the sinus between dorsal and lateral sepals, ovate, 2.5–3.5 by 2–3 mm, rounded, margins  erose to laciniate, 3-veined. Labellum free, ovate to ovate-oblong, 3.5–5 by 2–3 mm, apical margin irregularly crenate, obtuse to subtruncate, lateral margins erect or incurved, irregularly crenate, base with 2 small subglobose calli; disk ornamented by oblong-ellipsoid keels above the middle on either side of mid-vein, 5- to 7-veined. Column slender, 3–4 mm long, slightly curved, laterally winged towards apex; stelids c. 2 mm long; rostellum a thickened cushion, slightly emarginate. Capsule oblong-ellipsoid, 0.8–1 by 0.4–0.6 cm, with elongated pedicel.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Flowering shoots 80–100 cm tall; rhizome horizontal, irregularly cylindric or fusiform, 4–8 by 2–3 cm, pubescent; roots filiform, to 8 cm long; aerial stem erect, slender, with 2–5  distant, scale-like sheaths, glabrous; sheaths tubular at base of stem, bract-like above, 1–3 mm long. Inflorescence laxly 5- to 25-flowered, glabrous; floral bracts (triangular-)lanceolate, 2–5 mm long, punctate outside, caducous. Flowers pale pink to white, tubular, 1–2.2 cm long, opening in succession (only one at a time); pedicel and ovary 2–5 mm long. Sepals subequal, connate, forming a tube, 10–18 by 5–8 mm; lobes ovate-triangular, obtuse to rounded, entire to slightly erose, 3-veined; the posterior lobe slightly hooded; the 2 anterior lobes spreading, separated from each other by a deep sinus; tube slightly gibbous at base. Petals attached on the sinus between dorsal and lateral sepals, orbicular, 2–3 mm in diameter, rounded, erose, 3-veined. Labellum parallel to column, the lower half adnate to lateral sepals, with a pair of linear-oblong, 4–5 mm long papillate calli, the free part ovate, 6–7 by 5–6 mm, slightly 3-lobed, with long claw; mid-lobe oblong, rounded or slightly emarginate, apical margin fimbriate, lateral margins erect or incurved, rounded, entire; disk ornamented by 4–7 elliptic-oblong keels. Column slender, 10–15 mm long; stelids acute; rostellum a thickened cushion, slightly emarginate; stigma at base of column. Capsule ellipsoid to oblong-obovoid, 1–1.5 by 0.4–0.6 cm.

description: Flowering shoots 3–10 cm tall, erect or ascending; rhizome tuberous, fleshy, suboblong, 3–4 by 0.5–0.7 cm, pubescent, with fibrous roots; aerial stem leafless, slender, with 2–3 scale-like sheaths, glabrous; sheaths tubular at base of stem, bract-like above, 1–3 mm long, acute. Inflorescence laxly 3- to 5-flowered, glabrous; rachis pinkish-white; floral bracts ovate-lanceolate, to 6 mm long, punctate outside, acute, slightly concave, caducous. Flowers dark pinkish-brown, widely campanulate, 1.8–2.5 cm long, fleshy; pedicel and ovary 8–18 mm long. Sepals connate, forming a tube, 5–6 by 5–7 mm, smooth outside; free portion equally 3-lobed, orbicular-ovate, obtuse to rounded, 3-veined; tube not gibbous at base. Petals attached on the sinus between dorsal and lateral sepals, ovate-oblong or oblong, 3.5–4 by c. 2 mm, obtuse to rounded, margins entire, 1-veined. Labellum adnate to synsepal for most of its length (apparently attached to sinus between lateral sepals), similar to petals, base without calli; disk smooth, without ornaments. Column clavate, c. 4 mm long, with an elongate, forked appendage on ventral surface, 4.5–5 mm long; stelids c. 0.6 mm long, acute, bent backwards. Capsule oblong to oblong-obovoid, 1.8–2.5 by 0.5–0.6 cm, with elongated pedicel.

description: Flowering shoots 3–10 cm tall, erect; rhizome tuberous, fleshy, 1.5–5 by 0.6–1.5 cm, pubescent; roots 2–4, filiform, to 8 cm long, white, arising from neck at the top of rhizome, glabrous; aerial stem erect, leafless, slender, with 2–4 scale-like sheaths, glabrous; sheaths tubular at base of stem, bract-like above, 1.5–5 mm long, acute. Inflorescence laxly 3- to 5-flowered, subumbellate in appearance, glabrous; floral bracts ovate-lanceolate, to 8 mm long, slightly punctate outside, acute, concave, caducous. Flowers white to whitish-cream, obliquely tubular, 1.5–1.8 cm long, not opening widely, fleshy; pedicel and ovary 2–5 mm long. Sepals connate, forming a tube, 10–14 by 6–7 mm, sometimes slightly striated with obscure irregularly warty ridge-like keels outside; free portion shallowly 3-lobed, ovate, verrucose, acute, hooded, margins subentire, vein obscure; the 2 anterior lobes separated from each other by a deep  sinus; tube slightly gibbous at base. Petals attached on the sinus between dorsal and lateral sepals, ovate-oblong, 1.5–2 by c. 1 mm, acute, margins entire, vein obscure. Labellum free, ovate, 4.5–5 by 2–2.5 mm, apical margin irregularly denticulate, acute to obtuse, lateral margins erect, subentire, base with 2 small subglobose calli; disk ornamented by oblong-ellipsoid keels above the middle on either side of mid-vein, 5-veined. Column slender, 4–4.5 mm long, straight, laterally winged towards apex; rostellum lacking; stelids c. 1.5 mm long. Capsule oblong ellipsoid, with elongated pedicel.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert
bibliographicCitation: Gastrodia theana . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 2, 2014. Pg. 530. Accessed 2022-04-21

description: Flowering shoots to 10 cm tall, erect; rhizome tuberous, fleshy, 2.5–3 by 0.8–1 cm, pubescent, with fibrous roots; aerial stem erect, leafless, slender, with 2–3 scale-like sheaths, glabrous; sheaths tubular at base of stem, bract-like above, 2.5–7 mm long, acute. Inflorescence laxly 3- to 5-flowered, subumbellate in appearance, glabrous; rachis dark brown; floral bracts ovate-lanceolate, to 10 mm long, punctate outside, acute, slightly concave, caducous. Flowers pale brown, campanulate, 2.3–2.5 cm long, opening widely, fleshy; pedicel and ovary 8–12 mm long. Sepals connate, forming a tube, 7–10 by 7–8 mm, verrucose outside; free portion 3-lobed, orbicular-ovate, verrucose, dorsal sepal emarginate, 7-veined; the 2 anterior lobes separated from each other by a deep sinus, apex acute, hooded; tube slightly gibbous at base. Petals attached on the sinus between dorsal and lateral sepals, orbicular-ovate, 4.5–5 by 4–5 mm, obtuse, margins erose, 3-veined. Labellum free, ovate-lanceolate, 6–7 by 4–5 mm, apical margin irregularly dentate, concave, blunt acute-obtuse, lateral margins erect, subentire, base with 2 small globose calli; disk ornamented by a thickened emarginate median band above the middle, 7-veined. Column 7–8 mm long, straight, laterally winged at apex; rostellum lacking; stelids c. 1 mm long. Capsule not seen.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert
bibliographicCitation: Gastrodia verrucosa . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 2, 2014. Pg. 531. Accessed 2022-04-21

description: Corms triangular-ovoid, 4–4.5 cm long, 3–3.5 cm in diameter. Leaves 3–4, fully developed (or very nearly so) at the time of flowering, at base forming a distinct (up to 28 cm long) pseudostem; laminas elliptic-oblong to oblanceolate-oblong, (4.1–)11.7–36.2 by (1.8–)4.3–9.1 cm. Inflorescence 11.2–37.5 cm long, usually shorter than the vegetative shoot, 5- to 28-flowered; peduncle 2.5–4.5 mm in diameter, major part freely exposed between 5–7 widely spaced sheaths at the time of flowering; floral bracts acute to acuminate, 5–30 by 1–6.5 mm. Flowers mainly (greenish-)white to purplish-pink (proximal part of labellum usually with maroon to purplish-red or pale brown markings, distal part white to pink or bright yellow with red to maroon markings and/or a sulphur-yellow blotch). Sepals 3- to 5-veined; dorsal sepal oblanceolate-oblong, obtuse to acute, 7.5–17.2 by 2.3–5.7 mm; lateral sepals oblanceolate oblong, slightly oblique, obtuse to acute, 8–19.5 by 2.2–5.9 mm. Petals obovate to oblanceolate-oblong, obtuse to acute, 6.5–16(–19.5) by 2.6–8.6 mm, 5- to 7-veined. Labellum 6.8–15 by 4.1–10 mm in its natural conformation (up to 17.5 mm wide when flattened), sometimes abruptly narrowed about one third below apex, 3.4–7.2 mm wide 2 mm below apex, margin erect to slightly incurved proximally, flat to recurved or revolute distally; apex truncate, retuse; labellum ornamented by a basal, fleshy, V-shaped callus and 2–3 obscure to prominent and occasionally confluent verrucose keels extending from the central to distal part of labellum. Column 3–5.3 mm long. Capsule not seen.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert
bibliographicCitation: Geodorum densiflorum . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 2, 2014. Pg. 533. Accessed 2022-04-21

description: Corms triangular-ovoid, up to 3.2 cm long, up to 2.8 cm in diameter. Leaves 3–4, not fully developed at the time of flowering (and pseudostem not always recognizable at this stage); laminas oblanceolate-oblong, up to 28.7 by 7.2 cm. Inflorescence 7–15(–20) cm long, distinctly shorter than the vegetative shoot, 4- to 16-flowered; peduncle 2.5–4 mm in diameter, completely covered (or very nearly so) by 4–5 closely spaced (often overlapping) sheaths at the time of flowering; floral bracts acuminate, 4–21 by 0.8–5 mm. Flowers mainly white (sepals and petals rarely with a faint greenish hue; proximal part of labellum white with purplish-red to orange markings, distal part yellow). Sepals 3- to 7-veined; dorsal sepal oblanceolate-oblong to obovate oblong, acute, 9.6–18.2 by 2.6–6.9 mm; lateral sepals more or less obliquely lanceolate-oblong, acute, 10–18.7 by 2.8–7.9 mm. Petals oblanceolate-oblong to obovate-oblong, acute 9.3–15.9 by 3.2–9.7 mm, 3- to 7-veined. Labellum 9.5–15.5 by 6–10 mm in its natural conformation (up to 15.5 mm wide when flattened), sometimes (very) abruptly narrowed about one third below apex, 4.5–6.5 mm wide 2 mm below apex, margin erect to slightly incurved proximally, flat to recurved or revolute distally; apex truncate, retuse; labellum ornamented by a basal, fleshy, more or less V-shaped callus and often 2 obscure, verrucose (sometimes confluent) keels in its central and/or distal part. Column 3.5–5.3 mm long. Capsule oblongoid, up to 4 cm long, up to 1.5 cm in diameter.

description: Corms triangular-ovoid, up to 4 cm long, up to 2.7 cm in diameter. Leaves 2–3, not fully developed at the time of flowering (and pseudostem not yet recognizable above ground); laminas oblanceolate-oblong, elliptic-oblong or obovate, 10–30 by 3.4–5.5 cm. Inflorescence  8–33 cm long, usually longer than the vegetative shoot, 2- to 25-flowered; peduncle 2–3.5 mm in diameter, major part freely exposed between 3–5 widely spaced sheaths at the time of flowering; floral bracts acuminate, 3–11 by 0.9–5 mm. Flowers either green to greenish-yellow (often with a yellow blotch on central to distal part of labellum) or mainly white (proximal part of labellum in that case with purplish-red to maroon markings, central to distal part with a bright yellow blotch). Sepals 3- to 5-veined; dorsal sepal oblanceolate-oblong, acute, 7.9–16 by 1.7–6.2 mm; lateral sepals oblanceolate-oblong, slightly oblique, acute, 8.7–16.1 by 2.2–6.3 mm. Petals oblanceolate-oblong to obovate-oblong, acute, 8.1–17.2 by 2.4–7.6 mm, 3- to 7-veined. Labellum 7.5–16.5 by 5.1–8 mm in its natural conformation (up to 14.5 mm wide when flattened), sometimes (very) abruptly narrowed about one third below apex, 2.8–7 mm wide 2 mm below apex, margin erect to slightly incurved proximally, flat to recurved or revolute distally; apex truncate, retuse; labellum ornamented by 2–3 obscure, verrucose (sometimes confluent) keels in its distal part. Column 2.5–4.5(–8) mm long. Capsule oblongoid, up to 3 cm long, up to 1.5 cm in diameter.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Corms triangular-ovoid, up to 3.8 cm long, up to 2.7 cm in diameter. Leaves 2–3, fully developed (or very nearly so) at the time of flowering, basally forming a distinct (up to 24 cm long) pseudostem; laminas elliptic-oblong to obovate-oblong, (8–)21.9–31 by (2.8–)7–10 cm. Inflorescence 12–33(–41) cm long, usually shorter than the vegetative shoot, 7- to 9-flowered; peduncle c. 4 mm in diameter, major part freely exposed between 3–5 widely spaced sheaths at the time of flowering; floral bracts acuminate, 6–36 by 1–5.5 mm. Flowers mainly cream to pale greenish-yellow (labellum with maroon streaks and lines, in its distal part often merging to form a large maroon blotch). Sepals 5- to 7-veined; dorsal sepal oblanceolate-oblong, acuminate, (16.5–)20–33.8 by 4–7 mm; lateral sepals oblong, slightly oblique, acuminate, 17.8–35 by 3.4–7.2 mm. Petals oblanceolate-oblong, acute, 16.5–31.6 by 5.5–11.2 mm, 5- to 9-veined. Labellum 15.5–24.8 by 7–12 mm in its natural conformation (up to 20 mm wide when flattened), not abruptly narrowed in its distal part, 5–8.8 mm wide 2 mm below apex, margin more or less revolute all way round; apex obtuse to rounded, sometimes retuse; labellum ornamented by a basal, fleshy, broadly V-shaped callus and often 2 verrucose keels, sometimes extending for almost the entire length of labellum. Column 5.5–9.5 mm long. Capsule oblongoid, up to 5 cm long, up to 2 cm in diameter.

description: Epiphytic or terrestrial, autotrophic herbs. Stems elongate, often branching. Foliage leaves many per shoot, distichous, sheathing at base; sheath glabrous or hairy, smooth or verrucose; lamina duplicate, sometimes nearly terete. Inflorescence a subsessile, strongly condensed, 1- to many-flowered raceme, when young enveloped by a transparent, sometimes hairy or verrucose spathe. Flowers resupinate or not. Sepals and petals free, except for the lateral sepals that are often connate at base (rarely also connate with the dorsal sepal). Labellum adnate to proximal part of column, spurred or saccate at base, devoid of ornaments or with a transverse callus at base of the flat part. Column stout, straight to slightly incurved; column foot solid or absent; anther subterminal, incumbent, versatile; pollinia 4, solid, with connate caudicles; rostellum not producing a stipe, but sometimes a diffuse viscidium; receptive part of stigma concave. Ovary glabrous or hairy. Fruit a capsule, circular to triangular in transverse section, dehiscing by longitudinal slits.</br></br>A genus of c. 100 species distributed in Sumatra, Java, Sulawesi, Philippines, Maluku, New Guinea and the SW Pacific islands (east to Samoa), and with isolated records from Thailand and Laos; 1 species in Thailand.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert
bibliographicCitation: Glomera  . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 2, 2014. Pg. 541. Accessed 2022-04-21

description: Medium-sized to very large, robust epiphytic, rarely lithophytic or terrestrial herbs. Roots stiff, acuminate, branching, of two types: erect catch-roots that trap detritus, and normal spreading roots. Stems clustered, pseudobulbous, either (1) very elongate, very fleshy and many-leaved, covered in leaf-sheaths or (2) rather short and thick, sometimes of a single node, ovoid, conical or shortly fusiform, not covered in leaf-sheaths, distally few-leaved. Leaves distichous, plicate, long and narrow, flexible, tough and coriaceous, acutely articulated to short sheathing base. Inflorescences lateral, simple, erect, horizontal or pendulous, a laxly many-flowered raceme, flowers mostly open simultaneously; floral bracts triangular, acute, often fleshy and concave, persistent. Flowers resupinate, medium-sized to large, often showy, long-lasting, yellow, variously marked with brown or maroon. Sepals and petals spreading, similar, oblong, sometimes concave, usually obtuse; lateral sepals sometimes falcate. Labellum much smaller, 3-lobed, fused at the base to the base of the column, usually hairy; disk ornamented by 2 or 3 ridges. Column 15–20 mm long, clavate, arcuate, foot absent, but often with a concave basal outgrowth; pollinia 2, deeply cleft, each joined by a caudicle to a separate outgrowth from the laterally extended, more or less crescent-shaped viscidium.</br></br>Approximately 10 species distributed in SE Asia, from Myanmar to Borneo, north to the Philippines and eastwards to New Guinea and the Solomon Islands; 1 species in Thailand.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert
bibliographicCitation: Grammatophyllum  . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 2, 2014. Pg. 542. Accessed 2022-04-21

description: A large epiphytic or rarely terrestrial herb, often forming a large clump. Pseudobulbs clustered, erect at first then pendent, stem-like, cylindrical, many-noded, leafy in the apical part, dull yellow, 3–7 m long, c. 5 cm in diameter. Leaves several, arranged in 2 rows, linear, acute, 50–100 by 3 cm, drooping from the base when older. Inflorescences up to 2 m or more long, densely many-flowered, bearing a few well-spaced, distorted, sterile flowers near the base; peduncle stout, cylindrical, up to 1.6 cm in diameter; bracts somewhat reflexed, linear-lanceolate, acute. Flowers almost flat, large, up to 10 cm across; sepals and petals pale or greenish yellow, heavily spotted with maroon-brown, the labellum yellow with red-brown veins on the side lobes and red-brown marks on the mid-lobe; sterile flowers fragrant, with 2 sepals and petals but lacking a labellum and column. Sepals spreading, elliptic-spathulate, obtuse or rounded, 40–55 by 16–20 mm. Petals spreading, elliptic, obtuse, 40–55 by 22–26 mm, with somewhat undulate lateral margins. Labellum 3-lobed, lacking a spur, 25–30 mm long; side lobes erect, curved over the column, obliquely semi-circular-rounded, pubescent on veins; mid-lobe slightly deflexed, ovate, obtuse, 10 mm wide, pubescent on veins; disk ornamented by 3 short ridges. Column 14–20 mm long, with an outgrowth on each side at the base, joined to the base of the labellum to form a saccate hollow. Pedicel and ovary 4–10 cm long, off-white.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Normally terrestrial pseudobulbous herbs. Pseudobulbs ovoid and irregularly swollen, adjacent, usually underground. Foliage leaves 1 or 2 on top of the pseudobulb, plicate, erect, linear-lanceolate, puberulous, petiolate, absent during flowering (at least in the only species known from Thailand). Inflorescences erect, arising from the base of the pseudobulb, puberulous; sterile bracts present, sheathing; flower-bearing part racemose, few-flowered; floral bracts  persistent. Flowers large, mostly golden-yellow in extra-Thai species, greenish-brown with  purple markings in the Thai species. Sepals free; dorsal sepal hooded over the column; lateral sepals spreading. Petals free. Labellum spurless, 3-lobed, without ornaments in the Thai species. Column slender, more than 10 mm long, straight or apically forward-curved, puberulous, with a prominent column foot; anther incumbent, versatile, with 8 clavate pollinia. Pedicel not distinctly set-off from ovary.</br></br>Three species in southern India and Sri Lanka and one recently discovered species in Thailand.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert
bibliographicCitation: Ipsea  . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 2, 2014. Pg. 545. Accessed 2022-04-21

description: Flowering shoots 12–18.5 cm tall. Pseudobulbs conical, 3‒4.5 by 2‒3.4 cm. Foliage leaves 3‒4, narrowly elliptic-oblong, acute to acuminate, 8.5‒21.1 by 1.6‒3.2 cm, glabrous, shortly petiolate. Inflorescences lax, pubescent; sterile bracts 2–5, tubular, 0.8–1 cm long; rachis short, 1- to 3-flowered; floral bracts ovate-lanceolate, acute, pubescent, 10–15 by c. 6 mm. Flowers greenish-brown with purple markings on the column front side and the labellum side lobes, anther yellow. Sepals elliptic-lanceolate, subacute, pubescent on the dorsal side, papillose-hairy on the ventral side; dorsal sepal hooded, 20–27 by 9–12 mm; lateral sepals similar but slightly narrower, spreading or curved forwards. Petals elliptic-obovate, spathulate with a linear  basal portion, obtuse, 14–27 by 4–5 mm, pubescent. Labellum 15–20 by 21–25 mm, base narrow and sigmoid, 3-lobed above, without keels and calli, pubescent and ciliate on the margins, surface with a longitudinal hairy furrow in its basal part; mid-lobe projecting forwards, rectangular with  truncate apex, 8–12 by 2.6–5 mm; side lobes falcate, subacute, erect, distal margins long-hairy, 10–12 by 3.7–6.5 mm. Column slender in its basal part but widened above, apical part forward-curved, 13–15 mm long; with a 3–5 mm long hairy column foot. Ovary (including pedicel) pubescent, 12–19.5 mm long. Capsule not seen.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert
bibliographicCitation: Ipsea thailandica . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 2, 2014. Pg. 545. Accessed 2022-04-21

description: Epiphytic or lithophytic herbs; rhizome stout, creeping; roots fibrous. Pseudobulbs close together, ovoid-cylindric to conical, sheathed. Foliage leaves 2 per pseudobulb, relatively large, plicate, chartaceous, petiolate, long-lived. Inflorescence racemose, proteranthous, pendulous; peduncle covered by sheaths at anthesis; floral bracts large, persistent. Flowers resupinate, white, large, not opening widely; pedicel and ovary cylindric, 3-ridged. Sepals similar, fleshy, united and saccate at base. Petals shorter and narrower than sepals, base not saccate. Labellum 3-lobed near apex, side lobes erect, embracing column, base saccate and enclosed in basal sac of lateral sepals, mid-lobe ornamented by 2–5 wavy keels near apex. Column curved, long, dilated and flattened at apex, without stelids; anther subterminal, incumbent; pollinia 4, in 2 pairs, waxy, oblong-pyriform, base with flat caudicles; stigma concave; rostellum triangular, prominent, not forming a stipe. Fruit a capsule, with 6 longitudinal ridges, apex with persistent column.</br></br>A genus of 1 species distributed in NE India, Nepal, Bhutan, Myanmar, China, Laos and northern Vietnam; 1 species in Thailand.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert
bibliographicCitation: Neogyna  . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 2, 2014. Pg. 547. Accessed 2022-04-21

description: Flowering shoots 25–40 cm tall; rhizome terete, 7–8 mm in diameter. Pseudobulbs ovoid cylindric to conical, 8–15 cm by 1–2 cm, sheathed at base, sheaths membranous. Foliage leaves elliptic-oblanceolate, 15–35 by 3–7 cm, apex acute, base attenuate, lamina glossy green; petiole 3.5–6 cm long. Inflorescence glabrous, to 35 cm long; peduncle 10–25 cm long, with broadly overlapping sheaths at base, sheaths 2–3 cm long; rachis straight or slightly flexuous, 5–12 cm long; floral bracts ovate-orbicular, 15–35 by 5–15 mm, apex obtuse to rounded. Flowers 5–12; pedicel and ovary 8–15 mm long. Sepals white, abaxially ridged, with basal sac; dorsal sepal oblong, 35–45 by 4–8 mm, apex obtuse, 5-nerved; lateral sepals falcate-oblong, slightly narrower than dorsal sepal, apex acute to obtuse, 5-nerved. Petals white, linear, 35–45 by 3–5 mm, apex acute, 3-nerved. Labellum white, 3-lobed, obovate, 35–45 by 20–25 mm; mid-lobe yellow, subreniform, apically cleft; side lobes ovate, rounded; disk ornamented by 2–3 longitudinal wavy bright yellow keels. Column white, 30–40 mm long. Capsule obovoid-ellipsoid, 3–3.5 by 1.5–2 cm.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert

description: Terrestrial, rhizomatous herbs; the creeping and ascending stem-like rhizome rooting from its nodes, internodes green, dark green or purple with brown spots or bands. Flowering shoots terminal, erect from a decumbent base, 15−25 cm tall. Foliage leaves 3−5(−7), alternate, sometimes crowded on the distal part of the stem, plicate, glabrous, petiolate; laminas cordate at base. Inflorescence racemose to spicate, glabrous, green with purple or brown spots or bands; bracts oblong-lanceolate. Flowers 5−15, non-resupinate. Sepals subsimilar, connate at the base, curled or more or less reflexed, 3-veined, glabrous, margins undulate. Petals adnate to the sepals  at the base, curled or reflexed. Labellum basally adnate to the column, clawed, sometimes differentiated into hypochile, mesochile and epichile, margins glabrous or pubescent and undulate; proximal part glabrous or pubescent, spurred at base; central part (finely) pubescent to more or less papillose, distal part ornamented by a short or long lamellate tufted crest. Column straight, semiterete with the margins developed into wings; stigma bipartite, flat; rostellum elliptic; stipe and viscidium absent; anther horn-like; pollinia 8 in 2 groups of 4, solid, with caudicles. Fruit a capsule dehiscing by 6 longitudinal slits.</br></br>A genus of c. 11 species distributed from the eastern Himalaya to S China, Indo-China and Malesia; 2 species in Thailand.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert
bibliographicCitation: Nephelaphyllum  . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 2, 2014. Pg. 549. Accessed 2022-04-21

description: Flowering shoots 10−20 cm tall, internodes 4−6 by 0.5−0.7 cm, green or dark green with purplish spots or bands. Foliage leaves 1−3, crowded on upper part of stem, uniformly pink, or purplish with pale red spots or bands on upper surface, pink, dark purple or green on lower surface; petiole 3−4 cm long; lamina broadly ovate with cordate base, acute or acuminate, 10−12 by 5−9 cm. Inflorescence spicate, glabrous, ovoid to ellipsoid, densely 5- to 15-flowered; peduncle 6−8 cm long; rachis 4−6 cm long, floral bracts ovate to ovate-lanceolate. Flowers short-pedicelled to subsessile, erect, pink, pinkish or pale pink. Sepals glabrous, similar in shape and size, oblong-lanceolate, 10−12 by 1−2 mm, brown with 3 pink streaks, margin undulate, curled or reflexed. Petals more or less similar to sepals, oblong-lanceolate, 10−12 by 2−3 mm, glabrous, pale brown or pinkish-brown with 3 pink streaks, margin undulate, curled or reflexed. Labellum 15−17 by 10−12 mm, obovate to broadly elliptic, pink, pale pink or yellowish with longitudinal oblong-lanceolate yellow bands, margin glabrous and undulate, proximal to central part finely pubescent, distal part ornamented by 3 low warty keels; spur ovoid, purple or pinkish. Column 5−7 by 4−5 mm; anther 3−3.2 by 2−2.3 mm. Ovary 7−9 by 2−3 mm. Capsule 1.5−2 by 0.5−1 cm.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert
bibliographicCitation: Nephelaphyllum pulchrum . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 2, 2014. Pg. 549. Accessed 2022-04-21

description: Flowering shoots 15−25 cm tall, internodes 2−4 by 0.3−0.5 cm, green with brown spots or bands. Foliage leaves 1−3, crowded on upper part of stem, pink or purplish, sometimes with pale red spots or bands on upper surface, pink, dark purple or green on lower surface; petiole  2−3 cm long; lamina ovate with more or less cordate and often oblique base, acute or acuminate, 4−10 by 2−6 cm. Inflorescence spicate, oblongoid, laxly 8- to 15-flowered; peduncle 5−6 cm long; rachis 3−5 cm long, floral bracts ovate-lanceolate. Flowers short-pedicelled to subsessile, drooping, green to greenish-yellow. Sepals glabrous, similar in shape and size, oblanceolate, 7−8 by 2−3 mm, green at base and yellowish or yellowish-green at margin with 3 dark green streaks, margin straight, apex curled down or slightly reflexed. Petals more or less similar to sepals, oblanceolate, 8−9 by 2−3 mm, glabrous, green at base and yellowish or yellowish-green at apex with 3 dark green streaks, margin straight, apex slightly reflexed. Labellum 9−10 by 4−5 mm, differentiated into a channelled hypochile and a more or less flat epichile, yellowish or yellowish-green; hypochile finely pubescent in 2 more or less confluent rows and with hairy margins; epichile ornamented by a tuft of high fat papillae; spur globular, dark green. Column 3−5 by 2−3 mm; anther c. 2 by 2 mm. Ovary c. 5 by 1 mm. Capsule 1.5−2 by 0.5−1 cm.
creator: Rachun Pooma & Sawita Yooprasert
bibliographicCitation: Nephelaphyllum tenuiflorum . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 12. Part 2, 2014. Pg. 550. Accessed 2022-04-21

description: Small to medium-sized terrestrial herbs. Tuber globose, corm-like, few-noded. Stem giving rise to an inflorescence and a leaf in succession, the subterranean portion producing lateral runners during the leafing period. Runners slender, producing daughter tubers at apex. Leaf solitary; leaf lamina horizontal, held flush with or well above ground level, cordate, orbicular, reniform or elliptic, palmately veined, membranous or fleshy, glabrous or pubescent, base cordate, apex acute, obtuse, or rounded, borne on a short or elongate petiole-like stalk. Inflorescence erect, terminal, slender or stout, usually slightly fleshy, glabrous; peduncle with 1 to several tubular sheaths, elongating during fructification in 1-flowered species; rachis 1-, 2- or several-flowered. Flowers resupinate or not, erect or nodding. Sepals and petals free, similar, linear-lanceolate, oblanceolate or elliptic. Labellum distinctly or obscurely 3-lobed or occasionally simple, glabrous or pubescent, sometimes with a central ridge, base sometimes shallowly saccate (or spurred in some African species), apex entire or fimbriate. Column parallel to labellum, elongate, clavate, not winged; anther terminal, incumbent, helmet-shaped, 2-locular; pollinia 2, cleft, sectile, mealy; caudicles absent; viscidium reduced; rostellum broad, sometimes reduced or absent; stigma shield-shaped to orbicular. Fruit dehiscing by 6 longitudinal slits.</br></br>A genus of c. 70 species occurring in tropical and southern Africa, the Cape Verde Islands, Madagascar and the Mascarenes, the Arabian Peninsula (Yemen), S Asia, the Himalayas and southern China, Taiwan and western Japan, continental SE Asia, the Philippines, Malaysia, Indonesia, Papua New Guinea, tropical Australia and the SW Pacific islands; 10 species in Thailand.

description: Tuber white-cream to beige, 12.5–32.6 mm in diameter, 3- to 5-noded. Leaf lamina held well above ground level, green, occasionally with purple markings, orbicular-cordate, 5.2–17.5 by 5.5–21.2 cm, membranous, glabrous, more than 20-veined, base deeply cordate, apex acute; petiole-like stalk erect, 5.5–22.5 cm long, up to 4 mm in diameter. Inflorescence 16.2–30.8 cm long, laxly to sub-densely 4- to 16-flowered; peduncle green or purplish, 2–4.5 mm in diameter, bearing 2 or 3 tubular sheaths; floral bracts reflexed, linear-lanceolate, 8.5–15 by 1–2 mm. Flowers resupinate, nodding, opening widely; pedicel 1.2–4.9 mm long; ovary 2.3–7.8 mm long, distinctly ridged. Sepals and petals yellowish-green, often with purple venation, narrowly elliptic to linear-oblanceolate, 3-veined, apex acute; sepals (11.2–)14–22.2 by 2–4 mm; petals (10–)12.6–21.5 by 2–3.8 mm. Labellum pale yellowish-green flushed white above the middle, with purple-mauve, brown or green venation, oblong, obovate or rhombic, (10.3–)12–17.5 by 4.1–11 mm, 3-lobed above the middle; lateral lobes loosely embracing the column, ovate to triangular, 1.8–2 by 2–2.8 mm, apices acute; mid-lobe triangular, ovate or sub-quadrate, 2.6–5.5 by 3–7.4 mm, entire, apex acute; labellum ornamented by sparse to dense villous hairs along the main veins or in a central band. Column pale yellowish, sometimes flushed mauve, arching, 6.5–9.2 mm long; anther 1–2 mm in diameter; pollinia c. 1.5 mm long; rostellum protruding; stigma shield-shaped. Capsule ellipsoid, narrowly winged, c. 11.4 mm long, c. 7 mm in diameter.

description: Tuber yellowish-white, 5.8–14.2 mm in diameter, 3- to 5-noded. Inflorescence 5–9.5 cm long, 1-flowered; peduncle greenish-beige, c. 1.5 mm in diameter, bearing 2 tubular sheaths; floral bract erect, linear-lanceolate, 2.8–8.2 by 0.5–0.8 mm. Labellum white flushed pink, lavender or magenta at the apex, sometimes with a patch of yellow or orange at the centre, obovate-flabelliform, 12.4–16.8 by 8–12.2 mm, 3-lobed above the middle; lateral lobes loosely embracing the column, ovate triangular, 2–3.2 by 2.5–2.8 mm, apices rounded-obtuse; mid-lobe sub-quadrate to broadly elliptic, 4–5.5 by 6–7.4 mm, margin irregularly fimbriate; labellum ornamented by sparse lanate hairs along the main veins on lateral lobes and (more densely) towards the apex of the mid lobe. Column white, sometimes tinged mauve, straight, 4.6–8.2 mm long; anther 1.5–2.8 mm in diameter; pollinia c. 1 mm long; rostellum protruding; stigma shield-shaped. description: Tuber whitish, 6–10 mm in diameter. Leaf lamina held more or less flush with ground level, light green on both surfaces, reniform, 2–4.5 by 3–5.5 cm, glabrous, with 11 or more main veins, base cordate, margin undulate, apex rounded; petiole-like stalk erect, 0.8–2.5 cm long. Inflorescence 7–9 cm long, 2- or 3-flowered; peduncle green, bearing 1 or 2 tubular sheaths, each 1.2–1.5 cm long; floral bracts 2–3 mm long. Labellum pale yellowish-green at base, tinged white at the apex, oblong, c. 13 by 3–5 mm, simple or obscurely 3-lobed above the middle, apical margin fimbriate; labellum ornamented by papillae along central 3 or 5 veins; papillae longer and denser towards the apex of the labellum. Column white, erect, straight, 7–8 mm, slightly dilated at the apex; anther orbicular, c. 1.2 mm in diameter; pollinia c. 0.8 mm long; rostellum reduced and obscure; stigma semi-circular. description: Tuber whitish, 10–15 mm in diameter. Leaf lamina held well above ground level, green on both surfaces, orbicular-cordate, c. 4.5 by c. 4 cm, membranous, glabrous, with 21 veins, base cordate-rounded, margin undulate, apex acute; petiole-like stalk erect or flexuous, green, c. 11.5 cm long, sulcate, c. 2 mm in diameter. Inflorescence c. 22 cm long, laxly 3-flowered; peduncle green, c. 2 mm in diameter, bearing 3 tubular sheaths; floral bracts reflexed, linear-lanceolate, c. 12.4 by c. 1.3 mm. Flowers resupinate, nodding, not opening widely; pedicel and ovary 4.2–6.3 mm long, ridged. Sepals and petals pale green with purple venation, narrowly oblong-obovate, 3-veined, apex acute; sepals c. 10.2 by c. 2 mm; petals c. 9.5 by c. 2.2 mm. Labellum white with purple-brown venation, rhombic to obtriangular, c. 9 by c. 5.3 mm, 3-lobed above the middle; lateral lobes erect and embracing column, triangular, c. 1.4 by c. 1.1 mm, apices acute; mid lobe transversely elliptic, c. 1.4 by c. 2.6 mm, margin entire, apex truncate-rounded; labellum ornamented by a thick villous band extending from the base of the labellum to the apex of  the mid-lobe. Column slender, arched, dilated at the apex, 5–7 mm long; anther c. 1.5 mm in diameter; rostellum protruding; stigma shield-shaped. Capsule not seen.

description: Tuber beige, 6.6–10 mm in diameter, 3- or 4-noded. Leaf lamina held a short way above the ground, light green with purple-maroon streaks along the veins above, uniformly green beneath, polygonal-cordate and cornutely-toothed at tips of main veins, 2.2–5.2 by 2.7–5.3 cm, membranous, glabrous, 7-veined, base cordate, apex acute; petiole-like stalk erect, green, sometimes tinged purple, 1.2–4.2 cm long, c. 2 mm in diameter. Inflorescence 6.8–10.5 cm long, 1-flowered; peduncle purplish-brown with purple flecks, 1.2–1.8 mm in diameter, bearing 1 or 2 tubular sheaths; floral bract oblong-elliptic, 3–5 by 1–1.2 mm. Flower resupinate, nodding, usually opening widely; pedicel 1.5–2.5 mm long; ovary 2–4.5 mm long. Sepals and petals purplish-brown with purple flecks, narrowly elliptic to linear-lanceolate, 3-veined, apex acute; sepals 14–16 by 2–2.3 mm; petals slightly falcate, 13.6–14.4 by 1.4–1.8 mm. Labellum white suffused purple-magenta, tinged green near the base and with a white central strip, narrowly oblong-obovate, 13–14.8 by 4.8–5.0 mm, 3-lobed at the middle; lateral lobes tightly embracing the column, ovate-triangular, 0.8–1.5 by 1–1.5 mm, apices acute; mid-lobe obovate, 6.8–7.5 by 4.2–4.6 mm, margin entire, apex obtuse; labellum ornamented by short papillae throughout and with a strip of longer papillae borne on a raised ridge extending to the apex of the mid-lobe. Column white suffused pink, straight, 7.5–8. mm long, with a patch of short hairs below the stigma; anther 1.2–1.5 mm in diameter; pollinia c. 1 mm long; rostellum protruding; stigma  shield-shaped. description: Tuber beige, 8–17.8 mm in diameter, 3- to 5-noded. Leaf lamina held above ground level, uniformly apple-green or purple, cordate-polygonal, 4.8–6.7 by 5.5–6.8 cm, membranous, glabrous, 5- or 7-veined, base deeply cordate with basal lobes overlapping, apex acute; petiole-like stalk erect, 2.4–3.2 cm long, 2.2–3 mm in diameter. Inflorescence 4.2–8.5 cm long, 1-flowered; peduncle 1.5–2.8 mm in diameter, bearing 2 or 3 tubular sheaths; floral bract narrowly triangular-lanceolate, 4–4.9 by 2–2.4 mm, apex acute. Flower erect, opening widely, slightly fragrant; pedicel and ovary 6–8.3 mm long, c. 2.3 mm in diameter. Sepals and petals brownish-beige tinged greenish, oblong-elliptic, linear-lanceolate or linear-oblanceolate, 3-veined, apex acute; sepals 15.4–20.2 by 2.6–4 mm; petals slightly oblique, 15–18.8 by 3–3.5 mm. Labellum white with a slender strip of apple-green or yellow-green along the central ridge and purple-violet dots either side, oblong-obovate or oblong, 15.3–19 by 6.5–9.5 mm, with a small, rounded lobe on  either side near the base, basal third embracing the column, slightly decurved above the middle, margins entire, apex truncate-rounded and shallowly retuse; basal lobes sometimes obscure, 1–1.5 mm long, c. 0.5 mm wide, apex obtuse; labellum ornamented by dense minute papillae, with a longitudinal ridge extending almost to the apex. Column white, clavate, straight, 7.5–8.8 mm long; anther c. 2 mm in diameter; pollinia c. 2.2 mm long; rostellum protruding; stigma shield-shaped. Capsule not seen.

description: Tuber c. 10 mm in diameter. Leaf not seen. Inflorescence 6–15 cm long, 2-flowered; peduncle greenish-purple, 1–2.8 mm in diameter, bearing 1 or 2 tubular sheaths; floral bracts reddish. Flower resupinate, nodding, opening weakly or widely; pedicel and ovary 6–7.5 mm long, slightly ridged. Sepals and petals green, sometimes flushed red, narrowly elliptic to elliptic-obovate, 3-veined, apex acute; sepals 11.5–13.8 by 2.2–3 mm; petals slightly falcate, 11–12.8 by 1.8–2.5 mm, 3-veined, apex acute. Labellum white with green or purplish veins, sometimes with a pale yellow ridge on the disk, rhombic-obovate, 9–11 mm long, 5.4–6.5 mm wide, 3-lobed at the middle (sometimes obscurely so), base cuneate, slightly swollen; lateral lobes loosely embracing the column, ovate-triangular, 1–1.5 mm long, c. 1.5 mm wide, apices sub-acute; mid-lobe ovate, 3.5–5 mm long, c. 2–4 mm wide, margin entire, apex obtuse to sub-acute; labellum ornamented by sparse villous hairs at the base, becoming dense in a widening band that extends to the apex of the mid-lobe. Column white, slightly arched above the middle, 6–7.5 mm long; anther 1–1.8 mm in diameter; pollinia c. 1.2 mm long; stigma shield-shaped; rostellum protruding at the apex of the stigma. description: Tuber whitish-beige, 12.5–32 mm in diameter, 3- to 5-noded. Leaf lamina flush with ground level or held a short way above, dark purple, brown or green with irregular olive-green or purple markings above, pale green or purple beneath, broadly ovate-reniform, 3.2–12.5 by 3.8–14.6 cm, coriaceous, pubescent along veins, 20-veined or more, base cordate, apex rounded or acute; petiole-like stalk erect, pale green, sometimes tinged purple, 0.7–3.5 cm long, 3–4 mm in diameter. Inflorescence 10.3–18.6 cm long, 2- (or rarely 3-)flowered; peduncle beige to dull maroon, c. 2 mm in diameter, bearing 2 or 3 tubular sheaths; floral bracts linear-lanceolate, one longer than the other, the longer one 3.1–12.5 by 0.4–1.2 mm, the shorter one c. 2 mm long. Flowers resupinate, nodding, opening widely; pedicel 2.2–5 mm long; ovary 4–6.8 mm  long, ridged. Sepals and petals greenish-beige to brownish-purple, narrowly elliptic to linear lanceolate, apex acute to acuminate; sepals 22.8–34.9 by 2–4.4 mm, 3- or 5-veined; petals 21.8–33.5 by 1.8–2.8 mm, 3-veined. Labellum white with a longitudinal yellow strip, or with pink purple venation and suffused purple-rose or yellow along the centre, rhombic-ovate, 13.5–21.6 by 5.8–14.9 mm, obscurely 3-lobed at or above the middle; lateral lobes loosely embracing the column, rounded; mid-lobe broadly ovate, 5.5–8 by 4.8–7 mm, margin entire, apex obtuse rounded or truncate, longitudinally folded at the apex; labellum without ornaments. Column white, arched above the middle, 8.5–11.5 mm long; anther 1.2–2 mm in diameter; pollinia c. 1.8 mm long; rostellum protruding; stigma shield-shaped, concave. Capsule fusiform, 6-ridged, 14–16 mm long, c. 8 mm in diameter.

description: Tuber beige, 4.5–10 mm in diameter, 3- to 5-noded. Leaf lamina held a short way above the ground, green, slightly tinted purple beneath, polygonal-cordate, 2.5–4.9 by 2.4–5.2 cm, membranous, glabrous, 7-veined, base deeply cordate with basal lobes sometimes overlapping,  apex acute; petiole-like stalk erect, green, 1.4–4 cm long, 1–2 mm in diameter. Inflorescence 5.5–9.4 cm long, 1-flowered; peduncle purplish-brown or purplish-green, c. 1 mm in diameter, bearing 1 or 2 tubular sheaths; floral bract erect, linear-lanceolate, 2.5–4.2 by 0.5–1.2 mm. Labellum white with violet or mauve spots on the mid-lobe, narrowly oblong-oblanceolate, 10–13.3 by 2.5–6.5 mm, 3-lobed at the middle; lateral lobes tightly embracing the column, triangular, 1–1.8 mm long, c. 1 mm wide, apices acute; mid-lobe obovate, 5.5–6.8 by 2.2–4.2 mm, margin entire, apex obtuse to sub-acute; labellum ornamented by minute papillae throughout and with a raised central band of longer papillae extending to midway along the mid-lobe. description: Tuber beige, 7–20 mm in diameter, 2- to 7-noded. Leaf lamina held above ground level, purple-bronze when new, turning green, cordate-polygonal, 2.7–5.2 by 3–6 cm, membranous, glabrous, 7- or 9-veined, base deeply cordate with basal lobes sometimes overlapping, apex acute or obtuse; petiole-like stalk erect, 4–8 cm long, 1.6–3 mm in diameter. Inflorescence 8.1–14.5 cm long, 1-flowered; peduncle 1.8–2 mm in diameter, bearing 3 or 4 tubular sheaths; floral bract oblong-ovate, 4.6–5.9 by 1.7–2.2 mm, apex acute. Flower nodding, opening widely; pedicel and ovary 5.2–8.3 mm long. Sepals and petals brown or red-purple with maroon flecks outside, ochre inside, oblong-elliptic or elliptic-obovate, apex acute; sepals 18–24.5 by 4.6–5.2 mm; petals 18.7–25 by 4.1–4.7 mm. Labellum lilac-purple sometimes with sparse white mottling, white along the central ridge, spathulate, 20.7–25 by 8.8–12.3 mm, 3-lobed below the middle, saccate at the base; lateral lobes rolled upwards and embracing the column, triangular-ovate, 1.6–2.1 mm long, apices acute; mid-lobe orbicular, 11.6–12.5 by 11–12.3 mm, margin entire but slightly undulate, apex truncate-rounded or slightly emarginate; labellum ornamented by a central ridge that extends almost to the apex of the mid-lobe, the ridge pubescent below the lateral lobes, glabrous elsewhere. Column white flushed purple, clavate, straight, 9.5–11.5 mm long; anther c. 2 mm in diameter; pollinia c. 2 mm long; rostellum protruding; stigma shield-shaped, raised. Capsule not seen.

description: Epiphytic herbs; rhizome erect or pendulous. Pseudobulbs arising from near the apex of the previous pseudobulb, cylindric to subcylindric. Foliage leaves 2 per pseudobulb, arising from pseudobulb apex, plicate, chartaceous or coriaceous, petiolate. Inflorescence racemose, proteranthous or synanthous, many-flowered, pendulous; peduncle sheathed; rachis straight or weakly zig-zag; floral bracts scarious, caducous or persistent. Flowers resupinate, small to medium in size, often white, with or without yellowish-brown markings. Sepals free, spreading, abaxially carinate. Petals subequal to sepals. Labellum 3-lobed, saccate at base, with or without  keels or ridges, side lobes usually clasping base of column. Column conspicuously elongated, slender, incurved, dilated at apex, without stelids; anther subterminal; pollinia 4, solid, with caudicles; stigma cup-shaped; rostellum large. Fruit a capsule.</br></br>A genus of c. 5 species distributed from NE India, Nepal, Bhutan, Myanmar and S China to Indo-China; 3 species in Thailand.

description: Plant epiphytic. Pseudobulbs subcylindric, 1.5–9.5 by 0.8–1.4 cm, with longitudinal ridges when dry, enclosed by tubular sheaths when young, rooting at nodes. Foliage leaves 2 per pseudobulb, arising from pseudobulb apex, narrowly oblong to oblong-lanceolate, 5–18 by 0.8–2.5 cm, apex acuminate, base attenuate, lamina glossy green, coriaceous; petiole 1–2 cm long. Inflorescence proteranthous or synanthous, glabrous, to 15 cm long; peduncle 2.7–6.5 cm long; rachis slender, weakly zig-zag, laxly 5- to many-flowered; floral bracts ovate-lanceolate, 5–12 by 2–5 mm, acute, obtuse or subtruncate, caducous. Flowers white, sometimes with yellowish-brown spots at base of labellum epichile; pedicel and ovary 5–10 mm long. Sepals similar, oblong-lanceolate; dorsal sepal 7–8(–10) by 2–3 mm, acute, 5- to 7-nerved; lateral sepals slightly oblique, acute to acuminate, 5- to 7-nerved. Petals narrowly oblong-lanceolate, 6–8 by 1–2 mm, acute or acuminate, 3-nerved. Labellum 3-lobed, 5.5–8 mm long, saccate at base; mid lobe oblong, apiculate, deflexed from base, more or less papillate adaxially; side lobes broad, not much longer than broad, acute, finely papillose outside, clasping base of column; sac ornamented by a median thickened longitudinal ridge inside. Column slender, 4–7 mm long, winged and dilated at apex; rostellum broadly ligulate. Fruit ellipsoid to obovoid-ellipsoid, 1–1.2 by 0.4–0.8 cm, ridged.

description: Plant epiphytic. Pseudobulbs pendulous, subfusiform to cylindric, 3–6 by 0.8–1.5 cm, rugose, enclosed by fibrous sheaths, longitudinally wrinkled when dry, rooting at nodes. Foliage leaves 2 per pseudobulb, arising from pseudobulb apex, narrowly oblong to linear-lanceolate, 10–18 by 0.8–1.2 cm, apex acute or acuminate, base attenuate, lamina glossy green, coriaceous; petiole 1–1.5 cm long. Inflorescence proteranthous, glabrous, to 18 cm long; peduncle 3–7 cm long; rachis slender, ridged, laxly 15- to many-flowered; floral bracts ovate-linear, 7–9 by 1.5–3 mm, acute or broadly obtuse, subpersistent. Flowers white, sometimes with pale yellow spots at base of labellum epichile; pedicel and ovary 4–6 mm long. Sepals subsimilar; dorsal sepal oblong, 7–8 by 2–2.5 mm, obtuse, 5-nerved; lateral sepals slightly oblique, narrower than dorsal sepal, acute to acuminate, 5-nerved. Petals narrowly linear-oblanceolate, 5–7 by 1.2–1.3 mm, obtuse or acute, 3-nerved. Labellum 3-lobed, 4–7 mm long, saccate at base; mid-lobe narrowly elliptic-oblong, acute or acuminate, deflexed; side lobes erect, longer than broad, acute to rounded, edges sometimes erose, clasping base of column, their bases united by a transverse ridge, nearly closing access to sac; sac without ornaments inside. Column uniformly slender, cylindric through most of its length, 4–6 mm long, slightly winged and dilated at apex; rostellum shortly ovate. Fruit obovoid-ellipsoid, 0.7–1 by 0.4–0.5 cm, ridged.

description: Plant epiphytic. Pseudobulbs fusiform to cylindric, 3–10 by 0.8–2 cm, longitudinally wrinkled when dry, rooting at nodes. Foliage leaves 2 per pseudobulb, arising from pseudobulb apex, elliptic to elliptic-lanceolate, 7–19 by 2.5–6.5 cm, apex obtuse or acute, base cuneate, lamina glossy green, coriaceous; petiole 0.8–2.5 cm long. Inflorescence proteranthous or synanthous, glabrous, to 20 cm long; peduncle 5–10 cm long; rachis slender, arching, laxly 10- to many-flowered; floral bracts obovate-oblanceolate, 5–10 by 6–8 mm, acute or obtuse, caducous. Flowers white, sometimes with yellowish-brown spots at base of labellum epichile; pedicel and ovary 5–8 mm long. Sepals similar, oblong to oblong-lanceolate; dorsal sepal 10–12 by 2–3 mm, acute, 5- to 7-nerved; lateral sepals more or less the same size as dorsal sepal, acute, 5- to 7-nerved. Petals linear to narrowly oblong, 10–13 mm by 0.7–1 mm, acute, 3-nerved. Labellum 3-lobed, 8–10 mm long; mid-lobe ovate-lanceolate to oblong-lanceolate, acute; side lobes suboblong, erect, rounded to obliquely truncate, not clasping back of column; sac ornamented by 3 lamella-like keels extending from base of labellum to base of mid-lobe, with 2 extra short keels on base of mid-lobe. Column slender, 8–10 mm long, winged and dilated at apex; rostellum narrowly lanceolate. Fruit obovoid-ellipsoid, 1.8–2 by 0.8–0.9 cm, ridged.

description: Terrestrial herbs, deciduous, with fleshy underground rhizome with tuber-like swellings at the stem bases, giving rise to separate flowering and leafy shoots. Foliage leaves erect, narrow, usually shorter than the inflorescence, plicate, petiolate, often withered at flowering. Inflorescences erect, racemose, to just under 1 m tall, with several sterile bracts; rachis few- to many-flowered; floral bracts persistent. Flowers medium-sized, resupinate, somewhat nodding, pubescent, not opening widely. Sepals  free, subequal; lateral sepal bases forming a small mentum. Petals similar but narrower. Labellum fleshy, 3-lobed, attached to the apex of the column foot, saccate at the base, disk and mid-lobe ornamented by papillae and tuberculate keels. Column stout, less than 10 mm long, pubescent, with versatile anther, with 8 clavate waxy pollinia. Pedicel distinctly set-off from ovary.</br></br>A small genus distributed through the whole of tropical and extratropical SE Asia to New Caledonia. Although 28 species have been described, only 3−5 are currently recognised by most botanists; 1 species in Thailand.

description: Flowering shoots (26–)35–98 cm tall. Foliage leaves 1–2, linear-lanceolate, acute, 35–50 by 0.9–1.7 cm. Inflorescences semi-dense, pubescent though sometimes very sparsely so, often pink or purple; sterile bracts 8–18, erect or semi-erect, enveloping most of the stem, lanceolate oblong, acute, membranous, 3–9.7 cm long; rachis (4–)8‒20-flowered, (4–)6–25 cm long; floral bracts lanceolate, acute, membranous, 10–32 by 2–4 mm. Flowers usually pink or purplish pink, labellum often yellow or with yellow patch, flowers also recorded as cream-coloured or greenish-white, yellow or yellowish-green with violet markings. Sepals elliptic-lanceolate, subacute or acute, pubescent; dorsal sepal 8–12(–13.5) by 2.5–4.3 mm; lateral sepals gibbous at the base, 8–11(–12.5) by 2–4.6 mm. Petals linear-spathulate, obtuse to acuminate, pubescent,  8–12(–14) by 1.2–2(–2.8) mm. Labellum 3-lobed in the upper half, 7–11 by 5–6.5 mm; mid-lobe oblong, 2–5 by 1.8–4 mm; side lobes oblong-ovate, acute, suberect, 1.5–2.5(–3) by 1.5–2.2(–2.8) mm, inserted above the labellum middle; basal sac to 1 mm long; labellum ornaments of 3 or 5 tuberculate keels. Column slightly incurved, with prominent apical wings and a column foot, 5–7 mm long. Ovary (4–)6–9 mm long, distinct from the 2.5–5 mm long pedicel; both parts pubescent, green or violet. Capsule ellipsoid, pubescent, 8–10 by 4–5 mm.

description: Epiphytic or lithophytic herbs; rhizome creeping, short. Pseudobulbs close together, 1 internode, cylindric to ovoid-globose. Foliage leaves 1–2 per pseudobulb, arising from pseudobulb apex, conduplicate, narrowly elliptic to linear-lanceolate, thinly coriaceous,  petiolate to subsessile. Inflorescence racemose, proteranthous, synanthous or heteranthous, 1- or 2-flowered in all species known from Thailand, erect to decurved; floral bracts shorter than ovaries, membranous, persistent. Flowers resupinate, small to medium in size, variously colored. Sepals similar, free, lateral sepals often oblique or slightly narrower and longer. Petals similar to sepals, often shorter and narrower. Labellum entire or 3-lobed, side lobes small, not embracing column, more or less sigmoidly curved at base, often ornamented by short, low to lamella like keels. Column slender, slightly incurved, as long as or much shorter than labellum, with or without stelids; column foot short or almost absent; anther overhanging; pollinia 4, waxy, obliquely obovoid, with caudicles; stigma cup-shaped; rostellum large, not producing a stipe. Fruit a capsule, ellipsoid to obovoid.</br></br>A genus of c. 12 species distributed in the Indian subcontinent, Bhutan, Myanmar, S China and Indo-China; 4 species in Thailand.

description: Plant epiphytic, 10–15 cm tall. Pseudobulbs ovoid, 1–2 by 0.5–1 cm, erect or suberect. Foliage leaves 1–2 per pseudobulb, narrowly elliptic, 3–8 by 0.8–1.5 cm, apex acute, base attenuate, lamina glossy green; petiole 0.5–0.8 cm long. Inflorescence heteranthous, glabrous, to 7 cm long; peduncle 1–2.5 cm long, with membranous sheaths at base, sheaths 0.8–1.5 cm long; floral bracts narrowly ovate, 5–6 by 1.5–2 mm, apex acute. Flowers 1–2, pale orange, greenish or white; pedicel and ovary 7–15 mm long. Sepals abaxially keeled; dorsal sepal ovate-lanceolate, 8–12 by 2–3 mm, apex acute, 5-nerved; lateral sepals oblong-lanceolate, more or less in the same size as dorsal sepal, apex acute, 3-nerved. Petals lanceolate, 8–10 by 2 mm, apex acute to acuminate, 3-nerved. Labellum 3-lobed, broadly oblong to obovate, 8–9 by 5–6 mm, with a saccate sigmoid claw; mid-lobe apiculate; side lobes broad triangular; disk ornamented by 2 brown spots and 2–3 longitudinal obscure keels. Column winged, 5–6 mm long.

description: Plant epiphytic, 5–10 cm tall. Pseudobulbs ovoid-ellipsoid to oblong, 1.8–3.5 by 0.3–1 cm, obliquely curved at apex, with longitudinal furrows. Foliage leaves 2 per pseudobulb, linear, linear-elliptic or linear-oblong, 5–10 by 0.5–0.9 cm, apex acute, base attenuate, lamina glossy green; petiole 0.4–0.8 cm long. Inflorescence proteranthous, glabrous, to 5 cm long, arising from young shoot, developing before the growth of the pseudobulb; peduncle 1–3 cm long; floral bracts triangular-ovate, 6–8 by 2–4 mm, apex acute. Flower 1, pale yellow to greenish; pedicel and ovary 8–10 mm long. Sepals abaxially keeled; dorsal sepal ovate, 10–16 by 3–5 mm, apex acute, 5-nerved; lateral sepals ovate-lanceolate, more or less the same size as dorsal sepal, apex acute to acuminate, 5-nerved. Petals ovate-oblong, 9–12 by 3–4 mm, apex acute, 3-nerved. Labellum 3-lobed, obovate, 10–13 by 8–11 mm, sigmoid at base; mid-lobe truncate; side lobes triangular, minute; disk ornamented by 3 small orange spots at base and 2 distinct longitudinal orange keels. Column slightly winged, 5–6 mm long, with 2 lateral falcately upwards pointing stelids.

description: Plant epiphytic, 5–12 cm tall. Pseudobulbs ovoid, ellipsoid or subglobose, 0.8–2.5 by 0.6–2 cm, erect or suberect. Foliage leaves 1–2 per pseudobulb, linear to elliptic-lanceolate, 3–18 by 1–2.5 cm, apex acute, base attenuate, lamina glossy green; petiole 0.5–2.5 cm long. Inflorescence proteranthous or heteranthous, glabrous, to 6 cm long; peduncle 1–3.5 cm long, with membranous sheaths at base, sheaths 1–2.5 cm long; floral bracts ovate-lanceolate, 5–8 by 2.5–5 mm, apex acute. Flowers 1(–2), pale yellow or greenish; pedicel and ovary winged, 10–12 mm long. Sepals abaxially keeled; dorsal sepal ovate-oblong to ovate-lanceolate, 12–18 by 4–8 mm, apex acute, 5-nerved; lateral sepals ovate-lanceolate, more or less the same size as dorsal sepal, apex acute, 4- to 5-nerved. Petals ovate-oblong, 10–20 by 3–5 mm, apex acute to acuminate, 3-nerved. Labellum simple, obovate-oblong, 15–18 by 5–12 mm, sigmoid at base; truncate, apiculate; disk ornamented by 3 small orange spots at base and 2–3 orange to brown longitudinal lamella-like keels. Column winged, 6–8 mm long.

description: Plant epiphytic or lithophytic, 10–20 cm tall. Pseudobulbs ovoid to ellipsoid, 1.5–3.5 by 0.7–1.2 cm. Foliage leaves 1–2 per pseudobulb, linear to linear-oblong, 7–18 by 0.7–1.5 cm, apex acuminate, base attenuate, lamina subglossy green; petiole 0.5–2 cm long. Inflorescence proteranthous or heteranthous, glabrous, to 5 cm long; peduncle 1.7–3.5 cm long; floral bracts  ovate, 4–5 by 2–3.5 mm, apex acute. Flowers 1(–2), pale yellow; pedicel and ovary 8–15 mm long. Sepals abaxially keeled; dorsal sepal ovate-oblong to oblong-lanceolate, 15–20 by 3–7 mm, apex acute, 5-nerved; lateral sepals ovate-lanceolate, more or less the same size as dorsal sepal, apex acute to acuminate, 5-nerved. Petals ovate-oblong to ovate-lanceolate, 12–20 by 3–7 mm, apex acute, 3- to 5-nerved. Labellum 3-lobed, obovate-elliptic, 10–22 by 5–10 mm, obscurely saccate at base; mid-lobe truncate, apiculate, irregularly crenate above side lobes; side lobes falcate, minute; disk ornamented by 3 small orange spots at the very base, 3 obscure keels and 3 orange spots. Column broadly winged, curved, 7–9 mm long; column foot short, c. 2 mm long. Fruit ellipsoid-obovoid, 1.5–2 by 1–1.4 cm, winged.

description:
Terrestrial or rarely lithophytic herbs, evergreen, in Thailand mostly glabrous except for the floral parts; stems either short and pseudobulbous or elongate-fusiform and cane-like. Flowering shoots 40–200 cm tall. Pseudobulbs (if present) insignificant and largely hidden by the bases of the foliage leaves, adjacent. Foliage leaves few, plicate, perennial, lanceolate-oblong, acute or acuminate, petiolate, sometimes forming a pseudostem; laminas rounded to cuneate at base. Inflorescences racemose, basal or lateral on the stem; peduncles with sterile bracts; rachis few-flowered; floral bracts persistent or caducous. Flowers usually large, resupinate, in the Thai species mostly with yellow, pink or white colours; damaged or old flowers turn dark blue. Sepals and petals similar, free, campanulate or spreading. Labellum more or less 3-lobed with a glabrous spur, free from the column or fused with it only at the base; side lobes often erect and enclosing the column; labellum sometimes ornamented, mostly by keels. Column long, without a column foot, mostly hairy on the front side; anther incumbent, versatile, pollinia 8, clavate, waxy; rostellum entire, not producing a viscidium. Ovary not distinct from the pedicel.

About 40 species, mainly in Asia, with a few found in Africa, N Australia and the Pacific Ocean Islands; 6 species in Thailand.

description: Flowering shoots 40–100 cm tall, vegetative parts glabrous. Pseudobulbs insignificant, hidden by the bases of the foliage leaves, conical to cylindric, 9–12(–23) by 1.2–3 cm. Foliage leaves 4–6, ovate-elliptic to oblong-elliptic, acute, green and often with pale blotches, (20–)30–60 by 3.7–15 cm; petioles 17–23 cm long, forming a pseudostem 13–19 cm long. Inflorescences semi-dense or lax, usually basal but very rarely arising from the upper parts of the pseudobulbs (to 18 cm high); peduncles mostly longer than 35 cm; sterile bracts 4, elliptic-lanceolate, acute, (1–)2.5–5 cm long; rachis 5–20 cm long, (4–)13- to 17-flowered; floral bracts ovate-lanceolate, acute or subacute, persistent, 8–20 by 5–10.7 mm. Flowers yellow or green, labellum yellow with orange or brown markings, sometimes hypochile and spur white, column white and marked with red. Sepals obovate-lanceolate, acute; dorsal sepal (23–)25–43 by (6–)8–16 mm; lateral sepals 25–42 by 10–17 mm. Petals obovate-elliptic, obtuse, somewhat clawed, (25–)30–42 by (8–)9.5–15.5 mm. Labellum weakly 3-lobed, fused with the column for 2–7 mm, front margins crisped-undulate, mid-lobe hardly protruding, 23–45 by 25–45 mm; disk without prominent callosities; spur cylindric, 5–8(–16) mm long. Column sparsely hairy on the anterior face, 17–20 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) (16–)25–32 mm long. Capsule ellipsoid, c. 25 by 5 mm.

description: Flowering shoots 60–94 cm tall, vegetative parts glabrous. Stems cane-like, fusiform cylindric, 33–45 by 1–1.2 cm. Foliage leaves 4–5, lanceolate-elliptic, acute, (20–)30–50 by (4.3–)5.8–8(–10) cm, petioles 2–13(–33) cm long; forming a pseudostem 5–13 cm long. Inflorescences 1–2, lax, glabrous or puberulous, arising laterally on the stem; peduncles 30–52 cm long; sterile bracts 3–4, lanceolate-elliptic, acute, 2.9–5.8 cm long; rachis (6.5–)12–23 cm long, 5- to 12-flowered; floral bracts caducous, ovate-lanceolate, acute, 20–30 mm long. Flowers with the sepal and petal outsides brownish-yellow and their inside brownish-purple with yellow edges, labellum yellow with reddish-brown markings, apex nearly pure yellow. Sepals narrowly obovate-lanceolate, apiculate, 26–40(–47) by 6–13 mm. Petals similar, lorate-elliptic, obtuse, 28–36(–42) by 3–6(–8) mm. Labellum 3-lobed, the basal 6–8 mm fused with the column, hairy on the median callus, 21–32 by 15–31 mm; mid-lobe orbicular, 3–9(–12) by 6–13 mm, truncate; side lobes triangular, obtuse, 5–10 by 6–12 mm, spreading; labellum ornamented by a median line, mostly with long white hairs in the distal part; spur conical, (2–)4–6 mm long. Column often sparsely pubescent, 19–22 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) 20–38 mm long. Capsule ellipsoid, 25–48 by 5–15 mm.

description: Flowering shoots to 100 cm tall. Pseudobulbs elongate-clavate, 20–40 by (1.3–)2–2.5 cm. Foliage leaves 5–8, elliptic, acuminate, slightly undulate, (5.5–)12–40 by (2.5–)5.5–10(–14) cm, borne in the upper part of the stem, both sides glabrous. Inflorescences lax, arising from the base of the pseudobulb, unbranched or rarely with a side branch, glabrous or sparsely hairy, up to 60 cm long and 0.4–0.8 cm in diameter; peduncles 30–50 cm long; sterile bracts to 9, 1.6–2.8 cm long; rachis 10–13 cm long, 4- to 15-flowered; floral bracts lanceolate, acute, persistent, glabrous, to 17 by 3.8 mm. Flowers 40–50 mm in diameter, opening widely; with pale green or yellowish-green sepals and petals, and white or cream-coloured labellum with greenish yellow spur. Sepals elliptic-oblong, obtuse or acute, pubescent on the outside, 27–32(–35) by (7–)8–10.5 mm. Petals oblanceolate, obtuse or acute, 28–33 by 6–8 mm. Labellum orbicular, weakly 3-lobed, basal 7–8 mm fused with the column, largely glabrous, 30–34 by 24–26 mm; disk ornamented by 2 or 3 obscure smooth keels; spur clavate, 6–9 mm long. Column hairy on the anterior face, 15–25 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) sparsely pubescent or subglabrous, 20–32 mm long. Capsule not seen.
