description: Flowering shoots to 200 cm tall, glabrous except for labellum and column. Pseudobulbs insignificant, hidden by the bases of the foliage leaves, ovoid, 2.5–6(–8) cm long. Foliage leaves 4–5, lanceolate-oblong, acute, 30–105 by (4–)6–20 cm; petioles (9–)15–25(–38) cm long. Inflorescences lax, arising from the pseudobulb base; peduncles mostly longer than 50 cm; sterile bracts 6–10, lanceolate-oblong, acuminate, (2–)4–6 cm long; rachis (4.5–)15–30 cm long, 6- to 20-flowered; floral bracts persistent or caducous, to c. 50 by 15 mm. Flowers nodding, with sepal and petal insides reddish-brown and their outsides white, labellum pale purple with darker veins and pink or mauve apical rim, column white; flowers reported as fragrant. Sepals ovate-lanceolate, acute or acuminate, 41–58(–63) by 9–16(–17.5) mm. Petals ovate-elliptic, acute, 40–55(–58) by 8–18 mm. Labellum weakly 3-lobed, obovate, acute or truncate, more or less hairy in the lower part, basal 3 mm fused with the column, 37–55 by 25–43 mm; mid-lobe ovate-oblong, obtuse, distinctly protruding, 20–25 mm wide; side lobes erect and enveloping the column; disk ornamented by 3 obscure keels; spur cylindric, apex mostly entire, 5–8(–9) mm long. Column sparsely hairy especially at the base and on the anther, 19–21 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel), (25–)28–48 mm long. Capsule ellipsoid, shortly pedicellate, pendent, to 55 by 17 mm.

description: Flowering shoots pseudobulbous, vegetative parts glabrous. Pseudobulbs insignificant, hidden by the bases of the foliage leaves, ovoid or fusiform, 10–14.5 by 4.5–5.7 cm. Foliage leaves c. 4, elliptic, acute, 49–70 by 15–24 cm; somewhat petiolate. Inflorescences lax, arising from the pseudobulb middle; sterile bracts several, lanceolate-oblong, acute, pilose; rachis 4- to 15-flowered; floral bracts caducous, 30–50 mm long. Flowers spreading, with both sides of sepals and petals greenish-yellow, labellum white with yellow and red markings. Sepals ovate-lanceolate, acuminate, to 68 by 12–18 mm. Petals lanceolate-elliptic, acuminate, to 63 by 12–17 mm. Labellum weakly 3-lobed, obovate, acute, fused with the column only at the base, 45–65 by 27–53 mm; mid-lobe ovate, cuspidate, distinctly protruding, 25–30 mm wide; side lobes erect and enveloping the column; disk ornamented by 3 obscure keels; spur usually apically bifid, 11–15 mm long. Column 18–22 mm long, front side pubescent. Ovary (including pedicel) 40–55 mm long. Capsule as in Phaius tankervilleae.

description: Lithophytic or epiphytic herbs, erect or pendulous; rhizome short, creeping. Pseudobulbs crowded or distant on rhizome, slender or swollen, sometimes connected to each other at both ends or connected by a short rhizome to middle part of another pseudobulb. Foliage leaves 1–2 per pseudobulb, duplicate, usually coriaceous, shortly petiolate. Inflorescence racemose, terminal from pseudobulb apex, erect, arching or pendulous, distichously many-flowered, glabrous in Thai species; rachis usually slightly zig-zag; floral bracts, caducous or persistent, concave. Flowers small, resupinate, not opening widely. Sepals free or lateral sepals connate at base, usually concave, lateral sepals often keeled on the back. Petals similar to sepals or narrower. Labellum firmly attached, sessile, subentire or 3- or 4-lobed, saccate, not sigmoidly curved at base, often ornamented by keels; epichile deflexed. Column short, winged or hooded at apex; column foot short or absent; anther terminal, incumbent; pollinia 4 in 2 pairs, solid, connected by inconspicuous caudicles, each pollinium with a tiny pore; stigma cup-shaped; rostellum large, not producing a stipe. Fruit a capsule.</br></br>A genus of c. 40 species distributed from India, Sri Lanka, Nepal, Bhutan, Myanmar, S China, Taiwan, Indo-China and Malesia to the SW Pacific islands; 8 species in Thailand. The occurrence of Pholidota chinensis Lindl. in Thailand is uncertain. There are specimens from markets but there is no record from the natural habitat.

description: Plant epiphytic; rhizome creeping, enclosed by persistent scales. Pseudobulbs ovoid to conical-ovoid, close together along the rhizome, 1.2–1.8 by 0.7–1 cm, base enclosed by coarse sheaths. Foliage leaves 2(–3) per pseudobulb, arising from pseudobulb apex, linear to narrowly lanceolate, 5–10 by 0.8–1.2 cm, apex acute to acuminate, base attenuate, lamina glossy green, coriaceous; petiole to 1 cm long. Inflorescence synanthous, to 15 cm long; peduncle 5–7.5 cm  long, longer than rachis; rachis slender, weakly zig-zag, laxly 8- to 20-flowered; floral bracts ovate-lanceolate, 5–8 by 4–5 mm, acute, persistent. Flowers white; pedicel and ovary 1.5–2.5 mm long. Sepals subsimilar; dorsal sepal ovate, 3–3.5 by 1.5–2 mm, acute, 3- to 5-nerved; lateral  sepals slightly oblique, ovate-lanceolate, 3.2–4 by 1.5–2 mm, acute, 3-nerved. Petals ovate oblong, 2.5–3 by 1.2–1.5 mm, irregularly acute-retuse, 3-nerved. Labellum obscurely 3-lobed,  3–3.5 mm long, concave at base; mid-lobe ovate-oblong, acute, recurved, ornamented by 2 small  rugose cushions below apex; side lobes obscure, abruptly lowering in front. Column light purple, stout, 1.5–2 mm long, with short triangular stelids at apex.

description: Plant epiphytic or lithophytic. Pseudobulbs ascending to erect, subcylindric, 2–12 by 1–1.5 cm, base enclosed by sheaths when young, usually longitudinally and shallowly grooved when mature. Foliage leaves 2 per pseudobulb, arising from pseudobulb apex, ovate to oblong lanceolate, 5–15 by 2.5–5 cm, apex acute, obtuse or acuminate, base cuneate, lamina glossy  green, coriaceous; petiole 0.5–1.5 cm long. Inflorescence synanthous, to 12 cm long; peduncle 1.5–4 cm long; rachis straight or zig-zag, laxly to subdensely 8- to many-flowered; floral bracts ovate, oblong or orbicular, 5–12 by 3–10 mm, acute to rounded, caducous. Flowers white, sometimes with pale yellow patch at base of labellum mid-lobe; pedicel and ovary 2–8 mm long. Sepals subsimilar; dorsal sepal ovate to ovate-oblong, 4–8 by 2–5 mm, obtuse to rounded, 3- to 5-nerved; lateral sepals ovate to ovate-lanceolate, 4–9 by 1.5–4.5 mm, acute to acuminate, 3-nerved. Petals ovate to ovate-lanceolate, 4–7 by 1.5–4 mm, obtuse, acute or acuminate, 3-nerved. Labellum obscurely 3-lobed, constricted at the middle, 4–8 mm long, boat-shaped and ornamented by 5 keels at base; mid-lobe 2-lobulate, base with yellow patch, each lobule rounded, recurved; side lobes obscure, not drawn out into true lobes, edges more or less laterally recurved. Column shortly clavate, 1.5–5 mm long, hooded, top margin irregular dentate, with more or less conspicuous lateral lobes; rostellum triangular. Fruit obovoid-ellipsoid, 1–2 by 0.6–1 cm, ridged.

description: Plant epiphytic; rhizome creeping, enclosed by persistent scales. Pseudobulbs ovoid, 1.5– 2.5 by 0.6–1.2 cm, base usually enclosed by coarse sheaths. Foliage leaves 2 per pseudobulb, arising from pseudobulb apex, linear to linear-oblong, 5–18 by 0.5–1.5 cm, apex acute to acuminate, base cuneate to attenuate, lamina glossy green, coriaceous; petiole to 1.5 cm long. Inflorescence proteranthous or synanthous, to 18 cm long; peduncle 1–4.5 cm long, shorter than rachis; rachis slender, zig-zag, laxly 12- to 25-flowered; floral bracts ovate-oblong, 3.5–6 by 2–3.5 mm, acute or obtuse, caducous. Flowers greenish-white to light purple; pedicel and ovary 1.5–3 mm long. Sepals subsimilar; dorsal sepal ovate, 1.6–2.5 by 1–2 mm, acute or obtuse, 3- to 5-nerved; lateral sepals oblique, broadly ovate, 1.8–3 by 1–2.2 mm, acute, 3-nerved. Petals ovate, 1–2.2 by 1–2 mm, acute or obtuse, 3-nerved. Labellum obscurely 3-lobed, 1.8–2.8 mm  long, saccate at base; mid-lobe ovate-orbicular, acute or obtuse, recurved, ornamented by 2 faint keels at base; side lobes broadly triangular with a rounded upper edge. Column orange, stout, 1–2.5 mm long; lateral lobes of the hood slightly developed. Fruit ellipsoid, 0.4–0.6 by 0.2–0.4 cm.

description: Plant epiphytic or lithophytic; rhizome densely enclosed by coriaceous scales. Pseudobulbs close together on rhizome, ovoid-conical to suboblong, 3–8 by 1.2–2.5 cm, base usually enclosed by coriaceous sheaths. Foliage leaves 1 per pseudobulb, arising from pseudobulb apex, oblong to oblong-oblanceolate, 8–28 by 2–8.5 cm, apex obtuse or acute, base cuneate, lamina coriaceous; petiole to 5 cm long. Inflorescence synanthous with developed young leaf, to 45 cm long; peduncle 3–6 cm long, base distinctly enclosed by scales, covered by sterile bracts at base of rachis; rachis pendulous, (sub)densely 10- to many-flowered (flowers touching each other); floral bracts broadly ovate, 6–8 by 6–8.5 mm, acute or obtuse, concave, puberulent on both sides with dense parallel veins and brown spots, persistent. Flowers white or cream; pedicel and ovary 4–7 mm long. Sepals dissimilar; dorsal sepal ovate-elliptic or ovate, 5–6.5 by 3–4.5 mm, acute, 3- to 5-nerved; lateral sepals oblique, ovate, 5.5–7 by 3–4 mm, strongly keeled on the back, acute, 3- to 5-nerved. Petals lanceolate-falcate, 4.5–6 by 1.2–2.5 mm, acute or obtuse, 1-nerved. Labellum broadly 3-lobed, 6–7 mm long, concave, ornamented by 2 or 3 keels at base; mid-lobe  deeply 2-lobulate, deflexed, lobules subelliptic or suborbicular; side lobes erect, triangular acute. Column 2.5–3.5 mm long, winged on both sides; rostellum broad, undulating to more or less straight rim. Fruit obovoid, 1–1.5 by 0.6–0.9 cm.

description: Plant epiphytic or lithophytic; rhizome densely enclosed by coriaceous scales. Pseudobulbs close together on rhizome, oblong to ovate-oblong, 3–6 by 1.5–3 cm, base usually enclosed by coriaceous sheaths. Foliage leaves 1 per pseudobulb, arising from pseudobulb apex, narrowly oblong to oblong-oblanceolate, 7–25 by 2–5.5 cm, apex acute, base cuneate, lamina coriaceous; petiole to 4 cm long. Inflorescence synanthous with developing young leaf, to 25 cm long; peduncle 3–5 cm long, base distinctly enclosed by scales, covered by sterile bracts at base of rachis; rachis pendulous, (sub)densely 12- to many-flowered (flowers touching each other); floral bracts broadly ovate-sagittate, 6–7 by 4–5 mm, acute, concave, puberulent on both sides with dense parallel veins and brown spots, persistent. Flowers white or cream; pedicel and ovary 3–4 mm long. Sepals dissimilar; dorsal sepal ovate, elliptic or oblong, 3–5 by 2–3.5 mm,  obtuse, 3- to 5-nerved; lateral sepals oblique, broadly ovate, 5–6 by 3–3.5 mm, strongly keeled on the back, acute, connected at the base, 3- to 5-nerved. Petals elliptic-falcate, 3.5–5 by 1–2 mm, obtuse, usually 1-nerved. Labellum broadly 3-lobed, 4–6 mm long, concave, ornamented  by 3 keels at base; mid-lobe deeply 2-lobulate, recurved, lobules obliquely ovate to obliquely quadrangular; side lobes erect, rounded. Column 2.5–3 mm long, winged on both sides; rostellum narrow, band-like, lateral margins swollen. Fruit elliptic to obovoid, 0.8–1.3 by 0.5–0.7 cm.

description: Plant epiphytic or lithophytic. Pseudobulbs ascending to erect, crowded on rhizome, subcylindric, 2–7 by 1.5–2 cm, usually with longitudinal ridges, base enclosed by sheaths, wrinkled when dry, rooting at nodes. Foliage leaves 2 per pseudobulb, arising from pseudobulb apex, elliptic to elliptic-lanceolate, 3–8 by 1.2–2 cm, apex acute, base cuneate, lamina glossy green, coriaceous; petiole 0.3–1 cm long. Inflorescence synanthous, to 8 cm long; peduncle 1–2 cm long; rachis curved, subdensely 20- to 35-flowered; floral bracts distichous, on the side opposite to the flowers, semi-circular, 6–8 by 6.5–9 mm, rounded to subtruncate, partly overlapping each other, persistent until after fruiting. Flowers yellowish-green to yellow; pedicel and ovary 2.5–3 mm long. Sepals dissimilar; dorsal sepal oblong-obovate, 3–5 by 1.5–3 mm, obtuse to rounded, 3-nerved; lateral sepals ovate-oblong, 3.5–4 by 1.5–2 mm, acute, 3-nerved. Petals ovate-oblong to ovate-lanceolate, 2.8–4 by 1–2 mm, acute or obtuse, 3-nerved. Labellum obscurely 3-lobed, 2.5–3.5 mm long, concave and ornamented by 5 partly fused keels at base; mid-lobe retuse; side lobes obscure, not drawn out into true lobes. Column shortly clavate, 1.5– 2.5 mm long, hooded, top margin truncate or retuse; rostellum truncate. Fruit ellipsoid-ovoid, 0.5–0.6 by 0.3–0.4 cm.

description: Plant epiphytic; rhizome creeping, enclosed by papyraceous scales, soon turning into caducous thin fibres. Pseudobulbs ovoid-cylindric, bulging below the centre, tapering to both ends, 4.5–9 by 1.2–1.5 cm, usually wrinkled, base usually enclosed by papyraceous sheaths, soon turning into caducous thin fibres. Foliage leaves 2 per pseudobulb, arising from pseudobulb apex, oblong-lanceolate, 10–20 by 1.8–3.5 cm, apex acuminate, base cuneate, lamina glossy green, coriaceous; petiole to 3 cm long. Inflorescence proteranthous or synanthous, to 25 cm long; peduncle 1–5 cm long, shorter than rachis, base covered with scales; rachis slender, straight, pendulous, laxly 20- to 35-flowered; floral bracts ovate-oblong, 0.5–1 by 2.5–5 mm, inrolled, acute, persistent during and after anthesis, caducous during fruit setting. Flowers pinkish-orange; pedicel and ovary 3.5–6 mm long, angular. Sepals subsimilar; dorsal sepal ovate, 2.5–4  by 1.5–3.2 mm, acute, 5-nerved; lateral sepals oblique, broadly ovate, 2.7–4.5 by 2–3 mm, acute, 5-nerved. Petals linear-lanceolate, 3.5–4 by 0.5–0.8 mm, acute to obtuse, 1-nerved. Labellum 3-lobed, 3–4.5 mm long, ornamented by a low rounded keel at base; mid-lobe ovate-orbicular, apiculate, deflexed; side lobes erect, with a rounded upper edge, abruptly lowering in front. Column pinkish-orange, slender, 2.5–3.5 mm long; hood long, retuse at apex. Fruit ellipsoid,  0.8–1.2 by 0.5–0.6 cm.

description: Terrestrial herbs with a short stout creeping rhizome rooting from the nodes; leaves, peduncle, rachis and floral bracts covered with yellowish-brown hairs. Pseudobulbs ascending, each bearing either a single leaf or an inflorescence, articulated at junction with petiole or peduncle, initially covered by scale-like cataphylls that soon disintegrate into fibres. Foliage leaves long-lived, convolute, plicate, short-petiolate; petiole channelled. Inflorescence erect, racemose, lax, both peduncle and rachis elongating during flowering; floral bracts persistent, entire. Flowers non-resupinate, wide-open. Sepals and petals free; sepals densely pubescent on the dorsal side, (sub)glabrous on the ventral side; petals glabrous. Labellum versatile, sessile, 3-lobed, glabrous, spurless, ornamented by 2 conspicuous double-crested ridges. Column suberect, incurved, semiterete-clavate with 2 lateral subspathulate stelids and a solid, spurless column foot; anther partly hidden in an apical column hood, incumbent, versatile; pollinia 2, solid, devoid of caudicles; rostellum short, truncate, neither producing stipe nor viscidia; receptive part of stigma concave. Ovary (including pedicel) terete, densely covered with yellowish-green hairs. Fruit a capsule dehiscing by longitudinal slits.</br></br>A monotypic genus; distribution as for the species (see below).

description: Pseudobulbs subterete, c. 6 cm long, c. 1 cm in diameter. Leaves dark (purplish-)green above, green underneath; petiole erect, c. 1.5 cm long; lamina spreading, (ovate-)elliptic, acuminate, c. 34.5 by c. 16.4 cm, with 5 particularly strong nerves elevated on the dorsal side. Inflorescence c. 78 cm tall, c. 13-flowered; peduncle dull violet, bearing a few strongly reduced leaves; rachis dull violet, c. 20.5 cm long; floral bracts appressed to pedicels, lanceolate, long-acuminate, dull violet, c. 19.2 by c. 4.9 mm. Flowers mainly greenish-yellow with purple markings (labellum white with purple markings, ovary dull violet). Sepals acuminate; dorsal sepal linear, c. 18.3 by c. 3.2 mm; lateral sepals falcately linear-oblong, c. 12.6 by c. 4.6 mm. Petals falcately linear-oblanceolate, short-acuminate, c. 14.9 by c. 3.7 mm. Labellum fleshy, suberect, c. 7.2 mm long to apex of mid-lobe, c. 9 mm wide across side lobes when flattened, ornamented by double-crested ridges extending from the base of the side lobes to about the middle of the mid-lobe; side lobes incurved, falcately linear, obtuse, c. 3.5 mm long (measured along front edge); mid-lobe recurved, broadly spathulate, rounded, apiculate, c. 3.7 by c. 3.9 mm. Column c. 9 mm long, stelids porrect, column foot with 2 pairs of lateral, scale-like appendages; anther obovate in upper view, acuminate in front, c. 1.5 mm long; pollinia subpyramidal; receptive part of stigma subquadrate. Ovary (including pedicel) spreading, incurved at apex, finely longitudinally furrowed, c. 20 mm long.

description: Epiphytic, lithophytic or (less frequently) terrestrial dwarf herbs, usually growing in dense patches on rocks or trees. Pseudobulbs annual, clustered on the rhizome, ovoid, conical, pyriform or turbinate, covered by sheaths when young. Foliage leaves 1–2 per pseudobulb, arising from pseudobulb apex, deciduous, erect to arcuate-spreading, plicate, elliptic-oblong, elliptic-lanceolate, oblong-lanceolate or oblanceolate, chartaceous, mostly shortly petiolate. Inflorescence basal, 1- to 2-flowered, arising from an old pseudobulb, erect, appearing either before or after leaves; floral bracts persistent. Flowers resupinate, large, showy, sometimes fragrant, white or pink to rose-purple or magenta, more rarely yellow, marked with yellow, red or brown on the labellum. Sepals free, spreading, linear-oblong to oblong-lanceolate. Petals similar to sepals but slightly narrower. Labellum obscurely 3-lobed or entire, apical margins erose to lacerate; ornamented by 2 to several ridges or lines of hairs along the veins of the upper surface of the labellum. Column slender, slightly arcuate, winged above, entire, erose or denticulate at apex; column foot absent; anther subterminal, incumbent; pollinia 4 in 2 pairs, waxy, often bilaterally flattened; rostellum producing neither stipe nor viscidium. Fruit a capsule, fusiform, with 3 longitudinal ribs.</br></br>A genus of c. 21 species distributed from NE India, Nepal, Bhutan, Bangladesh, Myanmar, S China and Taiwan to Laos and Vietnam; 2 species in Thailand.

description: Plant epiphytic or lithophytic, 15–25 cm tall when producing leaves. Pseudobulbs turbinate to pyriform, 1–3 by 1–1.5 cm, usually with a distinct neck, often covered by remains of old smooth sheaths. Foliage leaves 2 per pseudobulb, elliptic-oblong to oblanceolate, 8–25  by 1.7–3.5 cm, apex acute, base attenuate, chartaceous. Inflorescence appearing before the leaves, glabrous, to 6 cm long; peduncle covered by membranous, inflated, smooth sheaths; floral bract broadly obovate or suborbicular when flattened, 1.5–3 cm long, obtuse, cucullate. Flower 1, suberect to spreading, fragrant; pedicel and ovary 4–5 mm long. Sepals creamy white, occasionally lightly streaked with pink; dorsal sepal oblong-lanceolate, 30–40 by 7–8 mm, obtuse, 5-nerved; lateral sepals lanceolate-falcate, more or less the same size as dorsal sepal, acute, 5-nerved. Petals creamy white, oblanceolate, slightly falcate, 30–40 by 7–8 mm, acute, obscurely 1-nerved. Labellum white with a yellow centre, large purple and yellow blotches on the apical margin, 3-lobed, ovate-oblong, 25–35 by 20–25 mm, slightly saccate at base; mid-lobe oblong, emarginate; side lobes obscure; margin undulate, erose; ornaments of 5–7 papillate lines, extending to the apex of the labellum. Column arcuate, 17–20 mm long, apex irregularly erose dentate. Fruit fusiform, 1.8–2.5 by 0.5–1 cm.

description: Plant terrestrial or epiphytic, 12–25 cm tall when producing leaves. Pseudobulbs turbinate, 1–3.5 by 1–2.5 cm, with a distinct neck, often covered by remains of old warty sheaths. Foliage  leaves 2, rarely 1 per pseudobulb, elliptic to elliptic-oblanceolate, 10–25 by 2.5–6.5 cm, apex acuminate, base attenuate, chartaceous. Inflorescence appearing before the leaves, glabrous, to 12 cm long; peduncle covered by warty sheaths; floral bracts elliptic-oblong, 2.5–3 cm, acute. Flowers 1(–2), suberect; pedicel and ovary 1–1.5 cm long. Sepals pinkish-purple; dorsal sepal  oblong-lanceolate, 55–60 by 7–8 mm, acute, 5-nerved; lateral sepals oblong-lanceolate, slightly  falcate, more or less the same size as dorsal sepal, acute, 5-nerved. Petals pinkish-purple, linear oblong, slightly falcate, 50–70 by 5–7 mm, acute to obtuse, obscurely 1- to 3-nerved. Labellum white to pinkish-purple, with bluish-purple spots, obscurely 3-lobed, ovate-elliptic, 40–50 by 28–30 mm; mid-lobe ovate, dentate-lacerate on apical margin, emarginate; side lobes obscure; ornaments of 3–5(–7) papillate lines, extending to the middle of mid-lobe. Column arcuate, 35–45 mm long, apex dentate. Fruit long fusiform, 2–4 by 0.5–1 cm.

description: Terrestrial herbs, evergreen, either with fusiform pseudobulbs bearing one apical foliage leaf (rarely 2 or 3 leaves) or reed-like with several foliage leaves. Flowering shoots mostly 50–100 cm tall. Foliage leaves suberect or spreading, plicate, lanceolate-oblong, prominently petiolate or not. Inflorescences unbranched or rarely branched, few- to many-flowered, erect, mostly as tall as or taller than the foliage leaves, arising from the base of the leafy shoot; with sterile bracts; floral bracts persistent. Flowers medium-sized, resupinate, a few open at a time; in Thai species mostly yellow, often with red markings or red flush. Sepals free, ovate to elliptic, spreading, pubescent on the outside. Petals similar but narrower, glabrous. Labellum fleshy, spurless, with 2 basal flanges joining it to the column at the base or up to one third, usually with explosive mechanism through which the labellum snaps upwards when touched, normally glabrous, sometimes ornamented by small calli. Column rather short; anther incumbent, versatile, with 4 solid pollinia with amorphous viscidium (stipe absent); rostellum flap-like.</br></br>A genus of 40–45 species in tropical Asia, ranging from the Andaman Islands, Thailand and Indochina southwards to Peninsular Malaysia, Java and Sumatra, and eastwards as far as New Guinea and nearby islands; 5 species in Thailand.</br></br>Notes: a more comprehensive version of this account was published in Gard. Bull. Singapore 61: 81–93. 2009.

description: Flowering shoots as reed-like stems with distinct basal pseudobulbs, to 70 cm tall. Pseudobulbs conical to bottle-shaped, olive-green or purplish-brown, 7–8 by 3–4 cm. Foliage leaves (5–)8–10, elliptic-lanceolate, acute, glabrous, laminas 8–16.5 by 1.9–3.5 cm. Inflorescences lax, pubescent, 30–51(–70) cm long; sterile bracts 5–8, lanceolate-oblong, acute, glabrous, 2.7–4 cm long; rachis (7–)13–20 cm long, 7- to 15-flowered; floral bracts ovate-lanceolate, acuminate, pubescent, whitish-green, (10‒)20‒35 mm long. Flowers yellow or pink dotted with red, labellum yellow or cream-coloured with purple markings in the basal part. Sepals elliptic-lanceolate, subacute or acute, pubescent on the outside; dorsal sepal 13–20 by 5–7 mm; lateral sepals similar but slightly narrower. Petals oblong-lanceolate, obtuse, glabrous, (11.5–)12.3–18.5 by 2.6–5 mm. Labellum ovate, 3-lobed, 7.5–11 by 8.5–12 mm, sides entire, upper part strongly recurved, broadest part near the apex; mid-lobe a triangular tooth, 0.6–1 by  0.5–1.5 mm; side lobes triangular, obtuse, without calli, c. 3 by 2–2.5 mm. Column glabrous, 4.5–7 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) pubescent, 15–28 mm long. Capsule not seen.

description: Flowering shoots as reed-like stems, without pseudobulbs. Foliage leaves 6–12(–14), lanceolate, acuminate, shortly hairy, laminas 19–30 by (1.9–)4.2–7.3 cm, borne in the upper half of the stem. Inflorescences lax, pubescent, to 100 cm tall; sterile bracts 7–9, lanceolate-oblong, acute, glabrous or pubescent, 2.3–2.5 cm long; rachis 18–23 cm long, many-flowered; floral bracts triangular, acuminate, 10–15 by 8–9 mm. Flowers to 38 mm in diameter, yellow with red blotches, labellum cream-coloured or white becoming yellow with age; sepals and petals pubescent; flowers with a foetid smell. Sepals lanceolate, acute, pubescent, 20–23 by 8–10 mm. Petals similar to the sepals. Labellum elliptic, weakly 3-lobed, sides entire and much recurved, broadest part of the labellum near its middle, 9–10 mm long; mid-lobe tooth-like, deflexed, to 3 by 2 mm; side lobes inconspicuous, without calli, to 2 mm long. Column 6–9 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) pubescent, 18–20 mm long. Capsule ellipsoid, c. 52 by 14 mm.

description: Flowering shoots pseudobulbous. Pseudobulbs conical, spaced at intervals on a creeping rhizome, 4–10(–12) by 0.5–1 cm, covered by leaf sheaths. Foliage leaf 1, elliptic-lanceolate, acuminate, glabrous, 46–61 by 6.8–9.4(–11.1) cm; petiole (15–)20–40 cm long. Inflorescences lax or semi-dense, pubescent or subglabrous, 46–70(–80) cm long; peduncles to 50 cm long; sterile bracts 3–5, lanceolate-oblong, acute, 1.5–3 cm long; rachis gradually elongating to 30 cm long, 10- to 15-flowered; floral bracts ovate-lanceolate, acute, 6.5–10 by 2–2.3 mm. Flowers to 27 mm in diameter; yellow with red or sometimes brown blotches, labellum yellow. Sepals ovate-lanceolate, acuminate; dorsal sepal 11–15 by 5–6 mm; lateral sepals 13–15 by 3–5 mm. Petals linear-oblong, acute, 11–15 by 2.5–2.9 mm. Labellum ovate-lanceolate, weakly 3-lobed, side margins entire, 8–9 by 7–8 mm; mid-lobe tooth-like, strongly recurved, 0.5–2.5 mm long; side lobes obtuse, without calli, to 2 by 3.5 mm. Column with broad apical wings, 5.5–6.2 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) glabrous or pubescent, c. 15 mm long. Capsule not seen.

description: Flowering shoots pseudobulbous. Pseudobulbs conical, green to violet, spaced on a creeping rhizome, 5–8(–15) by 1.1–1.5(–2) cm. Foliage leaves 1 or 2(–3, see below), elliptic lanceolate, acute, upper surface green or purple, lower purple, glabrous, 30–59 by 4.5–12 cm; petioles (3–)6–14 cm long. Inflorescences lax, violet, pubescent, 62–120 cm long; peduncles 48– 84 cm long; sterile bracts 5–8, lanceolate-oblong, acute, glabrous or pubescent, (1.2–)1.6–4.5 cm long; rachis 14–36 cm long, 20- to 30-flowered; floral bracts ovate-lanceolate, acuminate, green violet, pubescent, 6–11.7 by 1.8–6 mm. Flowers to 25 mm in diameter; yellowish or greenish with red markings, with a dark red blotch on the thickened portion of the lateral sepal, column yellow; sepals, petals and column more or less pubescent. Sepals oblong-lanceolate, subacute to acuminate; dorsal sepal 10–16(–17) by 4–5.6 mm; lateral sepals 9–14 by 5–7 mm, inside margins usually thickened. Petals linear-lanceolate, acute, 9.5–16.3 by 2–4.5 mm. Labellum ovate, 3-lobed, with 2 conical calli near the apex, sides erose or fimbriate, apex reflexed, 5.5–8 by 5–8.3 mm; mid-lobe tooth-like, (1–)1.3–2.5 by 0.7–1.3 mm; side lobes triangular, obtuse or subacute, with calli. Column pubescent, 4.5–8 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) pubescent, 10–15 mm long. Capsule elongate-ellipsoid, pubescent, 22–40 by 3–8 mm.

description: Flowering shoots as reed-like stems, without prominent pseudobulbs. Foliage leaves 5–7, lanceolate-elliptic, acuminate, glabrous, laminas 11.5–21 by (1.6–)2–3.5 cm; petioles to 1.5 cm long. Inflorescences lax, pubescent, 67–92 cm tall; peduncles to 58 cm long; sterile bracts 7–8, lanceolate-oblong, acute, glabrous or hairy, 1.6–5 cm long; rachis 14–37 cm long, 10- to 25-flowered; floral bracts ovate-lanceolate, acuminate, green or purple, 8–10 by 2–4 mm. Flowers to 29 mm in diameter; yellow and tinged red, lateral sepals shiny red at the base, labellum yellow with dark markings, column white or yellow. Sepals ovate-lanceolate, subacute, outside hairy; dorsal sepal 18–25 by 5.2–8 mm; lateral sepals 13–22 by 5–10 mm. Petals narrowly linear-lanceolate, subacute, glabrous, 18–25 by 3–5 mm. Labellum quadrangular, 3-lobed, glabrous, side margins erose or fimbriate-hairy, 8–12 by 8–12 mm; mid-lobe tooth-like, sometimes reflexed, 1–2 by 1.2–2 mm; side lobes square or triangular, obtuse, with calli near the tip, 2–5 by 3.5–5 mm. Column 9–11 mm long; rostellum beaked, obtuse. Ovary (including pedicel) pubescent, 7–18 mm long. Capsule not seen.

description: Terrestrial herbs with adjacent pseudobulbous stems. Flowering shoots (16–)30–130(–150) cm tall. Pseudobulbs mostly underground and borne just below the soil surface. Foliage leaves few (very rarely one), plicate, lanceolate-oblong or grass-like, often deciduous, acuminate, glabrous, petiolate. Inflorescences racemose, few-flowered, basal, mostly pubescent; sterile bracts one to few, apically grading into the persistent floral bracts. Flowers medium-sized or large and often showy, resupinate, in Thailand yellow, white or pink. Sepals  free, spreading, outside usually pubescent. Petals similar but normally glabrous. Labellum 3-lobed, spurless, ornamented by basal twin-calli; mid-lobe spathulate or rarely linear-oblong, usually with 2 lateral teeth at the base of the claw; side lobes most commonly large, oblong, erect and enclosing the column. Column long, glabrous, without a column foot; anther versatile, incumbent, pollinia 8, waxy, clavate. Ovary pubescent, not distinct from the pedicel. Capsule variously ellipsoid.</br></br>A genus of c. 40 species distributed from India in the west throughout tropical and extra-tropical SE Asia to northern Australia (Queensland) and the islands of the Pacific Ocean, with Spathoglottis plicata also naturalised in other parts of the world; 7 species in Thailand.</br></br>Notes: a more comprehensive version of this account was published in Rheedea 18: 63–74. 2008.

description: Flowering shoots (24–)30–60(–77) cm tall. Pseudobulbs somewhat flattened, to 1 by 3 cm. Foliage leaves 2–4, lanceolate-linear, grass-like, deciduous, acute, glabrous, (10–)18–42 by (0.6–)1–2.3(–3.1) cm; petioles 3–5(–12) cm long. description: Terrestrial, mycohetrotrophic herbs with a vertical corm; devoid of roots. Flowering shoots erect; stem hollow, fragile, glabrous, pale brownish-white. Leaves alternate, membranous, scale-like, sheathing (below) or non-sheathing (above). Inflorescence racemose, (fairly) lax; floral bracts membranous, glabrous. Flowers resupinate, pendent. Sepals and petals free, glabrous. Labellum ornamented by glabrous calli, without papillae, spurless. Column stout, glabrous, without stelids and column foot; anther subterminal, versatile; pollinia 2, granular, longitudinally furrowed, with filiform caudicles; receptive part of stigma flat. Ovary distinctly pedicelled, glabrous. Fruit a capsule dehiscing by 6 longitudinal slits; pedicel not elongating during fruit ripening.</br></br>A monotypic genus; distribution as for the species (see below).

description: Corm oblongoid (to ellipsoid or ovoid), 1.6–4.4 cm long, 0.6–2.1 cm in diameter. description: Terrestrial, sympodial, autotrophic herbs with (often more or less buried) pseudobulbs that are clustered or (more often) distinctly separated along a rhizome. Foliage leaves usually present at the time of flowering, plicate (very rarely duplicate), 1 per corm or pseudobulb, not sheathing at base, either sessile with a rounded to cordate base or long-petiolate with a lamina  that is rounded to cuneate at base. Inflorescence heteranthous, or lateral from basal portion of corm or pseudobulb, racemose, usually longer than foliage leaves at the time of flowering; floral bracts spreading to pendent, acute. Flowers resupinate, all or nearly all open at the same time. Sepals and petals free, glabrous. Labellum firmly attached, not fused with column, entire or 3-lobed, usually ornamented by 2 or more longitudinal keels on the ventral side, sometimes shortly spurred at base. Column straight to slightly incurved, glabrous; column foot long, short or absent; anther subterminal, incumbent, versatile, sometimes with 2 short horn-like processes on top; pollinia 8, solid, with or without short caudicles; rostellum producing neither a stipe nor a viscidium; fertile part of stigma concave. Fruit a capsule dehiscing by longitudinal slits.</br></br>A genus of c. 30 species distributed in most of Indo-Malesia, extending to southern Japan in the north and to the Solomon Islands and northern Queensland in the south-east; 10 species in Thailand.

description: Pseudobulbs consisting of several internodes, erect, conical-ovoid to fusiform, 2.5–5 cm long, 0.4–2.5 cm in diameter. Leaves petiolate; petiole 6.5–35.8 cm long, with an articulation in its upper half; lamina (narrowly) oblanceolate to lanceolate, acute to acuminate, 13.5–47.9 by 1.5–6.8 cm, thin-textured. Inflorescence arising from a node, 44–130 cm long; rachis 8.2–55 cm long, 5- to 17-flowered; floral bracts 3–15 mm long. Flowers mainly greenish-brown to yellow (sepals and petals purple- to brown-veined; labellum white to cream, often with purple dots, greenish-yellow keels and brownish spur). Sepals acute to acuminate; dorsal sepal narrowly lanceolate, 17.5–24.5 by 3–4 mm; lateral sepals obliquely to falcately (ob)lanceolate-linear, 17–24.5 by 3.2–4 mm. Petals falcately and narrowly oblanceolate, acuminate, 16–22 by 2.8–3.8 mm. Labellum 3-lobed, 11–18 by 6–10 mm when flattened, 1.3–1.8 times as long as wide, with a (1.5–)2–4 mm long spur at base; mid-lobe (rhombic-)orbicular, subacuminate, 5–6.8 by 5–6.9 mm, margin entire and slightly undulating; side lobes rounded to obtuse, 3–3.5 mm long (measured along front edge); labellum ornamented by 3 keels starting from (near) its base and terminating on the mid-lobe; all keels straight or very nearly so, entire, somewhat lamella-like in their central and sometimes distal part. Column c. 10 mm long, with a 0.5–2 mm long column foot. Ovary (including pedicel) 9–17 mm long.

description: Pseudobulbs consisting of one internode, erect, fusiform to subterete, 2.5–4.8 cm long, 0.2–0.6 cm in diameter. Leaves petiolate; petiole 7.1–21.5 cm long, without an articulation; lamina lanceolate to lanceolate-elliptic, acute to acuminate, 7–19.7 by 1.7–6 cm, thin-textured. Inflorescence arising from a node or up to 7 mm above, 16.2–50.5 cm long; rachis to 27 cm  long, 1- to 11-flowered; floral bracts 18.4–33 mm long. Flowers mainly white to cream or green  (sepals and petals often crimson-veined, labellum white with a yellow median band). Sepals caudate; dorsal sepal narrowly lanceolate-linear, 39.5–51 by 1.6–2.2 mm; lateral sepals narrowly linear, 49.2–53.1 by 1.8–2.1 mm. Petals obliquely triangular-linear, caudate, 29.2–37 by 2.5–2.8 mm. Labellum entire, linear-oblong to lanceolate-oblong, acuminate, 14.8–15.5 by 5–5.3 mm when flattened, 2.9–3 times as long as wide, with a c. 2 mm long spur at base, margin (sub)entire and undulating (at least distally); labellum ornamented by 1 or 3 keels starting from its base and terminating close to the labellum apex; consistently straight to slightly undulating, entire and  low. Column 5.4–5.7 mm long, with a 1.8–2.3 mm long column foot. Ovary (including pedicel) 9–18 mm long.

description: Pseudobulbs consisting of several internodes, more or less prostrate, obliquely ovoid to ellipsoid, 2.5–6 cm long, 1.5–3.5 cm in diameter. Leaves petiolate; petiole 20–49 cm long, without an articulation; lamina lanceolate, acute to subacuminate, 32–66 by 3–9 cm, thin textured. Inflorescence arising from a node, 98–152 cm long; rachis 19.5–55 cm long, 18- to many-flowered; floral bracts 6–22 mm long. Flowers mainly dull purplish-brown to pale green (labellum mainly white to green with orangish spur and sometimes yellow mid-lobe). Sepals acute to acuminate; dorsal sepal narrowly oblanceolate, 22.4–27.6 by 5.7–6.2 mm; lateral sepals falcately (linear-)lanceolate, 19.7–24.6 by 6–6.4 mm. Petals falcately oblanceolate, acuminate, 17.7–24 by 5.4–5.9 mm. Labellum 3-lobed, 13.5–14 by 9.4–9.6 mm when flattened, 1.2–1.7  times as long as wide, with a 1.3–1.7 mm long spur at base; mid-lobe suborbicular, acute to subacuminate, 4.9–5.8 by 5.5–5.8 mm, margin entire and straight to undulate; side lobes obtuse  to rounded, 2–2.3 mm long (measured along front edge); labellum ornamented by 3 keels starting from (near) its base and 2 or 4 keels starting from above the middle, all terminating on the mid-lobe; all keels straight and entire on the disk, undulating and more or less erose-denticulate on the mid-lobe, somewhat lamella-like. Column 8–9 mm long, with a 0.9–1.5 mm long column foot. Ovary (including pedicel) 12–23 mm long.

description: Pseudobulbs consisting of one internode, erect, (arcuate-)subterete (petiole-like), slightly swollen towards base, 7.2–13 cm long, 0.3–0.4 cm in diameter. Leaves pale green with dark green blotches, sessile, ovate-cordate to elliptic-cordate, (short-)acuminate, 11–18 by 6.1–12.2 cm, somewhat leathery. Inflorescence arising from a node (or very nearly so), 14.4–29.9 cm long; rachis 3.8–8.2 cm long, 5- to 10-flowered; floral bracts 4–5 mm long. Flowers mainly olive-green to orange-brown (sepals and petals sometimes with purple veins, labellum mainly white to cream with fine purple markings and more or less orange-brown distally). Sepals acute to acuminate; dorsal sepal (linear-)lanceolate, 15–17 by 3.2–3.7 mm; lateral sepals obliquely (linear-)lanceolate from a broader base, 18–19.5 by 3.5–7 mm. Petals obliquely lanceolate elliptic, acute, 14–16 by 5–5.6 mm. Labellum entire to shallowly 3-lobed, 16–19.2 by 15–16.2 mm when flattened, 1.1–1.2 times as long as wide, slightly concave at base; mid-lobe (if differentiated) triangular, acute to rounded, c. 7.5 by c. 9.2 mm, margin entire and straight; side lobes (if differentiated) rounded, 7.7–8 mm long (measured along the front edge); labellum ornamented by 3 keels starting from its base and terminating close to the labellum apex; median keel straight, entire, low; lateral keels straight to slightly undulating, entire, somewhat lamella-like. Column 6–8 mm long, with a 9.5–10 mm long column foot. Ovary (including pedicel) 5–11 mm long.

description: Terrestrial, sympodial herbs with vertical subspherical corms producing inflorescences devoid of foliage leaves and erect leafy shoots with pseudostems formed by convolute leaf bases. Foliage leaves plicate, sometimes starting to wither before the end of anthesis. Inflorescences racemose or paniculate with up to 3 suberect lateral branches, many-flowered; floral bracts persistent. Flowers opening in succession (up to 10 at a time) from the inflorescence base upwards, resupinate. Sepals and petals free, glabrous, dull yellowish-green (sometimes weakly suffused with purple). Labellum versatile, erect from base but soon recurved by a knee-like bend, oblong, slightly widened in its distal part, bright green with 2 darker green keels and a transparent median band. Column stout (less than 3 times as long as anther), with a short column foot; anther subterminal, elongated, versatile, light brown; pollinia 2, sectile, partly cleft, devoid of caudicles; rostellum producing a viscidium, but no stipe; receptive part of stigma concave with slightly elevated margins. Ovary and pedicel twisted through 180, glabrous. Fruit a capsule dehiscing by longitudinal slits.</br></br>A monotypic genus; distribution as for the species (see below).

description: Corm 2.6–3.7 cm long, c. 3 cm in diameter, with a dense tangle of unbranched roots. Foliage leaves 3–4, distichous; pseudostem 20–32 cm long; free part of each leaf linear lanceolate to obovate, 10–30 by 2.3–9.7 cm, acuminate. Inflorescence 35–91 cm tall; peduncle purplish-brown, glaucescent, bearing 3–6 scale-like leaves; rachis of primary stem 14–37.6 cm long, lateral branches (if present) 8.9–24 cm long; floral bracts oblong-lanceolate, long-acute to acuminate, 5–12.5 mm long. Flowers not opening widely. Sepals acute, minutely mucronate; dorsal sepal strongly boat-shaped, linear-lanceolate, 3-veined from the base, 12.4–13.1 by 3.1–3.8 mm; lateral sepals more or less boat-shaped, falcately oblong-lanceolate, 3- to 5-veined from the base, 9.9–12 by 3.7–4.3 mm; petals connivent with the dorsal sepal, falcately linear-(ob)lanceolate, obtuse to acute, 1-veined from the base, 9.5–10.8 by c. 2.3 mm, subentire. Labellum shortly clawed, obtuse to acute, sometimes minutely mucronate, 9–10.2 by 4.8–5.3 mm, glabrous and smooth, subentire, ornamented by 2 entire longitudinal keels in its proximal  half. Column erect, incurved, subterete, 5.5–6.4 mm long; anther (narrowly) ovate in upper view, obtuse to subacute, 2.7–2.9 mm long; rostellum porrect, broadly trapezoid, truncate; receptive part of stigma (linear-)oblong. Ovary (including pedicel) terete-fusiform with 3 distinct entire keels, 10–12.3 mm long. Capsule fusiform-terete, tapering at base, 1.5–2.8 cm long (excluding perianth remnants and pedicel), 0.4–0.6 cm in diameter.

description: Epiphytic, sympodial herbs with short rhizomes. Pseudobulbs flattened, ridged, closely aggregated, each consisting of one internode and bearing 1 leaf. Foliage leaves duplicate, much longer than the pseudobulbs, glabrous, present during flowering, deciduous, not sheathing at base but with a grooved petiole. Inflorescences long-lived, pendulous, racemose, arising from the base of pseudobulbs, lax, 3- to many-flowered. Flowers medium-sized. Sepals and petals free. Labellum 3-lobed, versatile, ornamented by 2 calli at base. Column strongly incurved (forming a C together with the column foot), at apex hooded and provided with 2 stelids; column foot conspicuous, hollow with an entrance at base of labellum; anther conical; pollinarium composed of 4 solid pollinia arranged in 2 unequal pairs and attached to a long narrow stipe (tegule); viscidium not clearly differentiated; Ovary glabrous. Fruit a pedicelled capsule dehiscing by longitudinal slits.</br></br>A genus of 2 species recorded from Vietnam, Thailand, Peninsular Malaysia and Borneo; 1 species in Thailand.

description: Pseudobulbs subovoid to oblongoid, 2–3.6 by 0.9–1.7 cm. Foliage leaves rather thick, glabrous; lamina elliptic to oblong-lanceolate, acute, 5.5–21.5 by 2.4–4.2 cm, leaves of first and second year much smaller than leaves of third year. Inflorescences glabrous; peduncle 1.5–3  cm long; rachis 3.8–5.5 cm long; floral bracts minute, triangular, 1.5–2 by 2–3 mm, glabrous. Flowers 3–11, opening widely; pedicel (including ovary) 10.5–13 mm long. Sepals glabrous,  acute; dorsal sepal narrowly oblong-elliptic, concave, 16–18 by 5.3–6 mm, incurved in its distal two-thirds; lateral sepals broadly and falcately ovate to triangular-ovate, spreading, abruptly recurved about one-third below apex, 13–13.5 by 8–8.2 mm. Petals porrect, incurved towards column, glabrous, falcately linear-lanceolate, acute, 15–16 by 3–3.1 mm. Labellum 7.7–8 mm long, distinctly clawed; side lobes very broadly and obliquely spathulate, erect from just above  the claw, 2–2.5 by 4–4.5 mm; mid-lobe broadly ovate, recurved, obtuse to broadly acute, shortly pubescent on ventral surface, 4.5–5 by 3.8–4 mm; disk ornamented by 2 basal bilaterally flattened calli that are bent in a right angle so as to almost block the entrance of the hollow column foot. Column glabrous, 12.5–13 mm long; column foot c. 5 mm long; stelids obliquely (triangular-) oblong, 2–3 by 2–2.2 mm. Capsule ellipsoid, 2.2–3.3 cm long, 1–1.7 cm in diameter.

description: Pseudobulbs conical to ovoid, 2.5–5.5 by 1–2.8 cm. Foliage leaves linear-oblong to oblong-elliptic, acute, thin-textured, glabrous, 15–32 by 2–5 cm. Inflorescences glabrous; peduncle 3–6 cm long; rachis 7–36.5 cm long; floral bracts minute, triangular, 1.8–3 by 1.8– 2 mm, glabrous. Flowers opening widely; pedicel (including ovary) 0.6–1 cm long. Sepals glabrous, whitish with dark purple or crimson blotches, acute; dorsal sepal oblong, concave in  distal part, 9–10 by 3–3.5 mm; lateral sepals broadly ovate to oblong-ovate, shortly decurrent on the column foot, 7.5–8.5 by 4.5–5.2 mm. Petals spreading, glabrous, linear, acute to obtuse, whitish with dark purple or crimson patches, 9–10 by 1–1.5 mm. Labellum whitish with crimson patches or spots, 3-lobed, shortly clawed; side lobes falcately oblong to semi-circular, smaller than mid-lobe, erect from just above the claw, 3–3.5 by 1–2 mm; mid-lobe broadly obovate, recurved, rounded to retuse, shortly pubescent on upper surface, slightly longer in the central area towards base, 4.4–6 by 2.5–5 mm; disk ornamented by 2 small conical calli at base of side lobes. Column glabrous, c. 7.5 mm long, white; column foot c. 4.1 mm long; stelids c. 2 by 0.5–1 mm; pollinia subglobular; tegula subquadrate. Capsule oblongoid-fusiform, 1.8–2.3 cm long, c. 0.6 cm in diameter.

description: Terrestrial, lithophytic or epiphytic herbs, usually large and tall, without pseudobulbs; rhizome thick and short; roots fasciculate. Stems fascicled, erect or spreading, simple, cylindrical, fleshy, biennial, sheathed below and with normal leaves above. Foliage leaves many, distichous, chartaceous, glaucous beneath, sessile and sheathing below, deciduous. Inflorescence racemose, terminal on young leafy shoots, few- to many-flowered, arching or pendulous; floral bracts spathaceous, large, persistent. Flowers large, showy, not opening widely, short-lived. Sepals free, usually oblong-lanceolate, with several veins. Petals subsimilar to sepals, free, often slightly narrower and shorter than sepals. Labellum simple or obscurely 3-lobed, enclosing column, spurred at base, fringed on front margin, ornamented by several papillose keels in upper half of labellum. Column slender, winged at apex, straight to slightly incurved; column foot absent; anther terminal, incumbent, 2-celled, each cell subdivided into 2; pollinia 4, often deeply 2-lobed, solid, without disctinct caudicles; stigma concave; rostellum more or less 3-lobed. Fruit a capsule.</br></br>A genus of c. 4 species distributed from NE India, Nepal, Bhutan, Myanmar and S China to Peninsular Malaysia; 3 species in Thailand.

description: Flowering shoots 50–150 cm tall, terrestrial, epiphytic or lithophytic; rhizome short, 6–7 mm in diameter. Stems stout, erect, 1–1.5 cm in diameter, placed close together on rhizome; sheaths 3–6 cm long, acute. Foliage leaves many, distichous, mostly linear-lanceolate, the lower ones near stem base ovate, 15–40 by 2.5–5 cm, apex acute to acuminate, base sheating, glaucous beneath; main veins 5–8. Inflorescence terminal, pendulous, 12–15 cm long; peduncle with several sterile bracts; rachis slender, 3–6 cm long; floral bracts ovate-lanceolate, 4.5–5.5 by 2.5–3.5 cm, acute to acuminate, concave. Flowers 5–7, usually facing the same way, not opening widely; pedicel and ovary slender, 15–45 mm long. Sepals oblong-lanceolate, 60–85 by 10–18 mm, acute, white. Petals similar to sepals but slightly narrower. Labellum white, with large yellow patch, simple, broadly oblong to obovate-oblong, 45–55 by 15–35 mm, ornamented by 5 to many orange-yellow fringed keels; apical margins dentate-undulate; spur conspicuous, 15–18  mm long, 2-lobed, obtuse. Column white, 20–25 by 5–8 mm, slender, winged at apex; pollinia 4, deeply 2-lobed, 8 in appearance; rostellum 3-lobed, median lobe largest, obtuse, lateral lobes acute. Capsule narrowly ellipsoid, 3.5–4.5 by 1–2 cm.

description: Flowering shoots 30–100 cm tall, epiphytic or lithophytic; rhizome short, 5–7 mm in diameter. Stems stout, erect, 1–1.7 cm in diameter, placed close together on rhizome; sheaths 3–5 cm long, acute. Foliage leaves many, distichous, mostly ovate-lanceolate to oblong-lanceolate, the lower ones near stem base suborbicular, ovate or ovate-lanceolate, 10–25 by 3–5 cm, apex acute to acuminate, base sheathing, glaucous beneath; main veins 5–7. Inflorescence terminal, pendulous, 8–12 cm long; peduncle with sterile bracts; rachis slender, 2.5–5 cm long; floral bracts ovate-lanceolate, 3.5–5.2 by 1.5–3 cm, acute to acuminate, concave. Flowers 3–7, not opening widely; pedicel and ovary slender, 12–40 mm long. Sepals oblong-lanceolate, 55–82 by 10–17 mm, acute, purple. Petals similar to sepals but slightly wider and shorter. Labellum dark purple at apical margins, light purple at base, broadly obovate-oblong, 45–65 by 15–40 mm, ornamented by 5 to many orange-yellow fringed keels; apical margins undulate; spur conspicuous, 12–15 mm long, shallowly 2-lobed, obtuse. Column white, 18–27 by 5–7 mm, slender, winged and irregularly dentate at apex; pollinia 4, deeply 2-lobed, 8 in appearance; rostellum 3-lobed, median lobe largest, obtuse, lateral lobes acute. Capsule narrowly obovoid-ellipsoid, 3.2–4 by 1–2 cm.

description: Flowering shoots 50–100 cm tall, epiphytic or lithophytic; rhizome short. Stems stout, erect, 1–1.2 cm in diameter, placed close together on rhizome; sheathed at base. Foliage leaves many, distichous, linear-lanceolate, 15–30 by 2.5–4.5 cm, apex acute to acuminate, base sheathing, glaucous beneath; main veins 3–7. Inflorescence terminal, pendulous, 10–15 cm long; peduncle with several sterile bracts; rachis slender, 3–6.5 cm long; floral bracts lanceolate, 2.5–3.5 by 0.8–1.5 cm, acuminate, concave. Flowers 6–10, not opening widely; pedicel and ovary slender, 28–40 mm long. Sepals lanceolate or oblong-lanceolate, 30–35 by 8–12 mm, acute, white. Petals similar to sepals but slightly narrower. Labellum white, simple, ovate to oblong-obovate, 25–35 by 15–20 mm, ornamented by 5–8 bright yellowish-brown keels at center and purple veins along margins; apical margins irregularly denticulate-undulate, apiculate; spur minute, 2–2.5 mm long, only slightly cleft at apex, enclosed by the bases of lateral sepals. Column white, 15–18 by 3–8 mm, winged and irregularly dentate at apex; pollinia not deeply 2-lobed, 4 in appearance; rostellum 3-lobed, median lobe largest, acute to obtuse, lateral lobes acute.

description: Autotrophic (rarely mycoheterotrophic) terrestrial herbs with a short rhizome producing fibrous fasciculate, richly branched roots. Stem erect, rigid, branched or unbranched, bearing tubular cataphylls in its basal part. Foliage leaves sessile, sheathing at base, plicate (foliage leaves absent in the few mycoheterotrophic species). Inflorescences 1 to several, lateral (leaf-opposed) and/or terminal, racemose, short and dense. Flowers non-resupinate, not opening fully, mainly (greenish-)white to cream (labellum often with a yellow to orange blotch). Sepals and petals subsimilar; dorsal sepal free, more or less boat-shaped; lateral sepals connate, at least at base; petals free, entire. Labellum sessile, adnate to base of column, (linear-)lanceolate to somewhat fiddle-shaped, saccate to spurred at base, ornamented by a pair of keels or calli. Column less than 3 times as long as anther, dominated by the prominent rostellum; anther dorsal, versatile, elongated, acuminate, often dorsally keeled; pollinia 2, sectile, with slender caudicles; rostellum erect, producing a hamule and a viscidium; receptive part of stigma flat. Ovary and pedicel  (sub)terete, often scurfy-pubescent. Fruit an erect to spreading, short-pedicelled to subsessile, 6-ribbed capsule dehiscing by longitudinal slits.</br></br>A genus of 15–30 species distributed from Mexico and Florida to Venezuela, Colombia and Ecuador (including Galapagos), and throughout Indo-Malesia to northern Queensland and the SW Pacific islands (east to Tonga); 3 species in Thailand.

description: Flowering shoots (15–)20–48 cm tall; cataphylls widely spaced. Foliage leaves 2 (very rarely 1 or 3), subopposite on distal part of stem, elliptic to broadly elliptic-ovate (rarely lanceolate), acuminate to caudate; longest leaf (5.6–)7–18.5 by (1.7–)2.6–12.2 cm. Inflorescence 1, terminal, cylindric, 12- to many-flowered, 5–10.7 cm long; peduncle (1.5–)2–5.2 cm long, sometimes bearing 1–4 more or less spreading bract-like leaves; floral bracts shorter than, equal to or longer than ovaries, narrowly linear-triangular, acuminate to caudate, 4–15 mm long. Sepals sparsely pubescent to subglabrous; dorsal sepal linear to narrowly linear-lanceolate, acute to acuminate, mucronate, 11.2–11.4 by 2.2–2.3 mm; lateral sepals connate for almost their entire length, the resulting synsepal tightly embracing the labellum’s spur at base, the non-tubular part boat-shaped, linear-triangular to linear-lanceolate, bifid with acuminate, often mucronate lobules, 11.9–12.5 by 4.6–5.2 mm. Petals boat-shaped, obliquely lanceolate, obtuse to acute, 9.9–10.7 by 3.2–3.5 mm. Labellum boat-shaped, spurred at base, lanceolate, obtuse to acute, sometimes minutely mucronate, 9–10.6 by 4–4.7 mm, subentire to somewhat erose, ornamented by a pair of longitudinal keels in its proximal half; spur subparallel to ovary, cylindric, rounded to obtuse, 6.5–7 mm long. Column 7.1–8.2 mm long (to apex of rostellum); anther lanceolate to narrowly linear-lanceolate in upper view, 3.4–5.3 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) 4–12 mm long. Capsule oblongoid to ellipsoid, (0.7–)1.1–1.8 cm long (excluding perianth remnants), 0.4–0.7 cm in diameter.

description: Flowering shoots 30–50(–150) cm tall; cataphylls overlapping. Foliage leaves 7–21, alternate on the distal half (or more) of the stem, (narrowly) lanceolate to linear-lanceolate, long-acuminate to caudate; longest leaf (9.5–)10.7–24.7 by (0.7–)1.3–4.9 cm. Inflorescences 1–5, lateral and/or terminal, subspherical to broadly ellipsoid, usually 5- to 10-flowered, 0.8–3.2 cm long; peduncle up to 2.3 cm long (often much shorter), covered by appressed, densely imbricate bract-like leaves; floral bracts usually shorter than ovaries, broadly triangular-ovate to (lanceolate-)ovate, acuminate, 2–4 mm long. Sepals sparsely scurfy-pubescent; dorsal sepal (linear-)lanceolate, 5.7–8.3 by 1.8–3.1 mm, obtuse to acuminate, often mucronate; lateral sepals connate at base, sigmoidly linear-lanceolate to falcately (ovate-)lanceolate, (sub)acuminate, often mucronate, 5.8–10.1 by 2.1–2.8 mm. Petals falcately lanceolate, subacuminate, 4.9–7.8 by 1.5–2.6 mm. Labellum saccate and sometimes slightly indented along mid-line in the 2.5–4.8 mm long proximal part; flat, linear-lanceolate and reflexed in the 1.4–2.7 mm long distal part, obtuse to subacuminate; ornamented by a pair of low, rounded lateral calli at base of the distal part. Column 2.6–4.5 mm long (to apex of rostellum); anther elliptic-lanceolate to ovate in upper view, 2.1–2.4 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) 2–5.8 mm long. Capsule not seen.

description: Flowering shoots (9–)20–60 cm tall; cataphylls overlapping. Foliage leaves 4–12, alternate on the distal half (or more) of the stem, (linear-)lanceolate, acute to long-acuminate (rarely caudate); longest leaf 8.5–20.8 by 0.8–4.4 cm. Inflorescences 1–4, lateral and/or terminal, subspherical to broadly ellipsoid, usually 15- to many-flowered, (1–)2.5–4.9 cm long; peduncle up to 3.5 cm long (often much shorter), bearing a few spreading to appressed bract-like leaves; floral bracts usually longer than ovaries, narrowly linear to lanceolate, acute to acuminate, (4.5–)5.5–15 mm long. Sepals sparsely scurfy-pubescent; dorsal sepal (linear-)lanceolate, 8–9.1 by 1.7–2.1 mm, acuminate, mucronate, 3- to 5-veined from the base; lateral sepals connate at base, obliquely linear to falcately lanceolate, 9.2–9.8 by 1.7–2.5 mm, acuminate, mucronate, 3-veined from the base. Petals falcately linear-lanceolate, subacuminate, 7–8.3 by 1.8–1.9 mm. Labellum saccate and usually slightly indented along mid-line in the 3–4.5 mm long proximal part; flat, linear-lanceolate and reflexed in the 1.8–2 mm long distal part, obtuse; ornamented by a pair of low rounded lateral calli at base of the flat distal part. Column 3.2–4.3 mm long (to apex of rostellum); anther linear-triangular to elliptic-lanceolate in upper view, 2.1–2.4 mm long. Ovary (including pedicel) 4.4–8 mm long. Capsule oblongoid, 1.3–1.5 cm long (excluding perianth remnants), 0.3–0.6 cm in diameter.
